title: Sukta 1 · In praise of Savitar
deity: In praise of Savitar
text:
अमृतप्रदाता
१-३ अथर्वा। सविता। उष्णिक्, १ त्रिपदा पिपिलिकमध्या साम्नी जगती, २-३ पिपीलिकमध्या पुरउष्णिक्।
दो॒षो गा॑य बृ॒हद् गा॑य द्यु॒मद् धे॑हि ।
आथ॑र्वण स्तु॒हि दे॒वं स॑वि॒तार॑म्॥१॥
तमु॑ ष्टुहि॒ यो अ॒न्तः सिन्धौ॑ सू॒नुः ।
स॒त्यस्य॒ युवा॑न॒मद्रो॑घवाचं सु॒शेव॑म्॥२॥
स घा॑ नो दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता सा॑विषद॒मृता॑नि॒ भूरि॑ ।
उ॒भे सु॑ष्टुती सु॒गात॑वे ॥३॥
translation_en:
Sing, Atharvana, at eve, sing loudly, bring a splendid present: hymn God Savitar with praises.

Yea, praise him whose home is in the river, Son of Truth, the youthful, gracious friend whose word is guileless.

Savitar our God shall send us many everlasting treasures, that both paths may well be travelled.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 1 · In praise of Savitar - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा In praise of Savitar की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [In praise of Savitar स्तुति]: Sing, Atharvana, at eve, sing loudly, bring a splendid present: hymn God Savitar with praises.

2. [In praise of Savitar स्तुति]: Yea, praise him whose home is in the river, Son of Truth, the youthful, gracious friend whose word is guileless.

3. [In praise of Savitar स्तुति]: Savitar our God shall send us many everlasting treasures, that both paths may well be travelled.

title: Sukta 2 · In praise of Indra
deity: In praise of Indra
text:
आत्मगोपनम्।
१-३ अथर्वा। सोमः, वनस्पतिः। परोष्णिक्।
इन्द्रा॑य॒ सोम॑मृत्विजः सु॒नोता च॑ धावत ।
स्तो॒तुर्यो वचः॑ शृ॒णव॒द्धवं॑ च मे ॥१॥
आ यं वि॒शन्तीन्द॑वो॒ वयो॒ न वृ॒क्षमन्ध॑सः ।
विर॑प्शि॒न् विमृधो॑ जहि रक्ष॒स्विनीः॑ ॥२॥
सु॒नोता॑ सोम॒पाव्ने॑ सोम॒मिन्द्रा॑य व॒ज्रिणे॑ ।
युवा॒ जेतेशा॑नः॒ स पु॑रुष्टु॒तः ॥३॥
translation_en:
For Indra, ministering priests! run ye and press the Soma juice, That he may hear his praiser's word, and this my call.

Thou into whom the drops find way as sap pours life into a tree, Drive off in thine abundant might our demon foes.

For Indra, thunder-armed, who drinks the Soma press the Soma out: He, youthful, conqueror, and Lord is praised by all.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 2 · In praise of Indra - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा In praise of Indra की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [In praise of Indra स्तुति]: For Indra, ministering priests! run ye and press the Soma juice, That he may hear his praiser's word, and this my call.

2. [In praise of Indra स्तुति]: Thou into whom the drops find way as sap pours life into a tree, Drive off in thine abundant might our demon foes.

3. [In praise of Indra स्तुति]: For Indra, thunder-armed, who drinks the Soma press the Soma out: He, youthful, conqueror, and Lord is praised by all.

title: Sukta 3 · A prayer to various deities for protection and prosperity
deity: A prayer to various deities for protection and prosperity
text:
आत्मगोपनम्।
१-३ अथर्वा। १ इन्द्रपूषणौ, अदितिः, मरुतः, अपां नपात्, सिन्धवः, विष्णुः, द्यौः,२ द्यावापृथिवी, ग्रावा, सोमः, सरस्वती, अग्निः,३ अश्विनौ, उषासानक्ता, अपां नपात्, त्वष्टा। जगती, पथ्याबृहती।
पा॒तं न॑ इन्द्रापूष॒णादि॑तिः॒ पान्तु॑ म॒रुतः॑ ।
अपां॑ नपात् सिन्धवः स॒प्त पा॑तन॒ पातु॑ नो॒ विष्णु॑रु॒त द्यौः ॥१॥
पा॒तां नो॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॒भिष्ट॑ये॒ पातु॒ ग्रावा॒ पातु॒ सोमो॑ नो॒ अंह॑सः ।
पातु॑ नो दे॒वी सु॒भगा॒ सर॑स्वती॒ पात्व॒ग्निः शि॒वा ये अ॑स्य पा॒यवः॑ ॥२॥
पा॒तां नो॑ दे॒वाश्विना॑ शु॒भस्पती॑ उ॒षासा॒नक्तो॒त न॑ उरुष्यताम्।
अपां॑ नपा॒दभिह्रुती॒ गय॑स्य चि॒द देव॑ त्वष्टर्व॒र्ध॑य॑ स॒र्वता॑तये ॥
translation_en:
Guard us the Maruts! Guard us well, O Indra, Piishan, Aditi. Guard us, O Waters' Child, and Rivers Seven. May Vishnu guard us, and the Sky.

May Heaven and Earth take care of us for victory, may Pressing- Stone and Soma save us from distress. Sarasvati, auspicious Goddess, guard us well: preserve us Agni and his kind protecting powers.

Preserve us both the Asvins, Gods and Lords of Light, and let the Dawns and Night bring us deliverance. The Waters' Child protect our house from every harm. Do thou, God Tvashtar, make us strong for health and wealth.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 3 · A prayer to various deities for protection and prosperity - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer to various deities for protection and prosperity की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer to various deities for protection and prosperity स्तुति]: Guard us the Maruts! Guard us well, O Indra, Piishan, Aditi. Guard us, O Waters' Child, and Rivers Seven. May Vishnu guard us, and the Sky.

2. [A prayer to various deities for protection and prosperity स्तुति]: May Heaven and Earth take care of us for victory, may Pressing- Stone and Soma save us from distress. Sarasvati, auspicious Goddess, guard us well: preserve us Agni and his kind protecting powers.

3. [A prayer to various deities for protection and prosperity स्तुति]: Preserve us both the Asvins, Gods and Lords of Light, and let the Dawns and Night bring us deliverance. The Waters' Child protect our house from every harm. Do thou, God Tvashtar, make us strong for health and wealth.

title: Sukta 4 · A hymn to various deities for protection
deity: A hymn to various deities for protection
text:
१-३ अथर्वा। १ त्वष्टा, पर्जन्यः, ब्रह्मणस्पतिः, अदितिः, २ अंशः, भगः, वरुणः, मित्रः, अर्यमा, अदितिः, मरुतः,३ अश्विनौ, द्यौष्पिता। पथ्याबृहती, २ संस्तारपङ्क्तिः, ३ त्रिपदा विराड्गायत्री।
त्वष्टा॑ मे॒ दैव्यं॒ वचः॑ प॒र्जन्यो॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पतिः॑ ।
पु॒त्रैर्भ्रातृ॑भि॒रदि॑ति॒र्नु पा॑तु नो दु॒ष्टरं॒ त्राय॑माणं॒ सहः॑ ॥१॥
अंशो॒ भगो॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मादि॑तिः॒ पान्तु॑ म॒रुतः॑ ।
अप॒ तस्य॒ द्वेषो॑ गमेदभि॒ह्रुतो॑ यावय॒च्छत्रु॒मन्ति॑तम्॥२॥
धि॒ये सम॑श्विना॒ प्राव॑तं न उरु॒ष्या ण॑ उरुज्म॒न्नप्र॑युछन्।
द्यौ॒३ष्पित॑र्या॒वय॑ दु॒च्छुना॒ या॥३॥
translation_en:
May Tvashtar, Brāhmanaspati, Parjanya hear my holy prayer. May Aditi with all her sons, the brothers, guard us, invincible, protecting power.

May Ansa, Bhaga, Varuna, and Mitra, Aryaman, Aditi, and Maruts guard us. May we be freed from that oppressor's hatred. May he keep off that foeman who is near us.

May both the Asvins further our devotion. With ceaseless care deliver us, Wide-Ranger! O Father Heaven, keep from us all misfortunes.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 4 · A hymn to various deities for protection - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A hymn to various deities for protection की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A hymn to various deities for protection स्तुति]: May Tvashtar, Brāhmanaspati, Parjanya hear my holy prayer. May Aditi with all her sons, the brothers, guard us, invincible, protecting power.

2. [A hymn to various deities for protection स्तुति]: May Ansa, Bhaga, Varuna, and Mitra, Aryaman, Aditi, and Maruts guard us. May we be freed from that oppressor's hatred. May he keep off that foeman who is near us.

3. [A hymn to various deities for protection स्तुति]: May both the Asvins further our devotion. With ceaseless care deliver us, Wide-Ranger! O Father Heaven, keep from us all misfortunes.

title: Sukta 5 · A prayer to Agni and Indra for the well being of a princely patron
deity: A prayer to Agni and Indra for the well being of a princely patron
text:
वर्चः प्राप्तिः
१-३ अथर्वा। १ अग्निः, २ इन्द्रः, ३ अग्निः, सोमः, ब्रह्मणस्पतिः। अनुष्टुप्, २ भुरिक्।
उदे॑नमुत्त॒रं न॒याग्ने॑ घृ॒तेना॑हुत ।
समे॑नं॒ वर्च॑सा सृज प्र॒जया॑ च ब॒हुं कृ॑धि ॥१॥
इन्द्रे॒मं प्र॑त॒रं कृ॑धि सजा॒ताना॑मसद् व॒शी।
रा॒यस्पोषे॑ण॒ सं सृ॑ज जी॒वात॑वे ज॒रसे॑ नय ॥२॥
यस्य॑ कृ॒ण्मो ह॒विर्गृ॒हे तम॑ग्ने वर्धया॒ त्वम्।
तस्मै॒ सोमो॒ अधि॑ ब्रवद॒यं च॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पतिः॑ ॥३॥
translation_en:
Agni, adored with sacred oil, lift up this man to high estate. Endow him with full store of strength and make him rich in progeny.

Advance him, Indra! Let him be ruler of all akin to him. Grant him sufficiency of wealth: guide him to life and length of days.

Prosper this man, O Agni, in whose house we offer sacrifice. May Soma bless him, and the God here present, Brāhmanaspati.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 5 · A prayer to Agni and Indra for the well being of a princely patron - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer to Agni and Indra for the well being of a princely patron की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer to Agni and Indra for the well being of a princely patron स्तुति]: Agni, adored with sacred oil, lift up this man to high estate. Endow him with full store of strength and make him rich in progeny.

2. [A prayer to Agni and Indra for the well being of a princely patron स्तुति]: Advance him, Indra! Let him be ruler of all akin to him. Grant him sufficiency of wealth: guide him to life and length of days.

3. [A prayer to Agni and Indra for the well being of a princely patron स्तुति]: Prosper this man, O Agni, in whose house we offer sacrifice. May Soma bless him, and the God here present, Brāhmanaspati.

title: Sukta 6 · A prayer to Brāhmanaspati for protection from wicked men
deity: A prayer to Brāhmanaspati for protection from wicked men
text:
शत्रुनाशनम्।
१-३ अथर्वा। १ ब्रह्मणस्पतिः, २-३ सोमः। अनुष्टुप्।
यो॒३स्मा॑न् ब्र॑ह्मणस्प॒तेऽदे॑वो अभि॒मन्य॑ते ।
सर्वं॒ तं र॑न्धयासि मे॒ यज॑मानाय सुन्व॒ते॑॥१॥
यो नः॑ सोम सुशं॒सिनो॑ दुः॒शंस॑ आ॒दिदे॑शति ।
वज्रे॑णास्य॒ मुखे॑ जहि॒ स संपि॑ष्टो॒ अपा॑यति ॥२॥
यो नः॑ सोमाभि॒दास॑ति॒ सना॑भि॒र्यश्च॒ निष्ट्यः॑ ।
अप॒ तस्य॒ बलं॑ तिर म॒हीव॒ द्यौर्व॑ध॒त्मना॑ ॥३॥
translation_en:
The godless man whoever plots against us, Brāhmanaspati, Thou shalt give up as prey to me the worshipper who pour the juice.

If, Soma, any spiteful man hath aimed at us whose thoughts are kind, Smite with thy bolt upon his face: he, crushed to pieces, vani- sheth.

Soma, whoever troubleth us, be he a stranger or akin, Deprive him of the strength he hath: slay him thy-self like mighty Dyaus!
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 6 · A prayer to Brāhmanaspati for protection from wicked men - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer to Brāhmanaspati for protection from wicked men की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer to Brāhmanaspati for protection from wicked men स्तुति]: The godless man whoever plots against us, Brāhmanaspati, Thou shalt give up as prey to me the worshipper who pour the juice.

2. [A prayer to Brāhmanaspati for protection from wicked men स्तुति]: If, Soma, any spiteful man hath aimed at us whose thoughts are kind, Smite with thy bolt upon his face: he, crushed to pieces, vani- sheth.

3. [A prayer to Brāhmanaspati for protection from wicked men स्तुति]: Soma, whoever troubleth us, be he a stranger or akin, Deprive him of the strength he hath: slay him thy-self like mighty Dyaus!

title: Sukta 7 · A prayer to Soma and other gods for help and protection
deity: A prayer to Soma and other gods for help and protection
text:
असुरक्षयणम्।
१-३ अथर्वा। सोमः, अदितिः, ३ देवाः। गायत्री, १ निचृत्।
येन॑ सो॒मादि॑तिः प॒था मि॒त्रा वा॒ यन्त्य॒द्रुहः॑ ।
तेना॒ नोऽव॒सा ग॑हि ॥१॥
येन॑ सोम साह॒न्त्यासु॑रान् र॒न्धया॑सि नः ।
तेना॑ नो॒ अधि॑ वोचत ॥२॥
येन॑ देवा॒ असु॑राणा॒मोजां॒स्यवृ॑णीध्वम्।
तेना॑ नः॒ शर्म॑ यच्छत ॥३॥
translation_en:
Aditi is sky, and air's mid-region, Aditi is the father, son, and mother, Aditi all the Gods and the Five Nations, Aditi what is now and what is future.

We call for help the Queen of Law and Order, great mother of all those whose ways are righteous, Far-spread, unwasting strong in her dominion, Aditi wisely lead- ing, well protecting.

Sinless may we ascend, for weal, the vessel, rowed with good oars, divine, that never leaketh, Earth, our strong guard, incomparable Heaven, Aditi wisely lead- ing, well protecting.

Let us bring hither, in pursuit of riches, Aditi with our word, the mighty mother, Her in whose lap the spacious air is lying: may she afford us triply-guarding shelter!
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 7 · A prayer to Soma and other gods for help and protection - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer to Soma and other gods for help and protection की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer to Soma and other gods for help and protection स्तुति]: Aditi is sky, and air's mid-region, Aditi is the father, son, and mother, Aditi all the Gods and the Five Nations, Aditi what is now and what is future.

2. [A prayer to Soma and other gods for help and protection स्तुति]: We call for help the Queen of Law and Order, great mother of all those whose ways are righteous, Far-spread, unwasting strong in her dominion, Aditi wisely lead- ing, well protecting.

3. [A prayer to Soma and other gods for help and protection स्तुति]: Sinless may we ascend, for weal, the vessel, rowed with good oars, divine, that never leaketh, Earth, our strong guard, incomparable Heaven, Aditi wisely lead- ing, well protecting.

4. [A prayer to Soma and other gods for help and protection स्तुति]: Let us bring hither, in pursuit of riches, Aditi with our word, the mighty mother, Her in whose lap the spacious air is lying: may she afford us triply-guarding shelter!

title: Sukta 8 · A man's love-charm
deity: A man's love-charm
text:
कामात्मा
१-३ जमदग्निः। कामात्मा, २ सुपर्णः, ३ द्यावापृथिवी, सूर्यः। पथ्यापङ्क्तिः।
यथा॑ वृ॒क्षं लिबु॑जा सम॒न्तं प॑रिषस्व॒जे।
ए॒वा परि॑ ष्वजस्व॒ मां यथा॒ मां का॒मिन्यसो॒ यथा॒ मन्नाप॑गा॒ असः॑ ॥१॥
यथा॑ सुप॒र्णः प्र॒पत॑न् प॒क्षौ नि॒हन्ति॒ भूम्या॑म्।
ए॒वा नि ह॑न्मि ते॒ मनो॒ यथा॒ मां का॒मिन्यसो॒ यथा॒ मन्नाप॑गा॒ असः॑ ॥२॥
यथे॒मे द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी स॒द्यः प॒र्येति॒ सूर्यः॑ ।
ए॒वा पर्ये॑मि ते॒ मनो॒ यथा॒ मां का॒मिन्यसो॒ यथा॒ मन्नाप॑गा॒ असः॑ ॥३॥
translation_en:
Like as the creeper throws, her arms on every side around the tree, So hold thou me in thine embrace that thou mayst be in love with me, my darling, never to depart.

As, when he mounts, the eagle strikes his pinions downward on the earth, So do I strike thy spirit down that thou mayst be in love with me, my darling, never to depart.

As in his rapid course the Sun encompasses the heaven and: earth, So do I compass round thy mind that thou mayst be in love with. me, my darling, never to depart.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 8 · A man's love-charm - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A man's love-charm की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A man's love-charm स्तुति]: Like as the creeper throws, her arms on every side around the tree, So hold thou me in thine embrace that thou mayst be in love with me, my darling, never to depart.

2. [A man's love-charm स्तुति]: As, when he mounts, the eagle strikes his pinions downward on the earth, So do I strike thy spirit down that thou mayst be in love with me, my darling, never to depart.

3. [A man's love-charm स्तुति]: As in his rapid course the Sun encompasses the heaven and: earth, So do I compass round thy mind that thou mayst be in love with. me, my darling, never to depart.

title: Sukta 9 · A man's love-charm
deity: A man's love-charm
text:
कामात्मा
१-३ जमदग्निः। कामात्मा, ३ गावः। अनुष्टुप्।
वाञ्छ॑ मे त॒न्वं॑१ पादौ॒ वाञ्छा॒क्ष्यौ॒३वाञ्छ॑ स॒क्थ्यौऽ।
अ॒क्ष्यौऽ वृष॒ण्यन्त्याः॒ केशा॒ मां ते॑ कामे॑न शुष्यन्तु ॥१॥
मम॑ त्वा दोषणि॒श्रिषं॑ कृ॒णोमि॑ हृदय॒श्रिष॑म्।
यथा॒ मम॒ क्रता॒वसो॒ मम॑ चि॒त्तमु॒पाय॑सि ॥२॥
यासां॒ नाभि॑रा॒रेह॑णं हृ॒दि सं॒वन॑नं कृ॒तम् ।
गावो॑ घृ॒तस्य॑ मा॒तरो॒ ऽमूं सं वा॑नयन्तु मे ॥३॥
translation_en:
Desire my body, love my feet, love thou mine eyes, and love my legs. Let both thine eyes and hair, fond girl! be dried and parched. through love of me.

I make thee hang upon mine arm, I make thee lie upon my heart. Thou yieldest to my wish, that thou mayst be submissive to my will.

May they whose kisses are a bond, a love-charm laid within the heart, Mothers of butter, may the cows incline that maid to love of me.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 9 · A man's love-charm - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A man's love-charm की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A man's love-charm स्तुति]: Desire my body, love my feet, love thou mine eyes, and love my legs. Let both thine eyes and hair, fond girl! be dried and parched. through love of me.

2. [A man's love-charm स्तुति]: I make thee hang upon mine arm, I make thee lie upon my heart. Thou yieldest to my wish, that thou mayst be submissive to my will.

3. [A man's love-charm स्तुति]: May they whose kisses are a bond, a love-charm laid within the heart, Mothers of butter, may the cows incline that maid to love of me.

title: Sukta 10 · A thanksgiving for life, hearing, and sight
deity: A thanksgiving for life, hearing, and sight
text:
संप्रोक्षणम्।
१-३ शन्तातिः। १ पृथिवि, श्रोत्रं, वनस्पतिः, अग्निः, २ प्राणः, अन्तरिक्षं, वयः, वायुः,
३ द्यौः, चक्षुः, नक्षत्राणि, सूर्यः। द्वैपदम्, १ साम्नी त्रिष्टुप्, २ प्राजापत्या बृहती, ३ साम्नी बृहती।
पृ॒थि॒व्यै श्रोत्रा॑य॒ वन॒स्पति॑भ्यो॒ऽग्नयेऽधि॑पतये॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥१॥
प्रा॒णाया॒न्तरि॑क्षाय॒ वयो॑भ्यो वा॒यवेऽधि॑पतये॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥२॥
दि॒वे चक्षु॑षे॒ नक्ष॑त्रेभ्यः॒ सूर्या॒याधि॑पतये॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥३॥
translation_en:
All hail for hearing to the Earth, to Trees, to Agni, sovran Lord!

All hail for breath to Air, for power to life to Vāyu, sovran Lord!

All hail for vision to the Stars, to Heaven, to Sūrya, sovran Lord!
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 10 · A thanksgiving for life, hearing, and sight - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A thanksgiving for life, hearing, and sight की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A thanksgiving for life, hearing, and sight स्तुति]: All hail for hearing to the Earth, to Trees, to Agni, sovran Lord!

2. [A thanksgiving for life, hearing, and sight स्तुति]: All hail for breath to Air, for power to life to Vāyu, sovran Lord!

3. [A thanksgiving for life, hearing, and sight स्तुति]: All hail for vision to the Stars, to Heaven, to Sūrya, sovran Lord!

title: Sukta 11 · An epithalamian charm to ensure the birth of a boy
deity: An epithalamian charm to ensure the birth of a boy
text:
पुंसवनम्।
१-३ प्रजापतिः। रेतः, ३ प्रजापतिः, अनुमतिः, सिनीवाली। अनुष्टुप्।
श॒मीम॑श्व॒त्थ आरू॑ढ॒स्तत्र॑ पुं॒सु॑व॑नं कृ॒तम्।
तद् वै पु॒त्रस्य॒ वेद॑नं॒ तत् स्त्री॒ष्वा भ॑रामसि ॥१॥
पुं॒सि वै रेतो॑ भवति॒ तत् स्त्रि॒यामनु॑ षिच्यते ।
तद् वै पु॒त्रस्य॒ वेद॑नं॒ तत् प्र॒जाप॑तिरब्रवीत्॥२॥
प्र॒जाप॑ति॒रनु॑मतिः सिनीवा॒ल्यऽचीक्लृपत्।
स्त्रषू॑यम॒न्यत्र॒ दध॒त् पुंमां॑समु दधदि॒ह॥३॥
translation_en:
Asvattha on the Sami-tree. There a male birth is certified. There is the finding of a son: this bring we to the women-folk.

The father sows the genial seed, the woman tends and fosters it. This is the finding of a son: thus hath Prajāpati declared.

Prajāpati, Anumati, Sinivāli have ordered it. Elsewhere may he effect the birth of maids, but here prepare a boy.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 11 · An epithalamian charm to ensure the birth of a boy - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा An epithalamian charm to ensure the birth of a boy की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [An epithalamian charm to ensure the birth of a boy स्तुति]: Asvattha on the Sami-tree. There a male birth is certified. There is the finding of a son: this bring we to the women-folk.

2. [An epithalamian charm to ensure the birth of a boy स्तुति]: The father sows the genial seed, the woman tends and fosters it. This is the finding of a son: thus hath Prajāpati declared.

3. [An epithalamian charm to ensure the birth of a boy स्तुति]: Prajāpati, Anumati, Sinivāli have ordered it. Elsewhere may he effect the birth of maids, but here prepare a boy.

title: Sukta 12 · A charm against venomous serpents
deity: A charm against venomous serpents
text:
सर्प-विष-निवारणम्।
१-३ गरुत्मान्। तक्षकः। अनुष्टुप्।
परि॒ द्यामि॑व॒ सूर्योऽही॑नां॒ जनि॑मागमम्।
रात्री॒ जग॑दिवा॒न्यद्धं॒सात् तेना॑ ते वारये वि॒षम्॥१॥
यद् ब्र॒ह्मभि॒र्यदृषि॑भि॒र्यद् दे॒वैर्वि॑दि॒तं पु॒रा।
यद् भू॒तं भव्य॑मास॒न्वत् तेना॑ ते वारये वि॒षम्॥२॥
मध्वा॑ पृञ्चे न॒द्यः॑१ पर्व॑ता गि॒रयो॒ मधु॑ ।
मधु॒ परु॑ष्णी॒ शीपा॑ला॒ शमा॒स्ने अ॑स्तु॒ शं हृ॒दे॥३॥
translation_en:
I, As the Sun goes round the heaven, have travelled round the Serpents' race. I ward thy poison off, as Night parts all else living from the Sun.

With this, discovered in the days of old by Brāhmans, Rishis, Gods, With this I ward thy poison off, thou Biter! formed and form- ing now.

With mead I mingle flowing streams: the hills and mountains shall be mead. Parushni and Sipālā mead. May it be well with mouth and heart.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 12 · A charm against venomous serpents - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm against venomous serpents की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm against venomous serpents स्तुति]: I, As the Sun goes round the heaven, have travelled round the Serpents' race. I ward thy poison off, as Night parts all else living from the Sun.

2. [A charm against venomous serpents स्तुति]: With this, discovered in the days of old by Brāhmans, Rishis, Gods, With this I ward thy poison off, thou Biter! formed and form- ing now.

3. [A charm against venomous serpents स्तुति]: With mead I mingle flowing streams: the hills and mountains shall be mead. Parushni and Sipālā mead. May it be well with mouth and heart.

title: Sukta 13 · Homage to death
deity: Homage to death
text:
मृत्युजयः।
१-३ अथर्वा। (स्वस्त्ययनकामः)। मृत्युः। अनुष्टुप्।
नमो॑ देवव॒धेभ्यो॒ नमो॑ राजव॒धेभ्यः॑ ।
अथो॒ ये विश्या॑नां व॒धास्तेभ्यो॑ मृत्यो॒ नमो॑ऽस्तु ते ॥१॥
नम॑स्ते अधिवा॒काय॑ परावा॒काय॑ ते॒ नमः॑ ।
सु॒म॒त्यै मृ॑त्यो ते॒ नमो॑ दुर्म॒त्यै त॑ इ॒दं नमः॑ ॥२॥
नम॑स्ते यातु॒धाने॑भ्यो॒ नम॑स्ते भेष॒जेभ्यः॑ ।
नम॑स्ते मृत्यो॒ मूले॑भ्यो ब्राह्म॒णेभ्य॑ इ॒दं नमः॑ ॥३॥
translation_en:
Worship to weapons of the Gods! worship to weapons of the Kings! Then worship to the people's arms! worship, O Death, be paid to thee!

Let worship be to thy defence and to thine accusation paid. Death! be this worship paid to thy good-will and thy malevo- lence!

Worship to thy physicians, to thy sorcerers be worship paid! Death! let this reverence be done unto thy Brāhmans and thy roots.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 13 · Homage to death - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा Homage to death की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [Homage to death स्तुति]: Worship to weapons of the Gods! worship to weapons of the Kings! Then worship to the people's arms! worship, O Death, be paid to thee!

2. [Homage to death स्तुति]: Let worship be to thy defence and to thine accusation paid. Death! be this worship paid to thy good-will and thy malevo- lence!

3. [Homage to death स्तुति]: Worship to thy physicians, to thy sorcerers be worship paid! Death! let this reverence be done unto thy Brāhmans and thy roots.

title: Sukta 14 · A charm against consumption
deity: A charm against consumption
text:
बलासनाशनम्।
१-३ बभ्रुपिङ्गलः। बलासः। अनुष्टुप्।
अ॒स्थि॒स्रं॒सं प॑रुस्रं॒समास्थि॑तं हृदयाम॒यम्।
ब॒लासं॒ सर्वं॑ नाशयाङ्गे॒ष्ठा यश्च॒ पर्व॑सु ॥१॥
निर्ब॒लासं॑ बला॒सिनः॑ क्षि॒णोमि॑ मुष्क॒रं य॑था ।
छि॒नद्म्य॑स्य॒ बन्ध॑नं॒ मूल॑मुर्वा॒र्वा इ॑व ॥२॥
निर्ब॑लासे॒तः प्र प॑ताशु॒ङ्गः शि॑शु॒को य॑था ।
अथो॒ इट॑ इव हाय॒नोप॑ द्रा॒ह्यवी॑रहा ॥३॥
translation_en:
Remove thou all Decline that lurks within the members and the joints, The firmly-settled heart-disease that racks the bones and rends the limbs.

From the consumptive man I pluck Decline as 'twere a severed part. I cut the bond that fetters him, even as a root of cucumber.

Begone, Consumption, hence away, like a young foal that runs. at speed. Then, not pernicious to our men, flee, yearly visitant like grass!
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 14 · A charm against consumption - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm against consumption की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm against consumption स्तुति]: Remove thou all Decline that lurks within the members and the joints, The firmly-settled heart-disease that racks the bones and rends the limbs.

2. [A charm against consumption स्तुति]: From the consumptive man I pluck Decline as 'twere a severed part. I cut the bond that fetters him, even as a root of cucumber.

3. [A charm against consumption स्तुति]: Begone, Consumption, hence away, like a young foal that runs. at speed. Then, not pernicious to our men, flee, yearly visitant like grass!

title: Sukta 15 · A charm for power and preeminence
deity: A charm for power and preeminence
text:
शत्रुनिवारणम्।
१-३ उद्दालकः। वनस्पतिः। अनुष्टुप्।
उ॒त्त॒मो अ॒स्योष॑धीनां॒ तव॑ वृ॒क्षा उ॑प॒स्तयः॑ ।
उ॒प॒स्तिर॑स्तु सो॒३स्माकं॒ यो अ॒स्मां अ॑भि॒दास॑ति ॥१॥
सब॑न्धु॒श्चास॑बन्धुश्च॒ यो अ॒स्मां अ॑भि॒दास॑ति ।
तेषां॒ सा वृ॒क्षाणा॑मिवा॒हं भू॑यासमुत्त॒मः ॥२॥
यथा॒ सोम॒ ओष॑धीनामुत्त॒मो ह॒विषां॑ कृ॒तः ।
त॒लाशा॑ वृ॒क्षाणा॑मिवा॒हं भू॑यासमुत्त॒मः ॥३॥
translation_en:
Most excellent of all the plants art thou: thy vassals are the trees. Let him be subject to our power, the man who seeks to injure us.

Whoever seeks to injure us, with kinsmen or no kin to aid, May I be uppermost of all, even as this Plant is queen of trees.

As Soma hath been made the best of all oblations 'mid the plants, So, as Talāsā is the queen of trees, may I be chief of all.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 15 · A charm for power and preeminence - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm for power and preeminence की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm for power and preeminence स्तुति]: Most excellent of all the plants art thou: thy vassals are the trees. Let him be subject to our power, the man who seeks to injure us.

2. [A charm for power and preeminence स्तुति]: Whoever seeks to injure us, with kinsmen or no kin to aid, May I be uppermost of all, even as this Plant is queen of trees.

3. [A charm for power and preeminence स्तुति]: As Soma hath been made the best of all oblations 'mid the plants, So, as Talāsā is the queen of trees, may I be chief of all.

title: Sukta 16 · A medical charm
deity: A medical charm
text:
अक्षिरोगभैषजम्।
१-४ शौनकः। चन्द्रमाः, मन्त्रोक्तदेवताः, अनुष्टुप्, १ निचृत्त्रिपदा गायत्री,
३ बृहतीगर्भा ककुम्मत्यनुष्टुप्, ४ त्रिपदा प्रतिष्ठा।
आब॑यो॒ अना॑बयो॒ रस॑स्त उ॒ग्र आ॑बयो ।
आ ते॑ कर॒म्भम॑द्मसि ॥१॥
वि॒हह्लो॒ नाम॑ ते पि॒ता म॒दाव॑ती॒ नाम॑ ते मा॒ता।
स हि॑न॒ त्वम॑सि॒ यस्त्वमा॒त्मान॒माव॑यः ॥२॥
तौवि॑लि॒केऽवे॑ल॒यावा॒यमै॑ल॒ब ऐ॑लयीत्।
ब॒भ्रुश्च॑ ब॒भ्रुक॑र्ण॒श्चापे॑हि॒ निरा॑ल ॥३॥
अ॒ल॒साला॑सि॒ पूर्व॑ सि॒लाञ्जा॑ला॒स्युत्त॑रा ।
नी॒ला॒ग॒ल॒साला॑ ॥४॥
translation_en:
O Ābayu, non-Ābayu, dire is thy juice, O Ābayu; we eat the gruel made of thee.

Vihalha is thy father's name, thy mother's is Madāvati. Yea, verily thou art not he, thou who hast well protected life.

Go thou to rest, Tauvilikā! This noisy cry hath sunk to rest. Go hence, depart, Nirāla, thou! the tawny and the tawny- eared.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 16 · A medical charm - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A medical charm की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A medical charm स्तुति]: O Ābayu, non-Ābayu, dire is thy juice, O Ābayu; we eat the gruel made of thee.

2. [A medical charm स्तुति]: Vihalha is thy father's name, thy mother's is Madāvati. Yea, verily thou art not he, thou who hast well protected life.

3. [A medical charm स्तुति]: Go thou to rest, Tauvilikā! This noisy cry hath sunk to rest. Go hence, depart, Nirāla, thou! the tawny and the tawny- eared.

title: Sukta 17 · A charm to ensure conception
deity: A charm to ensure conception
text:
गर्भदृंहणम्।
१-४ अथर्वा। गर्भदृंहणम्, पृथिवि। अनुष्टुप्।
यथे॒यं पृ॑थि॒वी म॒ही भू॒तानां॒ गर्भ॑माद॒धे।
ए॒वा ते॑ ध्रियतां॒ गर्भो॒ अनु॒ सूतुं॒ सवि॑तवे ॥१॥
यथे॒यं पृ॑थि॒वी म॒ही दा॒धारे॒मान् वन॒स्पती॑न्।
ए॒वा ते॑ ध्रियतां॒ गर्भो॒ अनु॒ सूतुं॒ सवि॑तवे ॥२॥
यथे॒यं पृ॑थि॒वी म॒ही दा॒धार॒ पर्व॑तान् गि॒रीन्।
ए॒वा ते॑ ध्रियतां॒ गर्भो॒ अनु॒ सूतुं॒ सवि॑तवे ॥३॥
यथे॒यं पृ॑थि॒वी म॒ही दा॒धार॒ विष्ठि॑तं॒ जग॑त्।
ए॒वा ते॑ ध्रियतां॒ गर्भो॒ अनु॒ सूतुं॒ सवि॑तवे ॥४॥
translation_en:
Even as this mighty Earth conceived the germ of all the things that be, So may the germ of life be laid in thee that thou mayst bear a son.

Even as this mighty Earth hath borne and bears the stately forest trees, So may the germ of life be borne in thee that thou mayst bear a son.

Even as this mighty Earth hath borne and bears the mountains and the hills, So may the germ of life be borne in thee that thou mayst bear a son.

Even as this mighty Earth supports the moving world that dwells thereon, So may the germ of life be borne in thee that thou mayst bear a son.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 17 · A charm to ensure conception - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to ensure conception की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to ensure conception स्तुति]: Even as this mighty Earth conceived the germ of all the things that be, So may the germ of life be laid in thee that thou mayst bear a son.

2. [A charm to ensure conception स्तुति]: Even as this mighty Earth hath borne and bears the stately forest trees, So may the germ of life be borne in thee that thou mayst bear a son.

3. [A charm to ensure conception स्तुति]: Even as this mighty Earth hath borne and bears the mountains and the hills, So may the germ of life be borne in thee that thou mayst bear a son.

4. [A charm to ensure conception स्तुति]: Even as this mighty Earth supports the moving world that dwells thereon, So may the germ of life be borne in thee that thou mayst bear a son.

title: Sukta 18 · A charm to banish jealousy
deity: A charm to banish jealousy
text:
ईर्ष्याविनाशनम्।
१-३ अथर्वा। ईर्ष्याविनाशनम्। अनुष्टुप्।
ई॒र्ष्याया॒ ध्राजिं॑ प्रथ॒मां प्र॑थ॒मस्या॑ उ॒ताप॑राम्।
अ॒ग्निं हृ॑द॒य्यं॑१ शोकं॒ तं ते॒ निर्वा॑पयामसि ॥१॥
यथा॒ भूमि॑र्मृ॒तम॑ना मृ॒तान्मृ॒तम॑नस्तरा ।
यथो॒त म॒म्रुषो॒ मन॑ ए॒वेर्ष्योर्मृ॒तं मनः॑ ॥२॥
अ॒दो यत् ते हृ॒दि श्रि॒तं म॑न॒स्कं प॑तयिष्णु॒कम्।
तत॑स्त ई॒र्ष्यां मु॑ञ्चामि॒ निरू॒ष्माणं॒ दृते॑रिव ॥३॥
translation_en:
The first approach of Jealousy, and that which followeth the first, The pain, the fire that burns within thy heart we quench and drive away.

Even as the earth is dead to sense, yea, more unconscious than the dead, Even as a corpse's spirit is the spirit of the jealous man.

The thought that harbours in thy heart, the fluttering doubt that dwells therein. Yea, all thy jealousy, like heat born of the dance, I banish thence.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 18 · A charm to banish jealousy - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to banish jealousy की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to banish jealousy स्तुति]: The first approach of Jealousy, and that which followeth the first, The pain, the fire that burns within thy heart we quench and drive away.

2. [A charm to banish jealousy स्तुति]: Even as the earth is dead to sense, yea, more unconscious than the dead, Even as a corpse's spirit is the spirit of the jealous man.

3. [A charm to banish jealousy स्तुति]: The thought that harbours in thy heart, the fluttering doubt that dwells therein. Yea, all thy jealousy, like heat born of the dance, I banish thence.

title: Sukta 19 · A prayer for purification
deity: A prayer for purification
text:
पावमानम्।
१-३ शन्तातिः। चन्द्रमाः, १ देवजनाः, मनवः विश्वा भूतानि, पवमानः, २ पवमानः, ३ सविता। गायत्री, १ अनुष्टुप्।
पु॒नन्तु॑ मा देवज॒नाः पु॒नन्तु॒ मन॑वो धि॒या।
पु॒नन्तु॒ विश्वा॑ भू॒तानि॒ पव॑मानः पुनातु मा ॥१॥
पव॑मानः पुनातु मा॒ क्रत्वे॒ दक्षा॑य जी॒वसे॑ ।
अथो॑ अरि॒ष्टता॑तये ॥२॥
उ॒भाभ्यां॑ देव सवितः प॒वित्रे॑ण स॒वेन॑ च ।
अ॒स्मान् पु॑नीहि॒ चक्ष॑से ॥३॥
translation_en:
Let the Gods purify me, let men purify me with a prayer. Cleanse me all creatures that exist! may Pavamāna make me pure.

May Pavamāna make me pure for wisdom and for power and life, and unassailed security.

God Savitar, byboth of these, filter and pressing out this juice, purify us that we may see.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 19 · A prayer for purification - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for purification की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for purification स्तुति]: Let the Gods purify me, let men purify me with a prayer. Cleanse me all creatures that exist! may Pavamāna make me pure.

2. [A prayer for purification स्तुति]: May Pavamāna make me pure for wisdom and for power and life, and unassailed security.

3. [A prayer for purification स्तुति]: God Savitar, byboth of these, filter and pressing out this juice, purify us that we may see.

title: Sukta 20 · A charm against fever
deity: A charm against fever
text:
यक्ष्मनाशनम्।
१-३ भृग्वङ्गिराः। यक्ष्मनाशनम्। १ अतिजगती, २ ककुम्मतीप्रस्तारपङ्क्तिः, ३ सतः पङ्क्तिः।
अ॒ग्नेरि॑वास्य॒ दह॑त एति शु॒ष्मिण॑ उ॒तेव॑ म॒त्तो वि॒लप॒न्नपा॑यति ।
अ॒न्यम॒स्मदि॑च्छतु॒ कं चि॑दव्र॒तस्तपु॑र्वधाय॒ नमो॑ अस्तु त॒क्मने॑ ॥१॥
नमो॑ रु॒द्राय॒ नमो॑ अस्तु त॒क्मने॒ नमो॒ राज्ञे॒ वरु॑णाय॒ त्विषी॑मते ।
नमो॑ दि॒वे नमः॑ पृथि॒व्यै नम॒ ओष॑धीभ्यः ॥२॥
अ॒यं यो अ॑भिशोचयि॒ष्णुर्विश्वा॑ रू॒पाणि॒ हरि॑ता कृ॒णोषि॑ ।
तस्मै॑ तेऽरु॒णाय॑ ब॒भ्रवे॒ नमः॑ कृणोमि॒ वन्या॑य त॒क्मने॑ ॥३॥
translation_en:
He goes away as 'twere from this fierce burning fire, inebriated and lamenting he departs. Let him, the lawless, seek another and not us. Worship be paid to Fever armed with fiery heat.

To Rudra and to Fever be our worship paid: worship be paid to Varuna the splendid King! Worship to Dyaus, to Earth, worship be paid to Plants!

Thou who, aglow with heat, makest all bodies green, to thee, red, brown, I bow, the Fever of the wood.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 20 · A charm against fever - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm against fever की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm against fever स्तुति]: He goes away as 'twere from this fierce burning fire, inebriated and lamenting he departs. Let him, the lawless, seek another and not us. Worship be paid to Fever armed with fiery heat.

2. [A charm against fever स्तुति]: To Rudra and to Fever be our worship paid: worship be paid to Varuna the splendid King! Worship to Dyaus, to Earth, worship be paid to Plants!

3. [A charm against fever स्तुति]: Thou who, aglow with heat, makest all bodies green, to thee, red, brown, I bow, the Fever of the wood.

title: Sukta 21 · A charm to strengthen hair and promote its growth
deity: A charm to strengthen hair and promote its growth
text:
केशवर्धनी औषधिः।
१-३ शन्तातिः। चन्द्रमाः। अनुष्टुप्।
इ॒मा यास्ति॒स्रः पृ॑थि॒वीस्तासां॑ ह॒ भूमि॑रुत्त॒मा।
तासा॒मधि॑ त्व॒चो अ॒हं भे॑ष॒जं समु॑ जग्रभम्॥१॥
श्रेष्ठ॑मसि भेष॒जानां॒ वसि॑ष्ठं॒ वीरु॑धानाम्।
सोमो॒ भग॑ इव॒ यामे॑षु॒ दे॒वेषु॒ वरु॑णो॒ यथा॑ ॥२॥
रेव॑ती॒रना॑धृषः सिषा॒सवः॑ सिषासथ ।
उ॒त स्थ के॑श॒दृंह॑णी॒रथो॑ ह केश॒वर्ध॑नीः ॥३॥
translation_en:
Of all the three terrestrial realms the ground is verily the best. I from the skin that covers these gather a healing medicine.

Thou art the best of medicines, most excellent of Plants art thou, As Soma 'mid the wandering stars, as Varuna among the Gods.

Endowed with wealth, denying not, give freely fain to give your gifts! Ye stay the hair from falling off: ye strengthen and increase its growth.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 21 · A charm to strengthen hair and promote its growth - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to strengthen hair and promote its growth की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to strengthen hair and promote its growth स्तुति]: Of all the three terrestrial realms the ground is verily the best. I from the skin that covers these gather a healing medicine.

2. [A charm to strengthen hair and promote its growth स्तुति]: Thou art the best of medicines, most excellent of Plants art thou, As Soma 'mid the wandering stars, as Varuna among the Gods.

3. [A charm to strengthen hair and promote its growth स्तुति]: Endowed with wealth, denying not, give freely fain to give your gifts! Ye stay the hair from falling off: ye strengthen and increase its growth.

title: Sukta 22 · To the Maruts or Storm-Gods
deity: To the Maruts or Storm-Gods
text:
भैषज्यम्।
१-३ शन्तातिः। १ आदित्यरश्मिः, २-३ मरुतः। त्रिष्टुप्, २ चतुष्पदा भुरिग्जगती।
कृ॒ष्णं नि॒यानं॒ हर॑यः सुप॒र्णा अ॒पो वसा॑ना॒ दिव॒मुत् प॑तन्ति ।
त आव॑वृत्र॒न्त्सद॑नादृ॒तस्यादिद् घृ॒तेन॑ पृथि॒वीं व्यूऽदुः ॥१॥
पय॑स्वतीः कृणुथा॒प ओष॑धीः शि॒वा यदेज॑था मरुतो रुक्मवक्षसः ।
ऊर्जं॑ च॒ तत्र॑ सुम॒तिं च॑ पिन्वत॒ यत्रा॑ नरो मरुतः सि॒ञ्चथा॒ मधु॑ ॥२॥
उ॒द॒प्रुतो॑ म॒रुत॒स्तां इ॑यर्त वृ॒ष्टिर्या विश्वा॑ नि॒वत॑स्पृ॒णाति॑ ।
एजा॑ति॒ ग्लहा॑ क॒न्येऽव तु॒न्नैरुं॑ तुन्दा॒ना पत्ये॑व जा॒या॥३॥
translation_en:
Dark the descent; the strong-winged birds are golden: they fly aloft to heaven, enrobed in waters. They have come hither from the seat of Order, and inundated earth with streams of fatness.

Ye make floods rich in milk, make plants propitious, what time ye stir, O golden-breasted Maruts! Pour down your showers of vigorous strength and favour there where ye sprinkle mead, O Maruts, heroes!

O Maruts, send ye down, streaming with water rain which, may, filling all the sloping valleys, Leap like a bold girl in a man's embraces, or like a matron tumbled by her husband.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 22 · To the Maruts or Storm-Gods - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा To the Maruts or Storm-Gods की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [To the Maruts or Storm-Gods स्तुति]: Dark the descent; the strong-winged birds are golden: they fly aloft to heaven, enrobed in waters. They have come hither from the seat of Order, and inundated earth with streams of fatness.

2. [To the Maruts or Storm-Gods स्तुति]: Ye make floods rich in milk, make plants propitious, what time ye stir, O golden-breasted Maruts! Pour down your showers of vigorous strength and favour there where ye sprinkle mead, O Maruts, heroes!

3. [To the Maruts or Storm-Gods स्तुति]: O Maruts, send ye down, streaming with water rain which, may, filling all the sloping valleys, Leap like a bold girl in a man's embraces, or like a matron tumbled by her husband.

title: Sukta 23 · To the Waters
deity: To the Waters
text:
अपां भैषज्यम्।
१-३ शन्तातिः। आपः। १ अनुष्टुप्, २ त्रिपदा गायत्री, ३ परोष्णिक्।
स॒स्रुषी॒स्तद॒पसो॒ दिवा॒ नक्तं॑ च स॒स्रुषीः॑ ।
वरे॑ण्यक्रतुर॒हम॒पो दे॒वीरुप॑ ह्वये ॥१॥
ओता॒ आपः॑ कर्म॒ण्याऽमु॒ञ्चन्त्वि॒तः प्रणी॑तये ।
स॒द्यः कृ॑ण्व॒न्त्वेत॑वे ॥२॥
दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुः स॒वे कर्म॑ कृण्वन्तु॒ मानु॑षाः ।
शं नो॑ भवन्त्व॒प ओष॑धीः शि॒वाः ॥३॥
translation_en:
Here flow the restless ones, they flow unceasing through the day and night, Most excellently wise I call the Goddess Waters hitherward.

Let the deft Waters, summoned, give permission that we bear them off, And quickly set us on our way.

Let all the people celebrate the rite of Savitar the God. Sweet unto us be Waters, Plants propitious!
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 23 · To the Waters - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा To the Waters की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [To the Waters स्तुति]: Here flow the restless ones, they flow unceasing through the day and night, Most excellently wise I call the Goddess Waters hitherward.

2. [To the Waters स्तुति]: Let the deft Waters, summoned, give permission that we bear them off, And quickly set us on our way.

3. [To the Waters स्तुति]: Let all the people celebrate the rite of Savitar the God. Sweet unto us be Waters, Plants propitious!

title: Sukta 24 · To the Rivers
deity: To the Rivers
text:
अपां भैषज्यम्।
१-३ शन्तातिः। आपः। अनुष्टुप्।
हि॒मव॑तः॒ प्र स्र॑वन्ति॒ सिन्धौ॑ समह सङ्ग॒मः ।
आपो॑ ह मह्यं॒ तद् दे॒वीर्दद॑न् हृद्द्योतभेष॒जम्॥१॥
यन्मे॑ अ॒क्ष्योरा॑दि॒द्योत॒ पार्ष्ण्योः॒ प्रप॑दोश्च॒ यत्।
आप॒स्तत् सर्वं॒ निष्क॑रन् भि॒षजां॒ सुभि॑षक्तमाः ॥२॥
सिन्धु॑पत्नीः॒ सिन्धु॑राज्ञीः॒ सर्वा॒ या न॒द्य॑१स्थन॑ ।
द॒त्त न॒स्तस्य॑ भेष॒जं तेना॑ वो भुनजामहै ॥३॥
translation_en:
Forth from the Hills of Snow they stream, and meet in Sindhu here or there. To me the sacred Waters gave the balm that heals the heart's disease.

Whatever rupture I have had that injured eyes or heels or toes. All this the Waters, skilfullest physicians, shall make well again,

All Rivers who have Sindhu for your Lady, Sindhu for your Queen, Give us the balm that heals this ill: this boon let us enjoy from you.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 24 · To the Rivers - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा To the Rivers की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [To the Rivers स्तुति]: Forth from the Hills of Snow they stream, and meet in Sindhu here or there. To me the sacred Waters gave the balm that heals the heart's disease.

2. [To the Rivers स्तुति]: Whatever rupture I have had that injured eyes or heels or toes. All this the Waters, skilfullest physicians, shall make well again,

3. [To the Rivers स्तुति]: All Rivers who have Sindhu for your Lady, Sindhu for your Queen, Give us the balm that heals this ill: this boon let us enjoy from you.

title: Sukta 25 · A charm to remove pustules or scrofulous swellings (apachitas)
deity: A charm to remove pustules or scrofulous swellings (apachitas)
text:
मन्याविनाशनम्
१-३ शुनःशेपः। मन्याविनाशनम्। अनुष्टुप्।
पञ्च॑ च॒ याः प॑ञ्चा॒शच्च॑ सं॒यन्ति॒ मन्या॑ अ॒भि।
इ॒तस्ताः सर्वा॑ नश्यन्तु वा॒का अ॑प॒चिता॑मिव ॥१॥
स॒प्त च॒ याः स॑प्त॒तिश्च॑ सं॒यन्ति॒ ग्रैव्या॑ अ॒भि।
इ॒तस्ताः सर्वा॑ नश्यन्तु वा॒का अ॑प॒चिता॑मिव ॥२॥
नव॑ च॒ या न॑व॒तिश्च॑ सं॒यन्ति॒ स्कन्ध्या॑ अ॒भि।
इ॒तस्ताः सर्वा॑ नश्यन्तु वा॒का अ॑प॒चिता॑मिव ॥३॥
translation_en:
May all the five-and-fifty which meet round the tendons of the neck. Depart and vanish hence away like plaguing insects buzz and hum!

Those seventy-and-seven which meet round the upper vertebrae, Let them all vanish hence away like plaguing insects' buzz and hum!

Those nine-and-ninety which, combined, attack the shoulder round about, Let them all vanish hence away like plaguing insects' buzz and hum!
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 25 · A charm to remove pustules or scrofulous swellings (apachitas) - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to remove pustules or scrofulous swellings (apachitas) की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to remove pustules or scrofulous swellings (apachitas) स्तुति]: May all the five-and-fifty which meet round the tendons of the neck. Depart and vanish hence away like plaguing insects buzz and hum!

2. [A charm to remove pustules or scrofulous swellings (apachitas) स्तुति]: Those seventy-and-seven which meet round the upper vertebrae, Let them all vanish hence away like plaguing insects' buzz and hum!

3. [A charm to remove pustules or scrofulous swellings (apachitas) स्तुति]: Those nine-and-ninety which, combined, attack the shoulder round about, Let them all vanish hence away like plaguing insects' buzz and hum!

title: Sukta 26 · To Affliction
deity: To Affliction
text:
पाप्मनाशनम्।
१-३ ब्रह्म। पाप्मा। अनुष्टुप्।
अव॑ मा पाप्मन्त्सृज व॒शी सन् मृ॑डयासि नः ।
आ मा॑ भ॒द्रस्य॑ लो॒के पा॑प्मन् धे॒ह्यवि॑ह्रुतम्॥१॥
यो नः॑ पाप्म॒न् न जहा॑सि॒ तमु॑ त्वा जहिमो व॒यम्।
प॒थामनु॑ व्या॒वर्त॑ने॒ऽन्यं पा॒प्मानु॑ पद्यताम्॥२॥
अ॒न्यत्रा॒स्मन्न्युऽच्यतु सहस्रा॒क्षो अम॑र्त्यः ।
यं द्वेषा॑म॒ तमृ॑च्छतु॒ यमु॑ द्वि॒ष्मस्तमिज्ज॑हि ॥३॥
translation_en:
Let me go free, O Misery: do thou, the mighty, pity us. Set me uninjured in the world of happiness, O Misery.

From thee, from thee who fliest not from us, O Misery, we fly. Then at the turning of the paths let Misery fall on someone else.

May the immortal, thousand eyed, dwell otherwhere apart from us. Let him afflict the man we hate: smite only him who is our foe.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 26 · To Affliction - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा To Affliction की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [To Affliction स्तुति]: Let me go free, O Misery: do thou, the mighty, pity us. Set me uninjured in the world of happiness, O Misery.

2. [To Affliction स्तुति]: From thee, from thee who fliest not from us, O Misery, we fly. Then at the turning of the paths let Misery fall on someone else.

3. [To Affliction स्तुति]: May the immortal, thousand eyed, dwell otherwhere apart from us. Let him afflict the man we hate: smite only him who is our foe.

title: Sukta 27 · A charm to avert misfortune foreshown by the coming of a dove
deity: A charm to avert misfortune foreshown by the coming of a dove
text:
अरिष्टक्षयणम्।
१-३ भृगुः। यमः, निर्ऋतिः। जगती, २ त्रिष्टुप्।
देवाः॑ क॒पोत॑ इषि॒तो यदि॒छन् दू॒तो निरृ॑त्या इ॒दमा॑ज॒गाम॑ ।
तस्मा॑ अर्चाम कृ॒णवा॑म॒ निष्कृ॑तिं॒ शं नो अस्तु द्वि॒पदे॒ शं चतु॑ष्पदे ॥१॥
शि॒वः क॒पोत॒ इषि॒तो नो॑ अस्त्वना॒गा दे॑वाः शकु॒नो गृ॒हं नः॑ ।
अ॒ग्निर्हि विप्रो॑ जु॒षतां॑ ह॒विर्नः॒ परि॑ हे॒तिः प॒क्षिणी॑ नो वृणक्तु ॥२॥
हे॒तिः प॒क्षिणी॒ न द॑भात्य॒स्माना॒ष्ट्री प॒दं कृ॑णुते अग्नि॒धाने॑ ।
शि॒वो गोभ्य॑ उ॒त पुरु॑षेभ्यो नो अस्तु॒ मा नो॑ देवा इ॒ह हिं॑सीत् क॒पोतः॑ ॥३॥
translation_en:
Gods! whatsoe'er the Dove came hither seeking, sent to us as the envoy of Destruction, For that let us sing hymns and make atonement, Well be it with our quadrupeds and bipeds!

Auspicious be the Dove that hath been sent us, a harmless bird, O Gods, that seeks our dwelling! May Agni, Sage, be pleased with our oblation, and may the missile borne on wings avoid us.

Let not the arrow that hath wings distract us. Beside the fire- place, on the hearth it settles. May it bring welfare to our men and cattle: here let the Dove, ye Gods, forbear to harm us.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 27 · A charm to avert misfortune foreshown by the coming of a dove - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to avert misfortune foreshown by the coming of a dove की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to avert misfortune foreshown by the coming of a dove स्तुति]: Gods! whatsoe'er the Dove came hither seeking, sent to us as the envoy of Destruction, For that let us sing hymns and make atonement, Well be it with our quadrupeds and bipeds!

2. [A charm to avert misfortune foreshown by the coming of a dove स्तुति]: Auspicious be the Dove that hath been sent us, a harmless bird, O Gods, that seeks our dwelling! May Agni, Sage, be pleased with our oblation, and may the missile borne on wings avoid us.

3. [A charm to avert misfortune foreshown by the coming of a dove स्तुति]: Let not the arrow that hath wings distract us. Beside the fire- place, on the hearth it settles. May it bring welfare to our men and cattle: here let the Dove, ye Gods, forbear to harm us.

title: Sukta 28 · A charm to avert misfortune foreshown by the coming of a dove
deity: A charm to avert misfortune foreshown by the coming of a dove
text:
अरिष्टक्षयणम्।
१-३ भृगुः। यमः, निर्ऋतिः। १ त्रिष्टुप्, २ अनुष्टुप्, ३ जगती।
ऋ॒चा क॒पोतं॑ नुदत प्र॒णोद॒मिषं॒ मद॑न्तः॒ परि॒ गां न॑यामः ।
सं॒लो॒भय॑न्तो दुरि॒ता प॒दानि॑ हि॒त्वा न॒ ऊर्जं॒ प्र प॑दा॒त् पथि॑ष्ठः ॥१॥
परी॒मे॒३ग्निम॑र्षत॒ परी॒मे गाम॑नेषत ।
दे॒वेष्व॑क्रत॒ श्रवः॒ क इ॒माँ आ द॑धर्षति ॥२॥
यः प्र॑थ॒मः प्र॒वत॑मास॒साद॑ ब॒हुभ्यः॒ पन्था॑मनुपस्पशा॒नः ।
यो॒३स्येशे॑ द्वि॒पदो॒ यश्चतु॑ष्पद॒स्तस्मै॑ य॒माय॒ नमो॑ अस्तु मृ॒त्यवे॑ ॥३॥
translation_en:
Drive forth the Dove, chase it with holy verses: rejoicing bring we hither food and cattle, Obliterating traces of misfortune. Most fleet may it fly forth and leave us vigour.

These men have strengthened Agni's might, these men have brought the kine to us. They have sung glory to the Gods. Who is the man that con- quers them?

Be reverence paid to him who, while exploring the path for many, first approached the river, Lord of this world of quadrupeds and bipeds; to him be rever- ence paid, to Death, to Yama!
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 28 · A charm to avert misfortune foreshown by the coming of a dove - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to avert misfortune foreshown by the coming of a dove की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to avert misfortune foreshown by the coming of a dove स्तुति]: Drive forth the Dove, chase it with holy verses: rejoicing bring we hither food and cattle, Obliterating traces of misfortune. Most fleet may it fly forth and leave us vigour.

2. [A charm to avert misfortune foreshown by the coming of a dove स्तुति]: These men have strengthened Agni's might, these men have brought the kine to us. They have sung glory to the Gods. Who is the man that con- quers them?

3. [A charm to avert misfortune foreshown by the coming of a dove स्तुति]: Be reverence paid to him who, while exploring the path for many, first approached the river, Lord of this world of quadrupeds and bipeds; to him be rever- ence paid, to Death, to Yama!

title: Sukta 29 · A charm to avert misfortune foreshown by the coming of a dove and an owl
deity: A charm to avert misfortune foreshown by the coming of a dove and an owl
text:
अरिष्टक्षयणम्।
१-३ भृगुः। यमः, निर्ऋतिः। (बृहती) १-२ विराण्नाम गायत्री, ३ त्र्यवसाना सप्तपदा विराडष्टिः।
अ॒मून् हे॒तिः प॑त॒त्रिणी॒ न्येऽतु॒ यदुलू॑को॒ वद॑ति मो॒घमे॒तत्।
यद् वा॑ क॒पोत॑ प॒दम॒ग्नौ कृ॒णोति॑ ॥१॥
यौ ते॑ दू॒तौ नि॑रृत इ॒दमे॒तोऽप्र॑हितौ॒ प्रहि॑तौ वा गृ॒हं नः॑ ।
क॒पो॒तो॒लू॒काभ्या॒मप॑दं॒ तद॑स्तु ॥२॥
अ॒वै॒र॒ह॒त्याये॒दमा प॑पत्यात् सुवी॒रता॑या इ॒दमा स॑सद्यात्।
परा॑ङे॒व परा॑ वद॒ परा॑ची॒मनु॑ सं॒वत॑म्।
यथा॑ य॒मस्य॑ त्वा गृ॒हेऽर॒सं प्र॑ति॒चाक॑शाना॒भूकं॑ प्रति॒चाक॑शान्॥३॥
translation_en:
On these men yonder fall the winged missile: the screeching of the Owl is ineffective, And that the Dove beside the fire hath settled.

Thine envoys who came hither, O Destruction, sent or not sent by thee unto our dwelling, The Dove and Owl, effectless be their visit!

Oft may it fly to us to save our heroes from slaughter, oft perch here to bring fair offspring, Turn thee and send thy voice afar: cry to the region far away; That I may see thee in the home of Yama reft of all thy power, that I may see thee impotent.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 29 · A charm to avert misfortune foreshown by the coming of a dove and an owl - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to avert misfortune foreshown by the coming of a dove and an owl की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to avert misfortune foreshown by the coming of a dove and an owl स्तुति]: On these men yonder fall the winged missile: the screeching of the Owl is ineffective, And that the Dove beside the fire hath settled.

2. [A charm to avert misfortune foreshown by the coming of a dove and an owl स्तुति]: Thine envoys who came hither, O Destruction, sent or not sent by thee unto our dwelling, The Dove and Owl, effectless be their visit!

3. [A charm to avert misfortune foreshown by the coming of a dove and an owl स्तुति]: Oft may it fly to us to save our heroes from slaughter, oft perch here to bring fair offspring, Turn thee and send thy voice afar: cry to the region far away; That I may see thee in the home of Yama reft of all thy power, that I may see thee impotent.

title: Sukta 30 · A charm to promote the growth of hair
deity: A charm to promote the growth of hair
text:
पापशमनम्।
१-३ उपरिबभ्रवः। शमी। जगती, २ त्रिष्टुप्, ३ चतुष्पाच्छंकुमत्यनुष्टुप्।
दे॒वा इ॒मं मधु॑ना॒ संयु॑तं॒ यवं॒ सर॑स्वत्या॒मधि॑ म॒णाव॑चर्कृषुः ।
इन्द्र॑ आसी॒त् सीर॑पतिः श॒तक्र॑तुः की॒नाशा॑ आसन् म॒रुतः॑ सु॒दान॑वः ॥१॥
यस्ते॒ मदो॑ऽवके॒शो वि॑के॒शो येना॑भि॒हस्यं॒ पुरु॑षं कृ॒णोषि॑ ।
आ॒रात् त्वद॒न्या वना॑नि वृक्षि॒ त्वं श॑मि श॒तव॑ल्शा॒ वि रो॑ह ॥२॥
बृह॑त्पलाशे॒ सुभ॑गे॒ वर्ष॑वृद्ध॒ ऋता॑वरि ।
मा॒तेव॑ पु॒त्रेभ्यो॑ मृड॒ केशे॑भ्यः शमि ॥३॥
translation_en:
Over a magic stone, beside Sarasvati, the Gods Ploughed in this barley that was blent with mead. Lord of the plough was Indra, strong with hundred powers: the ploughers were the Maruts they who give rich gifts.

Thy joy in hair that falleth or is scattered, wherewith thou sub- jectest a man to laughter To other trees, far from thee will I drive it. Grow up, thou Samī, with a hundred branches.

Auspicious, bearing mighty leaves, holy one, nurtured by the rain, Even as a mother to her sons, be gracious, Samī to our hair.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 30 · A charm to promote the growth of hair - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to promote the growth of hair की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to promote the growth of hair स्तुति]: Over a magic stone, beside Sarasvati, the Gods Ploughed in this barley that was blent with mead. Lord of the plough was Indra, strong with hundred powers: the ploughers were the Maruts they who give rich gifts.

2. [A charm to promote the growth of hair स्तुति]: Thy joy in hair that falleth or is scattered, wherewith thou sub- jectest a man to laughter To other trees, far from thee will I drive it. Grow up, thou Samī, with a hundred branches.

3. [A charm to promote the growth of hair स्तुति]: Auspicious, bearing mighty leaves, holy one, nurtured by the rain, Even as a mother to her sons, be gracious, Samī to our hair.

title: Sukta 31 · To Sūrya the Sun-God
deity: To Sūrya the Sun-God
text:
गौः।
१-३ उपरिबभ्रवः। गौः। गायत्री।
आयं गौः पृश्नि॑रक्रमी॒दस॑दन्मा॒तरं॑ पु॒रः ।
पि॒तरं॑ च प्र॒यन्त्स्वः ॥१॥
अ॒न्तश्च॑रति रोच॒ना अ॒स्य प्रा॒णाद॑पान॒तः ।
व्यऽख्यन्महि॒षः स्वः ॥२॥
त्रिं॒शद् धामा॒ वि रा॑जति॒ वाक् प॑त॒ङ्गो अ॑शिश्रियत्।
प्रति॒ वस्तो॒रह॒र्द्युभिः॑ ॥३॥
translation_en:
This spotted Bull hath come and sat before his mother in the east. Advancing to his father Heaven.

As expiration from his breath his radiance penetrates within. The Bull shines out through all the sky.

He rules supreme through thirty realms—One winged with song hath made him mount Throughout the days at break of morn.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 31 · To Sūrya the Sun-God - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा To Sūrya the Sun-God की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [To Sūrya the Sun-God स्तुति]: This spotted Bull hath come and sat before his mother in the east. Advancing to his father Heaven.

2. [To Sūrya the Sun-God स्तुति]: As expiration from his breath his radiance penetrates within. The Bull shines out through all the sky.

3. [To Sūrya the Sun-God स्तुति]: He rules supreme through thirty realms—One winged with song hath made him mount Throughout the days at break of morn.

title: Sukta 32 · A charm against fiends and goblins
deity: A charm against fiends and goblins
text:
यातुधानक्षयणम्।
(१-३) १-२ चातनः, ३ अथर्वा। १ अग्निः, २ रुद्रः, ३ मित्रावरुणौ। त्रिष्टुप्, २ प्रस्तारपङ्क्तिः।
अ॒न्त॒र्दा॒वे जु॑हुता॒ स्वे॒३तद् या॑तुधान॒क्षय॑णं घृ॒तेन॑ ।
आ॒राद् रक्षां॑सि॒ प्रति॑ दह॒ त्वम॑ग्ने॒ न नो॑ गृ॒हाणा॒मुप॑ तीतपासि ॥१॥
रु॒द्रो वो॑ ग्री॒वा अश॑रैत् पिशाचाः पृ॒ष्टीर्वोऽपि॑ शृणातु यातुधानाः ।
वी॒रुद् वो॑ वि॒श्वतो॑वीर्या य॒मेन॒ सम॑जीगमत्॥२॥
अभ॑यं मित्रावरुणावि॒हास्तु॑ नो॒ऽर्चिषा॒त्त्रिणो॑ नुदतं प्र॒तीचः॑ ।
मा ज्ञा॒तारं॒ मा प्र॑ति॒ष्ठां वि॑दन्त मि॒थो वि॑घ्ना॒ना उप॑ यन्तु मृ॒त्युम्॥३॥
<
translation_en:
With butter, in his hall v4here fire is burning, perform that sacri- fice which quells the goblins. Burn from afar against the demons Agni! Afflict not in thy fury us who praise thee.

Let Rudra break your necks, O ye Pisāchas, and split your ribs asunder, Yātudhānas! Your herb of universal power with Yama hath allied itself.

Here, Mitra-Varuna! may we dwell safely: with splendour drive the greedy demons backward, Let them not find a surety or a refuge, but torn away go down to Death together.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 32 · A charm against fiends and goblins - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm against fiends and goblins की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm against fiends and goblins स्तुति]: With butter, in his hall v4here fire is burning, perform that sacri- fice which quells the goblins. Burn from afar against the demons Agni! Afflict not in thy fury us who praise thee.

2. [A charm against fiends and goblins स्तुति]: Let Rudra break your necks, O ye Pisāchas, and split your ribs asunder, Yātudhānas! Your herb of universal power with Yama hath allied itself.

3. [A charm against fiends and goblins स्तुति]: Here, Mitra-Varuna! may we dwell safely: with splendour drive the greedy demons backward, Let them not find a surety or a refuge, but torn away go down to Death together.

title: Sukta 33 · A prayer to Indra for riches
deity: A prayer to Indra for riches
text:
इन्द्रस्तवः।
१-३ जाटिकायनः। इन्द्रः। गायत्री, २ अनुष्टुप्।
यस्ये॒दमा रजो॒ युज॑स्तु॒जे जना॒ वनं॒ स्वः ।
इन्द्र॑स्य॒ रन्त्यं॑ बृ॒हत्॥१॥
नाधृ॑ष॒ आ द॑धृषते धृषा॒णो धृ॑षि॒तः शवः॑ ।
पु॒रा यथा॑ व्य॒थिः श्रव॒ इन्द्र॑स्य॒ नाधृ॑षे॒ शवः॑ ॥२॥
स नो॑ ददातु॒ तां र॒यिमु॒रुं पि॒शङ्ग॑संदृशम्।
इन्द्रः॒ पति॑स्तु॒विष्ट॑मो॒ जने॒ष्वा॥३॥
translation_en:
He who controls this air and men who aid his strength, and wood, and heaven, the lofty seat which Indra loves.

The bold whose overpowering might the boldest never hath defied,— As erst still, unassailable is Indra's wrath, and fame, and force.

May he bestow on us that wealth, far-spreading, bright with yellow hue. Indra is mightiest Lord among the folk.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 33 · A prayer to Indra for riches - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer to Indra for riches की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer to Indra for riches स्तुति]: He who controls this air and men who aid his strength, and wood, and heaven, the lofty seat which Indra loves.

2. [A prayer to Indra for riches स्तुति]: The bold whose overpowering might the boldest never hath defied,— As erst still, unassailable is Indra's wrath, and fame, and force.

3. [A prayer to Indra for riches स्तुति]: May he bestow on us that wealth, far-spreading, bright with yellow hue. Indra is mightiest Lord among the folk.

title: Sukta 34 · To Agni for protection from enemies
deity: To Agni for protection from enemies
text:
शत्रुनाशनम्।
१-५ चातनः। अग्निः। गायत्री।
प्राग्नये॒ वाच॑मीरय वृष॒भाय॑ क्षिती॒नाम्।
स नः॑ पर्ष॒दति॒ द्विषः॑ ॥१॥
यो रक्षां॑सि नि॒जूर्व॑त्य॒ग्निस्ति॒ग्मेन॑ शो॒चिषा॑ ।
स नः॑ पर्ष॒दति॒ द्विषः॑ ॥२॥
यः पर॑स्याः परा॒वत॑स्ति॒रो धन्वा॑ति॒रोच॑ते ।
स नः॑ पर्ष॒दति॒ द्विषः॑ ॥३॥
यो विश्वा॒भि वि॒पश्य॑ति॒ भुव॑ना॒ सं च॒ पश्य॑ति ।
स नः॑ पर्ष॒दति॒ द्विषः॑ ॥४॥
यो अ॒स्य पा॒रे रज॑सः शु॒क्रो अ॒ग्निरजा॑यत ।
स नः॑ पर्ष॒दति॒ द्विषः॑ ॥५॥
translation_en:
Send forth thy voice to Agni, to the manly hero of our homes, So may he bear us past our foes.

That Agni who with sharpened flame of fire consumes the Rākshasas, So may he bear us past our foes.

He who from distance far remote shineth across the tracts of land, May he transport us past our foes.

He who beholds all creatures, who observes them with a careful eye, May he transport us past our foes.

That brilliant Agni who was born beyond this region of the air, May he transport us past our foes!
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 34 · To Agni for protection from enemies - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा To Agni for protection from enemies की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [To Agni for protection from enemies स्तुति]: Send forth thy voice to Agni, to the manly hero of our homes, So may he bear us past our foes.

2. [To Agni for protection from enemies स्तुति]: That Agni who with sharpened flame of fire consumes the Rākshasas, So may he bear us past our foes.

3. [To Agni for protection from enemies स्तुति]: He who from distance far remote shineth across the tracts of land, May he transport us past our foes.

4. [To Agni for protection from enemies स्तुति]: He who beholds all creatures, who observes them with a careful eye, May he transport us past our foes.

5. [To Agni for protection from enemies स्तुति]: That brilliant Agni who was born beyond this region of the air, May he transport us past our foes!

title: Sukta 35 · To Agni Vaisvānara
deity: To Agni Vaisvānara
text:
वैश्वानरः।
१-३ कौशिकः। वैश्वानरः। गायत्री।
वै॒श्वा॒न॒रो न॑ ऊ॒तय॒ आ प्र या॑तु परा॒वतः॑ ।
अ॒ग्निर्नः॑ सुष्टु॒तीरुप॑ ॥१॥
वै॒श्वा॒न॒रो न आग॑मदि॒मं य॒ज्ञं स॒जूरुप॑ ।
अ॒ग्निरु॒क्थेष्वंह॑सु ॥२॥
वै॒श्वा॒न॒रोऽङ्गि॑रसां॒ स्तोम॑मु॒क्थं च॑ चाक्लृपत्।
ऐषु॑ द्यु॒म्नं स्वऽर्यमत्॥३॥
translation_en:
Forth from the distance far away Vaisvānara come to succour us! Agni approach our eulogies!

Vaisvānara with friendly thoughts hath come to this our sacrifice, Agni who saves from woe, to lauds.

Vaisvānara hath formed the hymn and laud of the Angirases. To these may he bring glorious right.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 35 · To Agni Vaisvānara - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा To Agni Vaisvānara की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [To Agni Vaisvānara स्तुति]: Forth from the distance far away Vaisvānara come to succour us! Agni approach our eulogies!

2. [To Agni Vaisvānara स्तुति]: Vaisvānara with friendly thoughts hath come to this our sacrifice, Agni who saves from woe, to lauds.

3. [To Agni Vaisvānara स्तुति]: Vaisvānara hath formed the hymn and laud of the Angirases. To these may he bring glorious right.

title: Sukta 36 · In praise of Agni Vaisvānara
deity: In praise of Agni Vaisvānara
text:
वैश्वानरः।
१-३ अथर्वा (स्वस्त्ययनकामः)। अग्निः। गायत्री।
वऋ॒तावा॑नं वैश्वान॒रमृ॒तस्य॒ ज्योति॑ष॒स्पति॑म्।
अज॑स्रं घ॒र्ममी॑महे ॥१॥
स विश्वा॑ प्रति॑ चाक्लृप ऋ॒तूंरुत् सृ॑जते व॒शी।
य॒ज्ञस्य॒ वय॑ उत्ति॒रन्॥२॥
अ॒ग्निः परे॑षु॒ धाम॑सु॒ कामो॑ भू॒तस्य॒ भव्य॑स्य ।
स॒म्राडेको॒ वि रा॑जति ॥३॥
translation_en:
Holy Vaisvānara we seek, the Lord of light and endless life, the burning One who fadeth not.

He hath directed all things; he sends forth the Seasons in his might, furthering sacrifice's power.

Agni Kāma in other homes shines forth the sole imperial Lord of all that is and is to be.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 36 · In praise of Agni Vaisvānara - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा In praise of Agni Vaisvānara की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [In praise of Agni Vaisvānara स्तुति]: Holy Vaisvānara we seek, the Lord of light and endless life, the burning One who fadeth not.

2. [In praise of Agni Vaisvānara स्तुति]: He hath directed all things; he sends forth the Seasons in his might, furthering sacrifice's power.

3. [In praise of Agni Vaisvānara स्तुति]: Agni Kāma in other homes shines forth the sole imperial Lord of all that is and is to be.

title: Sukta 37 · A charm to divert Imprecation personified
deity: A charm to divert Imprecation personified
text:
शापनाशनम्।
१-३ अथर्वा (स्वस्त्ययनकामः)। चन्द्रमाः। अनुष्टुप्।
उप॒ प्रागा॑त् सहस्रा॒क्षो यु॒क्त्वा श॒पथो॒ रथ॑म्।
श॒प्तार॑मन्वि॒छन् मम॒ वृक॑ इ॒वावि॑मतो गृ॒हम्॥१॥
परि॑ णो वृङ्ग्धि शपथ ह्र॒दम॒ग्निरि॑वा॒ दह॑न्।
श॒प्तार॒मत्र॑ नो जहि दि॒वो वृ॒क्षमि॑वा॒शनिः॑ ॥२॥
यो नः॒ शपा॒दश॑पतः॒ शप॑तो॒ यश्च॑ नः॒ शपा॑त्।
शुने॑ पेष्ट्र॑मि॒वाव॑क्षामं॒ तं प्रत्य॑स्यामि मृ॒त्यवे॑ ॥३॥
translation_en:
Hitherward, having yoked his steeds, came Imprecation, thousand-eyed, Seeking my curser, as a wolf the home of one who owneth sheep.

Avoid us, Imprecation! as consuming fire avoids the lake. Smite thou the man who curses us, as the sky's lightning strikes the tree.

Who curses us, himself uncursed, or, cursed, who curses us again, Him cast I as a sop to Death, as to a dog one throws a bone.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 37 · A charm to divert Imprecation personified - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to divert Imprecation personified की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to divert Imprecation personified स्तुति]: Hitherward, having yoked his steeds, came Imprecation, thousand-eyed, Seeking my curser, as a wolf the home of one who owneth sheep.

2. [A charm to divert Imprecation personified स्तुति]: Avoid us, Imprecation! as consuming fire avoids the lake. Smite thou the man who curses us, as the sky's lightning strikes the tree.

3. [A charm to divert Imprecation personified स्तुति]: Who curses us, himself uncursed, or, cursed, who curses us again, Him cast I as a sop to Death, as to a dog one throws a bone.

title: Sukta 38 · A prayer for surpassing strength and energy
deity: A prayer for surpassing strength and energy
text:
वर्चस्यम्।
१-४ अथर्वा (वर्चस्कामः)। त्विषिः। (बृहस्पतिः)। त्रिष्टुप्।
सिं॒हे व्या॒घ्र उ॒त या पृदा॑कौ॒ त्विषि॑र॒ग्नौ ब्रा॑ह्म॒णे सूर्ये॒ या।
इन्द्रं॒ या दे॒वी सु॒भगा॑ ज॒जान॒ सा न॒ ऐतु॒ वर्च॑सा संविदा॒ना॥१॥
या ह॒स्तिनि॑ द्वी॒पिनि॒ या हिर॑ण्ये॒ त्विषि॑र॒प्सु गोषु॒ या पुरु॑षेषु ।
इन्द्रं॒ या दे॒वी सु॒भगा॑ ज॒जान॒ सा न॒ ऐतु॒ वर्च॑सा संविदा॒ना॥२॥
रथे॑ अ॒क्षेष्वृ॑ष॒भस्य॒ वाजे॒ वाते॑ प॒र्जन्ये॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ शुष्मे॑ ।
इन्द्रं॒ या दे॒वी सु॒भगा॑ ज॒जान॒ सा न॒ ऐतु॒ वर्च॑सा संविदा॒ना॥३॥
रा॒ज॒न्येऽदुन्दु॒भावाय॑ताया॒मश्व॑स्य॒ वाजे॒ पुरु॑षस्य मा॒यौ।
इन्द्रं॒ या दे॒वी सु॒भगा॑ ज॒जान॒ सा न॒ ऐतु॒ वर्च॑सा संविदा॒ना॥४॥
translation_en:
What energy the lion hath, the tiger, adder, and burning fire, Brāhman, or Sūrya, And the blest Goddess who gave birth to Indra, come unto us conjoined with strength and vigour!

All energy of elephant and panther, all energy of gold, men, kine, and waters, And the blest Goddess who gave birth to Indra come unto us conjoined with strength and vigour.

Might in car, axles, in the strong bull's courage, in Varuna's breath, in Vāta, in Parjanya, In Warrior, in the war-drum stretched for battle, in the man's roar and in the horse's mettle, May the blest Goddess who gave birth to Indra come unto us conjoined with strength and vigour.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 38 · A prayer for surpassing strength and energy - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for surpassing strength and energy की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for surpassing strength and energy स्तुति]: What energy the lion hath, the tiger, adder, and burning fire, Brāhman, or Sūrya, And the blest Goddess who gave birth to Indra, come unto us conjoined with strength and vigour!

2. [A prayer for surpassing strength and energy स्तुति]: All energy of elephant and panther, all energy of gold, men, kine, and waters, And the blest Goddess who gave birth to Indra come unto us conjoined with strength and vigour.

3. [A prayer for surpassing strength and energy स्तुति]: Might in car, axles, in the strong bull's courage, in Varuna's breath, in Vāta, in Parjanya, In Warrior, in the war-drum stretched for battle, in the man's roar and in the horse's mettle, May the blest Goddess who gave birth to Indra come unto us conjoined with strength and vigour.

title: Sukta 39 · A priest's prayer for power and glory
deity: A priest's prayer for power and glory
text:
वर्चस्यम्।
१-३ अथर्वा (वर्चस्कामः)। (बृहस्पतिः), २ इन्द्रः, ३ इन्द्रः, अग्निः, सोमः,।
१ जगती, २ त्रिष्टुप्, ३ अनुष्टुप्।
यशो॑ ह॒विर्व॑र्धता॒मिन्द्र॑जूतं स॒हस्र॑वीर्यं॒ सुभृ॑तं॒ सह॑स्कृतम्।
प्र॒सर्स्रा॑ण॒मनु॑ दी॒र्घाय॒ चक्ष॑से ह॒विष्म॑न्तं मा वर्धय ज्ये॒ष्ठता॑तये ॥१॥
अच्छा॑ न॒ इन्द्रं॑ य॒शसं॒ यशो॑भिर्यश॒स्विनं॑ नमसा॒ना वि॑धेम ।
स नो॑ रास्व रा॒ष्ट्रमिन्द्र॑जूतं॒ तस्य॑ ते रा॒तौ य॒शसः॑ स्याम ॥२॥
य॒शा इन्द्रो॑ य॒शा अ॒ग्निर्य॒शाः सोमो॑ अजायत ।
य॒शा विश्व॑स्य भू॒तस्या॒हम॑स्मि य॒शस्त॑मः ॥३॥
translation_en:
Let sacrifice, like fame, thrive sped by Indra, inspired, well- ordered, with a thousand powers. To highest rank raise me who bring oblation, me who move forth to far-extended vision.

We will pay sacrifice and serve with worship our glorious Indra, famous for his glories. Give thou us sway which Indra hath promoted, and in this boon of thine may we be famous.

Indra was glorious at his birth; Agni, Soma were born renowned. And glorious am I, the most illustrious of all that is.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 39 · A priest's prayer for power and glory - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A priest's prayer for power and glory की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A priest's prayer for power and glory स्तुति]: Let sacrifice, like fame, thrive sped by Indra, inspired, well- ordered, with a thousand powers. To highest rank raise me who bring oblation, me who move forth to far-extended vision.

2. [A priest's prayer for power and glory स्तुति]: We will pay sacrifice and serve with worship our glorious Indra, famous for his glories. Give thou us sway which Indra hath promoted, and in this boon of thine may we be famous.

3. [A priest's prayer for power and glory स्तुति]: Indra was glorious at his birth; Agni, Soma were born renowned. And glorious am I, the most illustrious of all that is.

title: Sukta 40 · A prayer for peace and security
deity: A prayer for peace and security
text:
अभयम्।
१-३ अथर्वा। १ द्यावापृथिवी, सोमः, सविता, अन्तरिक्षं, सप्तऋषयः,
२ सविता इन्द्रः, ३ इन्द्रः। १-२ जगती, ३ अनुष्टुप्।
अभ॑यं द्यावापृथिवी इ॒हास्तु॒ नोऽभ॑यं॒ सोमः॑ सवि॒ता नः॑ कृणोतु ।
अभ॑यं नोऽस्तू॒र्व॑१न्तरि॑क्षं सप्तऋषी॒णां च॑ ह॒विषाभ॑यं नो अस्तु ॥१॥
अ॒स्मै ग्रामा॑य प्र॒दिश॒श्चत॑स्र॒ ऊर्जं॑ सुभू॒तं स्व॒स्ति स॑वि॒ता नः॑ कृणोतु ।
अ॒श॒त्र्विन्द्रो॒ अभ॑यं नः कृणोत्व॒न्यत्र॒ राज्ञा॑म॒भि या॑तु म॒न्युः ॥२॥
अ॒न॒मि॒त्रं नो॑ अध॒राद॑नमि॒त्रं न॑ उत्त॒रात्।
इन्द्रा॑नमि॒त्रं नः॑ प॒श्चाद॑नमि॒त्रं पु॒रस्कृ॑धि ॥३॥
translation_en:
Here may we dwell, O Heaven and Earth, in safety. May Savitar and Soma send us safety. Our safety be the wide air: ours be safety through the oblation of the Seven Rishis.

May the Four Quarters give this hamlet power: Savitar favour us and make us happy! May Indra make us free from foes and danger: may wrath of Kings be turned to other places.

Make thou us free from enemies both from below and from above. O Indra, give us perfect peace, peace from behind and from be- fore.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 40 · A prayer for peace and security - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for peace and security की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for peace and security स्तुति]: Here may we dwell, O Heaven and Earth, in safety. May Savitar and Soma send us safety. Our safety be the wide air: ours be safety through the oblation of the Seven Rishis.

2. [A prayer for peace and security स्तुति]: May the Four Quarters give this hamlet power: Savitar favour us and make us happy! May Indra make us free from foes and danger: may wrath of Kings be turned to other places.

3. [A prayer for peace and security स्तुति]: Make thou us free from enemies both from below and from above. O Indra, give us perfect peace, peace from behind and from be- fore.

title: Sukta 41 · A prayer for protection, long life, and various blessings
deity: A prayer for protection, long life, and various blessings
text:
दीर्घायुःप्राप्तिः।
१-३ ब्रह्म।१ चन्द्रमाः, २ सरस्वती, ३ दैव्या ऋषयः। १ भुरिक्, २ अनुष्टुप्, ३ त्रिष्टुप्।
मन॑से॒ चेत॑से धि॒य आकू॑तय उ॒त चित्त॑ये ।
म॒त्यै श्रु॒ताय॒ चक्ष॑से वि॒धेम॑ ह॒विषा॑ व॒यम्॥१॥
अ॒पा॒नाय॑ व्या॒नाय॑ प्रा॒णाय॒ भूरि॑धायसे ।
सर॑स्वत्या उरु॒व्यचे॑ वि॒धेम॑ ह॒विषा॑ व॒यम्॥२॥
मा नो॑ हासिषु॒र्ऋष॑यो॒ दैव्या॒ ये त॑नू॒पा ये न॑स्त॒न्वऽस्तनू॒जाः ।
अम॑र्त्या॒ मर्त्यां॑ अ॒भि नः॑ सचध्व॒मायु॑र्धत्त प्रत॒रं जी॒वसे॑ नः ॥३॥
translation_en:
For mind, for intellect, for thought, for purpose, for intelligence,. For sense, for hearing, and for sight, let us adore with sacrifice.

For expiration, vital air, and breath that amply nourishes, Let us with sacrifice adore Sarasvatī whose reach is wide.

Let not the Rishis, the divine, forsake us, our own, our very selves, our lives' protectors. Do ye, immortal, still attend us mortals, and give us vital power to live the longer.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 41 · A prayer for protection, long life, and various blessings - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for protection, long life, and various blessings की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for protection, long life, and various blessings स्तुति]: For mind, for intellect, for thought, for purpose, for intelligence,. For sense, for hearing, and for sight, let us adore with sacrifice.

2. [A prayer for protection, long life, and various blessings स्तुति]: For expiration, vital air, and breath that amply nourishes, Let us with sacrifice adore Sarasvatī whose reach is wide.

3. [A prayer for protection, long life, and various blessings स्तुति]: Let not the Rishis, the divine, forsake us, our own, our very selves, our lives' protectors. Do ye, immortal, still attend us mortals, and give us vital power to live the longer.

title: Sukta 42 · A charm to reconcile estranged friends
deity: A charm to reconcile estranged friends
text:
परस्परचित्तैकीकरणम्।
१-३ भृग्वङ्गिराः। (परस्परचित्तैकीकरणकामः)। मन्युः। १-२ भुरिक्,३ अनुष्टुप्।
अव॒ ज्यामि॑व॒ धन्व॑नो म॒न्युं त॑नोमि ते हृ॒दः ।
यथा॒ संम॑नसौ भू॒त्वा सखा॑याविव॒ सचा॑वहै ॥१॥
सखा॑याविव सचावहा॒ अव॑ म॒न्युं त॑नोमि ते ।
अ॒धस्ते॑ अश्म॑नो म॒न्युमुपा॑स्यामसि॒ यो गु॒रुः ॥२॥
अ॒भि ति॑ष्ठामि ते म॒न्युं पार्ष्ण्या॒ प्रप॑देन च ।
यथा॑व॒शो न वादि॑षो॒ मम॑ चि॒त्तमु॒पाय॑सि ॥३॥
translation_en:
I loose the anger from thy heart as 'twere the bowstring from a bow, That we, one-minded now, may walk together as familiar friends.

Together let us walk as friends: thy wrathful feeling I remove. Beneath a heavy stone we cast thy wrath away and bury it.

I trample on thine anger thus, I tread it down with heel and toe: So dost thou yield thee to my will, to speak no more rebelliously.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 42 · A charm to reconcile estranged friends - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to reconcile estranged friends की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to reconcile estranged friends स्तुति]: I loose the anger from thy heart as 'twere the bowstring from a bow, That we, one-minded now, may walk together as familiar friends.

2. [A charm to reconcile estranged friends स्तुति]: Together let us walk as friends: thy wrathful feeling I remove. Beneath a heavy stone we cast thy wrath away and bury it.

3. [A charm to reconcile estranged friends स्तुति]: I trample on thine anger thus, I tread it down with heel and toe: So dost thou yield thee to my will, to speak no more rebelliously.

title: Sukta 43 · The same
deity: The same
text:
मन्युशमनम्।
१-३ भृग्वङ्गिराः (परस्परचित्तैकीकरणकामः)। मन्युशमनम्। अनुष्टुप्।
अ॒यं द॒र्भो विम॑न्युकः॒ स्वाय॒ चार॑णाय च ।
म॒न्योर्विम॑न्युकस्या॒यं म॑न्यु॒शम॑न उच्यते ॥१॥
अ॒यं यो भूरि॑मूलः समु॒द्रम॑व॒तिष्ठ॑ति ।
द॒र्भः पृ॑थि॒व्या उत्थि॑तो मन्यु॒शम॑न उच्यते ॥२॥
वि ते॑ हन॒व्यां श॒रणिं॒ वि ते॒ मुख्यां॑ नयामसि ।
यथा॑व॒शो न वादि॑षो॒ मम॑ चि॒त्तमु॒पाय॑सि ॥३॥
translation_en:
For stranger and for friend alike this Darbha-grass removeth wrath. Soother of Anger is it called because it calms the angry man.

This Plant that hath abundant roots spreads to the place where waters meet. Soother of anger is the name Darbha-grass that springs from earth.

We draw thine obstinacy forth, set in thy mouth and in thy jaw: So dost thou yield thee to my will. to speak no more rebelli- ously.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 43 · The same - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा The same की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [The same स्तुति]: For stranger and for friend alike this Darbha-grass removeth wrath. Soother of Anger is it called because it calms the angry man.

2. [The same स्तुति]: This Plant that hath abundant roots spreads to the place where waters meet. Soother of anger is the name Darbha-grass that springs from earth.

3. [The same स्तुति]: We draw thine obstinacy forth, set in thy mouth and in thy jaw: So dost thou yield thee to my will. to speak no more rebelli- ously.

title: Sukta 44 · A charm to remove disease
deity: A charm to remove disease
text:
रोगनाशनम्।
१-३ विश्वामित्रः। वनस्पतिः। अनुष्टुप्, ३ त्रिपदा महाबृहती।
अस्था॒द् द्यौरस्था॑त् पृथि॒व्यस्था॒द् विश्व॑मि॒दं जग॑त्।
अस्थु॑र्वृ॒क्षा ऊ॒र्ध्वस्व॑प्ना॒स्तिष्ठा॒द् रोगो॑ अ॒यं तव॑ ॥१॥
श॒तं या भे॑ष॒जानि॑ ते स॒हस्रं॒ संग॑तानि च ।
श्रेष्ठ॑मास्रावभेष॒जं वसि॑ष्ठं रोग॒नाश॑नम्॥२॥
रु॒द्रस्य॒ मूत्र॑मस्य॒मृत॑स्य॒ नाभिः॑ ।
वि॒षा॒ण॒का नाम॒ वा अ॑सि पितॄ॒णां मूला॒दुत्थि॑ता वातीकृत॒नाश॑नी ॥३॥
translation_en:
Firm stood the heaven, firm stood the earth, firm stood this universal world. Firm stood the trees that sleep erect: let this thy malady be still.

Of all thy hundred remedies, a thousand remedies combined. This is the surest cure for flux, most excellent to heal disease.

Thou art the stream that Rudra pours, the closest kin of Amrita. Thy name is called Vishānakā: thou sprangest from the Fathers' root, removing illness caused by wind.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 44 · A charm to remove disease - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to remove disease की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to remove disease स्तुति]: Firm stood the heaven, firm stood the earth, firm stood this universal world. Firm stood the trees that sleep erect: let this thy malady be still.

2. [A charm to remove disease स्तुति]: Of all thy hundred remedies, a thousand remedies combined. This is the surest cure for flux, most excellent to heal disease.

3. [A charm to remove disease स्तुति]: Thou art the stream that Rudra pours, the closest kin of Amrita. Thy name is called Vishānakā: thou sprangest from the Fathers' root, removing illness caused by wind.

title: Sukta 45 · A prayer for preservation from mental sin and evil promptings
deity: A prayer for preservation from mental sin and evil promptings
text:
दुःष्वप्ननाशनम्।
१-३ अङ्गिराः प्रचेता, यमश्च। दुःष्वप्ननाशनम्। १ पथ्यापङ्क्तिः, २ भुरिक् त्रिष्टुप्, ३ अनुष्टुप्।
प॒रोऽपे॑हि मनस्पाप॒ किमश॑स्तानि शंससि ।
परे॑हि॒ न त्वा॑ कामये वृ॒क्षां वना॑नि॒ सं च॑र गृ॒हेषु॑ गोषु॑ मे॒ मनः॑ ॥१॥
अ॒व॒शसा॑ निः॒शसा॒ यत् प॑रा॒शसो॑पारि॒म जाग्र॑तो॒ यत् स्व॒पन्तः॑ ।
अ॒ग्निर्वि॑श्वा॒न्यप॑ दुष्कृ॒तान्यजु॑ष्टान्या॒रे अ॒स्मद् द॑धातु ॥२॥
यदि॑न्द्र ब्रह्मणस्प॒तेऽपि॒ मृषा॒ चरा॑मसि ।
प्रचे॑ता न आङ्गिर॒सो दु॑रि॒तात् पा॒त्वंह॑सः ॥३॥
translation_en:
Sin of the Mind, avaunt! begone! Why sayest thou what none should say? Go hence away, I love thee not. Go to the forests and the trees. My heart is in our homes and cows.

Whatever wrong we have committed, sleeping or waking, by ill-wish, dislike, or slander, All these offences, which deserve displeasure, may Agni take from us and keep them distant.

Indra and Brāhmanaspati! whatever foolish deed we plan, May provident Angirasa preserve us from the sin and woe.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 45 · A prayer for preservation from mental sin and evil promptings - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for preservation from mental sin and evil promptings की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for preservation from mental sin and evil promptings स्तुति]: Sin of the Mind, avaunt! begone! Why sayest thou what none should say? Go hence away, I love thee not. Go to the forests and the trees. My heart is in our homes and cows.

2. [A prayer for preservation from mental sin and evil promptings स्तुति]: Whatever wrong we have committed, sleeping or waking, by ill-wish, dislike, or slander, All these offences, which deserve displeasure, may Agni take from us and keep them distant.

3. [A prayer for preservation from mental sin and evil promptings स्तुति]: Indra and Brāhmanaspati! whatever foolish deed we plan, May provident Angirasa preserve us from the sin and woe.

title: Sukta 46 · A charm against evil dreams
deity: A charm against evil dreams
text:
दुःष्वप्ननाशनम्।
१-३ अङ्गिराः प्रचेता, यमश्च। दुःष्वप्ननाशनम्।१ विष्टारपङ्क्तिः, २ त्र्यवसाना शक्वरीगर्भा पञ्चपदा जगती, ३ अनुष्टुप्।
यो न जी॒वोऽसि॒ न मृ॒तो दे॒वाना॑ममृतग॒र्भोऽसि स्वप्न ।
व॒रु॒णा॒नी ते॑ मा॒ता य॒मः पि॒तार॑रु॒र्नामा॑सि ॥१॥
