वि॒द्म ते॑ स्वप्न ज॒नित्रं॑ देवजामी॒नां पु॒त्रोऽसि य॒मस्य॒ कर॑णः ।
अन्त॑कोऽसि मृ॒त्युर॑सि।
तं त्वा॑ स्वप्न॒ तथा॒ सं वि॑द्म॒ स नः॑ स्वप्न दु॒ष्वप्न्या॑त् पाहि ॥२॥
यथा॑ क॒लां यथा॑ श॒फं यथ॒र्णं सं॒नय॑न्ति ।
ए॒वा दु॒ष्वप्न्यं॒ सर्वं॑ द्विष॒ते सं न॑यामसि ॥३॥
translation_en:
Thou, neither quick nor dead, O Sleep, art fraught with Amrit of the Gods. Thy name is Araru: thy sire is Yama; Varunāni bare thee.

We know thy birth, O Sleep, thou art son of the sisters of the Gods; the minister of Yama thou, thou art Antaka, thou art Death. So well we know thee who thou art. Sleep, guard us from the evil dream.

As men discharge a debt, as they pay up an eighth and half-an- eighth, So the whole evil dream do we pay and assign unto our foe.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 46 · A charm against evil dreams - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm against evil dreams की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm against evil dreams स्तुति]: Thou, neither quick nor dead, O Sleep, art fraught with Amrit of the Gods. Thy name is Araru: thy sire is Yama; Varunāni bare thee.

2. [A charm against evil dreams स्तुति]: We know thy birth, O Sleep, thou art son of the sisters of the Gods; the minister of Yama thou, thou art Antaka, thou art Death. So well we know thee who thou art. Sleep, guard us from the evil dream.

3. [A charm against evil dreams स्तुति]: As men discharge a debt, as they pay up an eighth and half-an- eighth, So the whole evil dream do we pay and assign unto our foe.

title: Sukta 47 · To accompany the three daily libations
deity: To accompany the three daily libations
text:
दीर्घायुः प्राप्तिः।
१-३ अङ्गिराः प्रचेताः। १ अग्निः, २ विश्वे देवाः, ३ सुधन्वा। त्रिष्टुप्।
अ॒ग्निः प्रा॑तःसव॒ने पा॑त्व॒स्मान् वै॑श्वान॒रो वि॑श्व॒कृद् वि॒श्वशं॑भूः ।
स नः॑ पाव॒को द्रवि॑णे दधा॒त्वायु॑ष्मन्तः सहभ॑क्षाः स्याम ॥१॥
विश्वे॑ दे॒वा म॒रुत॒ इन्द्रो॑ अ॒स्मान॒स्मिन् द्वि॒तीये॒ सव॑ने॒ न ज॑ह्युः ।
आयु॑ष्मन्तः प्रि॒यमे॑षां॒ वद॑न्तो व॒यं दे॒वानां॑ सुम॒तौ स्या॑म ॥२॥
इ॒दं तृ॒तीयं॒ सव॑नं कवी॒नामृ॒तेन॒ ये च॑म॒समैर॑यन्त ।
ते सौ॑धन्व॒नाः स्वऽरानशा॒नाः स्विऽष्टिं नो अ॒भि वस्यो॑ नयन्तु ॥३॥
translation_en:
Dear to all men, all-prosperer, all-creating, may Agni, guard us• at the morn's libation. May he, the brightly pure one, give us riches: may we have life enjoying food together.

At this our second offering may Indra, Maruts, and Visve Devas never fail us. Still may the favour of the Gods be with us, blest with long life and speaking words that please them.

We pour this third libation of the Sages who fashioned forth the cup in proper order. Winners of heaven, may they, Sudhanvan's children, lead our fair sacrifice to happy fortune.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 47 · To accompany the three daily libations - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा To accompany the three daily libations की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [To accompany the three daily libations स्तुति]: Dear to all men, all-prosperer, all-creating, may Agni, guard us• at the morn's libation. May he, the brightly pure one, give us riches: may we have life enjoying food together.

2. [To accompany the three daily libations स्तुति]: At this our second offering may Indra, Maruts, and Visve Devas never fail us. Still may the favour of the Gods be with us, blest with long life and speaking words that please them.

3. [To accompany the three daily libations स्तुति]: We pour this third libation of the Sages who fashioned forth the cup in proper order. Winners of heaven, may they, Sudhanvan's children, lead our fair sacrifice to happy fortune.

title: Sukta 48 · Formulas to be used at the three daily libations
deity: Formulas to be used at the three daily libations
text:
स्वस्तिवाचनम्।
१-३ अङ्गिराः, प्रचेताः। १ श्येनः, २ ऋभुः, ३ वृषा। उष्णिक्।
श्ये॒नोऽसि गाय॒त्रच्छन्दा॒ अनु॒ त्वा र॑भे ।
स्व॒स्ति मा॒ सं व॑हा॒स्य य॒ज्ञस्यो॒दृचि॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥१॥
ऋ॒भुर॑सि॒ जग॑च्छन्दा॒ अनु॒ त्वा र॑भे ।
स्व॒स्ति मा॒ सं व॑हा॒स्य य॒ज्ञस्यो॒दृचि॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥२॥
वृषा॑सि त्रि॒ष्टुप्छ॑न्दा॒ अनु॒ त्वा र॑भे ।
स्व॒स्ति मा॒ सं व॑हा॒स्य य॒ज्ञस्यो॒दृचि॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥३॥
translation_en:
Thou art the Hawk, Gāyatri's lord: I hold thee fast. Happily bear me to the goal of this my sacrifice. All hail!

Thou art the Ribhu, lord of Jagatī: I hold thee fast. Happily bear me to the goal of this my sacrifice. Al I hail!

Thou art the Bull, the Trishtup's lord: I hold thee fast. Happily bear me to the goal of this my sacrifice. All hail!
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 48 · Formulas to be used at the three daily libations - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा Formulas to be used at the three daily libations की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [Formulas to be used at the three daily libations स्तुति]: Thou art the Hawk, Gāyatri's lord: I hold thee fast. Happily bear me to the goal of this my sacrifice. All hail!

2. [Formulas to be used at the three daily libations स्तुति]: Thou art the Ribhu, lord of Jagatī: I hold thee fast. Happily bear me to the goal of this my sacrifice. Al I hail!

3. [Formulas to be used at the three daily libations स्तुति]: Thou art the Bull, the Trishtup's lord: I hold thee fast. Happily bear me to the goal of this my sacrifice. All hail!

title: Sukta 49 · In praise of Agni
deity: In praise of Agni
text:
अग्निस्तवः।
१-३ गार्ग्यः। अग्निः। १ अनुष्टुप्, २ जगती, ३ विराड्जगती।
न॒हि ते॑ अग्ने त॒न्वः क्रू॒रमा॒नंश॒ मर्त्यः॑ ।
क॒पिर्ब॑भस्ति॒ तेज॑नं॒ स्वं ज॒रायु॒ गौरि॑व ॥१॥
मे॒ष इ॑व॒ वै सं च॒ वि चो॒र्व॒ऽच्यसे॒ यदु॑त्तर॒द्रावुप॑रश्च॒ खाद॑तः ।
शी॒र्ष्णा शिरोऽप्स॒साप्सो॑ अ॒र्दय॑न्नं॒शून् ब॑भस्ति॒ हरि॑तेभिरा॒सभिः॑ ॥२॥
सु॒प॒र्णा वाच॑मक्र॒तोप॒ द्यव्या॑ख॒रे कृष्णा॑ इषि॒रा अ॑नर्तिषुः ।
नि यन्नि॒यन्त्युप॑रस्य॒ निष्कृ॑तिं पु॒रू रेतो॑ दधिरे सूर्य॒श्रितः॑ ॥३॥
translation_en:
O Agni, in thy body man hath never found a wounded part. The Ape devours the arrow's shaft as a cow eats her after- birth.

Thou like a fleece contractest and expandest thee what time the upper stone and that below devour. Closely compressing head with head and breast with breast he crunches up the tendrils with his yellow jaws.

The Eagles have sent forth their voice aloud to heaven: in the sky's vault the dark impetuous ones have danced. When they come downward to repair the lower stone, they, dwellers with the Sun, have gained abundant seed.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 49 · In praise of Agni - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा In praise of Agni की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [In praise of Agni स्तुति]: O Agni, in thy body man hath never found a wounded part. The Ape devours the arrow's shaft as a cow eats her after- birth.

2. [In praise of Agni स्तुति]: Thou like a fleece contractest and expandest thee what time the upper stone and that below devour. Closely compressing head with head and breast with breast he crunches up the tendrils with his yellow jaws.

3. [In praise of Agni स्तुति]: The Eagles have sent forth their voice aloud to heaven: in the sky's vault the dark impetuous ones have danced. When they come downward to repair the lower stone, they, dwellers with the Sun, have gained abundant seed.

title: Sukta 50 · A charm for the destruction of vermin
deity: A charm for the destruction of vermin
text:
अभययाचना।
१-३ अथर्वा (अभयकामः)। अश्विनौ। १ विराड्जगती, २-३ पथ्यापङ्क्तिः।
ह॒तं त॒र्दं स॑म॒ङ्कमा॒खुमश्वि॑ना छि॒न्तं शिरो॒ अपि॑ पृ॒ष्टीः शृ॑णीतम्।
यवा॒न्नेददा॒नपि॑ नह्यतं॒ मुख॒मथाभ॑यं कृणुतं धा॒न्याऽय ॥१॥
तर्द॒ है पत॑ङ्ग॒ है जभ्य॒ हा उप॑क्वस ।
ब्र॒ह्मेवासं॑स्थितं ह॒विरन॑दन्त इ॒मान् यवा॒नहिं॑सन्तो अ॒पोदि॑त ॥२॥
तर्दा॑पते॒ वघा॑पते॒ तृष्ट॑जम्भा॒ आ शृ॑णोत मे ।
य आ॑र॒ण्या व्यऽद्व॒रा ये के च॒ स्थ व्यऽद्वरास्तान्त्सर्वा॑न् जम्भयामसि ॥३॥
translation_en:
Destroy the rat, the mole, the boring beetle, cut off their heads and crush their ribs, O Asvins. Bind fast their mouths; let them not eat our barley: so guard, ye twain, our growing corn from danger.

Ho! boring beetle, ho! thou worm, ho! noxious grub and grasshopper! As a priest leaves the unfinished sacrifice, go hence devouring not, injuring not this corn.

Hearken to me, lord of the female borer, lord of the female grub! ye rough-toothed vermin! Whate'er ye be, dwelling in woods, and piercing, we crush and mangle all those piercing insects.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 50 · A charm for the destruction of vermin - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm for the destruction of vermin की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm for the destruction of vermin स्तुति]: Destroy the rat, the mole, the boring beetle, cut off their heads and crush their ribs, O Asvins. Bind fast their mouths; let them not eat our barley: so guard, ye twain, our growing corn from danger.

2. [A charm for the destruction of vermin स्तुति]: Ho! boring beetle, ho! thou worm, ho! noxious grub and grasshopper! As a priest leaves the unfinished sacrifice, go hence devouring not, injuring not this corn.

3. [A charm for the destruction of vermin स्तुति]: Hearken to me, lord of the female borer, lord of the female grub! ye rough-toothed vermin! Whate'er ye be, dwelling in woods, and piercing, we crush and mangle all those piercing insects.

title: Sukta 51 · A prayer for purification and forgiveness of sins
deity: A prayer for purification and forgiveness of sins
text:
एनोनाशनम्।
१-३ शन्तातिः। आपः, ३ वरुणः। १ गायत्री, २ त्रिष्टुप्, ३ जगती।
वा॒योः पू॒तः प॒वित्रे॑ण प्र॒त्यङ् सोमो॒ अति॑ द्रु॒तः ।
इन्द्र॑स्य॒ युजः॒ सखा॑ ॥१॥
आपो॑ अ॒स्मान् मा॒तरः॑ सूदयन्तु घृ॒तेन॑ नो घृ॒तप्वः पुनन्तु ।
विश्वं॒ हि रि॒प्रं प्र॒वह॑न्ति दे॒वीरुदिदा॑भ्यः॒ शुचि॒रा पू॒त ए॑मि ॥२॥
यत् किं चे॒दं व॑रुण॒ दैव्ये॒ जने॑ऽभिद्रो॒हं म॑नु॒ष्या॒३श्चर॑न्ति ।
अचि॑त्त्या॒ चेत् तव॒ धर्मा॑ युयोपि॒म मा न॒स्तस्मा॒देन॑सो देव रीरिषः ॥३॥
translation_en:
Cleansed by the filter of the Wind comes Soma past all our enemies, meet friend of Indra.

May the maternal Waters make us ready: cleanse us with fat- ness they who cleanse with fatness! The Goddesses bear off each blot and tarnish: I come forth from the waters cleansed and stainless.

O Varuna, whatever the offence may be, the sin which men commit against the heavenly folk— When, through our want of thought we violate thy laws, punish us not, O God, for that iniquity.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 51 · A prayer for purification and forgiveness of sins - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for purification and forgiveness of sins की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for purification and forgiveness of sins स्तुति]: Cleansed by the filter of the Wind comes Soma past all our enemies, meet friend of Indra.

2. [A prayer for purification and forgiveness of sins स्तुति]: May the maternal Waters make us ready: cleanse us with fat- ness they who cleanse with fatness! The Goddesses bear off each blot and tarnish: I come forth from the waters cleansed and stainless.

3. [A prayer for purification and forgiveness of sins स्तुति]: O Varuna, whatever the offence may be, the sin which men commit against the heavenly folk— When, through our want of thought we violate thy laws, punish us not, O God, for that iniquity.

title: Sukta 52 · A charm against noxious reptiles and insects
deity: A charm against noxious reptiles and insects
text:
भैषज्यम्।
१-३ भागलिः। १ सूर्यः, २ गावः, ३ भेषजम्। अनुष्टुप्।
उत् सूर्यो॑ दि॒व ए॑ति पु॒रो रक्षां॑सि नि॒जूर्व॑न्।
आ॒दि॒त्यः पर्वतेभ्यो वि॒श्वदृ॑ष्टो अदृष्ट॒हा॥१॥
नि गावो॑ गो॒ष्ठे अ॑सद॒न् नि मृ॒गासो॑ अविक्षत ।
न्यू॒३र्मयो॑ न॒दीनं॒ न्य॑१दृष्टा॑ अलिप्सत ॥२॥
आ॒यु॒र्ददं॑ विप॒श्चितं॑ श्रु॒तां कण्व॑स्य वी॒रुध॑म्।
आभा॑रिषं वि॒श्वभे॑षजीम॒स्यादृष्टा॒न् नि श॑मयत्॥३॥
translation_en:
Slaying the Rākshasas, the Sun mounts upward in the front of heaven, Āditya, from the mountains, seen of all, destroying things unseen.

The kine had settled in their pen, wild animals sought their lairs The wavelets of the brooks had passed away, and were beheld no more.

I have brought Kanva's famous Plant, life-giving, and itself inspired, The medicine that healeth all: may it suppress my hidden foes.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 52 · A charm against noxious reptiles and insects - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm against noxious reptiles and insects की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm against noxious reptiles and insects स्तुति]: Slaying the Rākshasas, the Sun mounts upward in the front of heaven, Āditya, from the mountains, seen of all, destroying things unseen.

2. [A charm against noxious reptiles and insects स्तुति]: The kine had settled in their pen, wild animals sought their lairs The wavelets of the brooks had passed away, and were beheld no more.

3. [A charm against noxious reptiles and insects स्तुति]: I have brought Kanva's famous Plant, life-giving, and itself inspired, The medicine that healeth all: may it suppress my hidden foes.

title: Sukta 53 · A prayer for recovery and preservation of health and security
deity: A prayer for recovery and preservation of health and security
text:
सर्वतो रक्षणम्।
१-३ बृहच्छुक्रः। १ द्यौः, पृथिवि, शुक्रः, सोमः, अग्निः, वायुः, सविता,
१ भगः, २ वैश्वानरः, ३ त्वष्टा। त्रिष्टुप्, १ जगती।
द्यौश्च॑ म इ॒दं पृ॑थि॒वी च॒ प्रचे॑तसौ शु॒क्रो बृ॒हन् दक्षि॑णया पिपर्तु ।
अनु॑ स्व॒धा चि॑कितां॒ सोमो॑ अ॒ग्निर्वा॒युर्नः॑ पातु सवि॒ता भग॑श्च ॥१॥
पुनः॑ प्रा॒णः पुन॑रा॒त्मा न॒ ऐतु॒ पुन॒श्चक्षुः॒ पुन॒रसु॑र्न॒ ऐतु॑ ।
वै॒श्वा॒न॒रो नो॒ अद॑ब्धस्तनू॒पा अ॒न्तस्ति॑ष्ठाति दुरि॒तानि॒ विश्वा॑ ॥२॥
सं वर्च॑सा॒ पय॑सा॒ सं त॒नूभि॒रग॑न्महि॒ मन॑सा॒ सं शि॒वेन॑ ।
त्वष्टा॑ नो॒ अत्र॒ वरी॑यः कृणो॒त्वनु॑ नो मार्ष्टु त॒न्वो॒३यद् विरि॑ष्टम्॥३॥
translation_en:
May Heaven and Earth, wise pair, may lofty Sukra grant me this thing by reason of the guerdon. May Agni, Soma mark through this libation: may Vāyu, Savitar, and Bhaga guard us.

Again return to us our breath and spirit, again come back to us our life and vision! Vaisvānara, unscathed, our bodies' guardian, stand between us and every woe and danger!

We are again united with our bodies, with happy mind, with spirit, strength, and splendour. May Tvashtar here make room for us, and freedom and smooth whate'er is injured in our bodies.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 53 · A prayer for recovery and preservation of health and security - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for recovery and preservation of health and security की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for recovery and preservation of health and security स्तुति]: May Heaven and Earth, wise pair, may lofty Sukra grant me this thing by reason of the guerdon. May Agni, Soma mark through this libation: may Vāyu, Savitar, and Bhaga guard us.

2. [A prayer for recovery and preservation of health and security स्तुति]: Again return to us our breath and spirit, again come back to us our life and vision! Vaisvānara, unscathed, our bodies' guardian, stand between us and every woe and danger!

3. [A prayer for recovery and preservation of health and security स्तुति]: We are again united with our bodies, with happy mind, with spirit, strength, and splendour. May Tvashtar here make room for us, and freedom and smooth whate'er is injured in our bodies.

title: Sukta 54 · A benediction on a newly elected King
deity: A benediction on a newly elected King
text:
अमित्रदम्भनम्।
१-३ ब्रह्मा। अग्नीषोमौ। अनुष्टुप्।
इ॒दं तद् यु॒ज उत्त॑र॒मिन्द्रं॑ शुम्भा॒म्यष्ट॑ये ।
अ॒स्य क्ष॒त्रं श्रियं॑ म॒हीं वृ॒ष्टिरि॑व वर्धया॒ तृण॑म्॥१॥
अ॒स्मै क्ष॒त्रम॑ग्नीषोमाव॒स्मै धा॑रयतं र॒यिम्।
इ॒मं रा॒ष्ट्रस्या॑भीव॒र्गे कृ॑णु॒तं यु॒ज उत्त॑रम्॥२॥
सब॑न्धु॒श्चास॑बन्धुश्च॒ यो अ॒स्मां अ॑भि॒दास॑ति ।
सर्वं॒ तं र॑न्धयासि मे॒ यज॑मानाय सुन्व॒ते॥३॥
translation_en:
Win the love of Indra that his friend may reach yet higher state. Increase, as rain the grass, this man's dominion and his lofty fame.

Confirm the princely power in him, Agni and Soma! grant him wealth. In all the circuit of his rule make him yet higher for your friend.

The man who shows us enmity, whether a stranger or akin, Thou wilt give up entire to me who sacrifice and press the juice.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 54 · A benediction on a newly elected King - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A benediction on a newly elected King की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A benediction on a newly elected King स्तुति]: Win the love of Indra that his friend may reach yet higher state. Increase, as rain the grass, this man's dominion and his lofty fame.

2. [A benediction on a newly elected King स्तुति]: Confirm the princely power in him, Agni and Soma! grant him wealth. In all the circuit of his rule make him yet higher for your friend.

3. [A benediction on a newly elected King स्तुति]: The man who shows us enmity, whether a stranger or akin, Thou wilt give up entire to me who sacrifice and press the juice.

title: Sukta 55 · A prayer for general protection and prosperity
deity: A prayer for general protection and prosperity
text:
सौमनस्यम्।
१-३ ब्रह्म। १ विश्वे देवाः, २-३ रुद्रः। जगती, २ त्रिष्टुप्।
ये पन्था॑नो ब॒हवो॑ देव॒याना॑ अन्त॒रा द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी सं॒चर॑न्ति ।
तेषा॒मज्या॑निं यत॒मो वहा॑ति॒ तस्मै॑ मा देवाः॒ परि॑ धत्ते॒ह सर्वे॑ ॥१॥
ग्री॒ष्मो हे॑म॒न्तः शिशि॑रो वस॒न्तः श॒रद् व॒र्षाः स्वि॒ते नो॑ दधात ।
आ नो॒ गोषु॒ भज॒ता प्र॒जायां॑ निवा॒त इद् वः॑ शर॒णे स्या॑म ॥२॥
इ॒दा॒व॒त्स॒राय॑ परिवत्स॒राय॑ संवत्स॒राय॑ कृणुता बृ॒हन्नमः॑ ।
तेषां॑ व॒यं सु॑म॒तौ य॒ज्ञिया॑ना॒मपि॑ भ॒द्रे सौ॑मन॒से स्या॑म ॥३॥
translation_en:
Of all the many God-frequented pathways that traverse realms between the earth and heaven, Consign me, all ye Gods to that which leadeth to perfect and inviolable safety.

Maintain us in well-being Summer, Winter Dew-time and Spring, Autumn, and Rainy Season Give us our share of cattle and of Children. May we enjoy your unassailed protection.

Pay to the Year your lofty adoration, to the first Year, the second, and the present. Many we abide in the auspicious favour and gracious love of these who claim our worship.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 55 · A prayer for general protection and prosperity - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for general protection and prosperity की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for general protection and prosperity स्तुति]: Of all the many God-frequented pathways that traverse realms between the earth and heaven, Consign me, all ye Gods to that which leadeth to perfect and inviolable safety.

2. [A prayer for general protection and prosperity स्तुति]: Maintain us in well-being Summer, Winter Dew-time and Spring, Autumn, and Rainy Season Give us our share of cattle and of Children. May we enjoy your unassailed protection.

3. [A prayer for general protection and prosperity स्तुति]: Pay to the Year your lofty adoration, to the first Year, the second, and the present. Many we abide in the auspicious favour and gracious love of these who claim our worship.

title: Sukta 56 · A charm against snakes
deity: A charm against snakes
text:
सर्पेभ्यो रक्षणम्।
१-३ शन्तातिः। १ विश्वे देवाः, २-३ रुद्रः। १ उष्णिग्गर्भा पथ्यापङ्क्तिः, २ अनुष्टुप्, ३ निचृत्।
मा नो॑ देवा॒ अहि॑र्वधी॒त् सतो॑कान्त्स॒हपु॑रुषान्।
सम्य॑तं॒ न वि ष्प॑रद् व्यात्तं॒ न सं य॑म॒न्नमो॑ देवज॒नेभ्यः॑।।१।।
नमो॑ऽस्त्वसि॒ताय॒ नम॒स्तिर॑श्चिराजये ।
स्व॒जाय॑ ब॒भ्रवे॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ देवज॒नेभ्यः॑ ॥२॥
सं ते॑ हन्मि द॒ता द॒तः समु॑ ते॒ हन्वा॒ हनू॑ ।
सं ते॑ जि॒ह्वया॑ जि॒ह्वां सम्वा॒स्नाह॑ आ॒स्यऽम्॥३॥
translation_en:
Let not the serpent slay us, O Gods, with our children and our folk. Let it not close the opened mouth nor open that which now is closed.

Be worship paid unto the black, worship to that with stripes across! To the brown viper reverence, reverence to the demon brood!

I close together fangs with fang, I close together jaws with jaw. I close together tongue with tongue, I close together mouth with mouth.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 56 · A charm against snakes - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm against snakes की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm against snakes स्तुति]: Let not the serpent slay us, O Gods, with our children and our folk. Let it not close the opened mouth nor open that which now is closed.

2. [A charm against snakes स्तुति]: Be worship paid unto the black, worship to that with stripes across! To the brown viper reverence, reverence to the demon brood!

3. [A charm against snakes स्तुति]: I close together fangs with fang, I close together jaws with jaw. I close together tongue with tongue, I close together mouth with mouth.

title: Sukta 57 · A charm for a wound or bruise
deity: A charm for a wound or bruise
text:
जलचिकित्सा।
१-३ शन्तातिः। रुद्रः। १-२ अनुष्टुप् ३ पथ्याबृहती।
इ॒दमिद् वा उ॑ भेष॒जमि॒दं रु॒द्रस्य॑ भेष॒जम्।
येनेषु॒मेक॑तेजनां श॒तश॑ल्यामप॒ब्रव॑त्॥१॥
जा॒ला॒षेणा॒भि षि॑ञ्चत जालाषेणोप॑ सिञ्चत ।
जा॒ला॒षमु॒ग्रं भे॑ष॒जं तेन॑ नो मृड जी॒वसे॑ ॥२॥
शं च॑ नो॒ मय॑श्च नो॒ मा च॑ नः॒ किं च॒नाम॑मत्।
क्ष॒मा रपो॒ विश्वं॑ नो अस्तु भेष॒जं सर्वं॑ नो अस्तु भेष॒जम्॥३॥
translation_en:
This is a medicine indeed, Rudra's own medicine is this, Wherewith he warns the arrow off one-shafted, with a hundred tips.

Besprinkle it with anodyne, bedew it with relieving balm: Strong, soothing is the medicine: bless us therewith that we may live.

Let it be health and joy to us. Let nothing vex or injure us. Down with the wound! Let all to us be balm, the whole be medicine.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 57 · A charm for a wound or bruise - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm for a wound or bruise की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm for a wound or bruise स्तुति]: This is a medicine indeed, Rudra's own medicine is this, Wherewith he warns the arrow off one-shafted, with a hundred tips.

2. [A charm for a wound or bruise स्तुति]: Besprinkle it with anodyne, bedew it with relieving balm: Strong, soothing is the medicine: bless us therewith that we may live.

3. [A charm for a wound or bruise स्तुति]: Let it be health and joy to us. Let nothing vex or injure us. Down with the wound! Let all to us be balm, the whole be medicine.

title: Sukta 58 · A priest's prayer for power and glory
deity: A priest's prayer for power and glory
text:
यशः प्राप्तिः।
१-३ अथर्वा (यशस्कामः)। बृहस्पतिः, १-२ इन्द्रः, द्यावापृथिवि, सविता,
३ अग्निः, इन्द्रः, सोमः। १ जगती, २ प्रस्तारपङ्क्तिः, ३ अनुष्टुप्।
य॒शसं॒ मेन्द्रो॑ म॒घवान् कृणोतु य॒शसं॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी उ॒भे इ॒मे।
य॒शसं॑ मा दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता कृ॑णोतु प्रि॒यो दा॒तुर्दक्षि॑णाया इ॒ह स्या॑म्॥१॥
यथेन्द्रो॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒व्योर्यश॑स्वा॒न् यथाप॒ ओष॑धीषु॒ यश॑स्वतीः ।
ए॒वा विश्वे॑षु दे॒वेषु॑ व॒यं सर्वे॑षु य॒शसः॑ स्याम ॥२॥
य॒शा इन्द्रो॑ य॒शा अ॒ग्निर्य॒शाः सोमो॑ अजायत ।
य॒शा विश्व॑स्य भू॒तस्या॒हम॑स्मि य॒शस्त॑मः ॥३॥
translation_en:
May Indra Maghavan give me name and glory. May Heaven and Earth, this couple, make me famous. May Savitar the deity make me honoured. Here may the man who gives the guerdon love me.

Indra from Heaven and Earth receiveth glory among the plants the Waters have their glory; Even so may we be glorious'mid all the Universal Gods.

Indra and Agni were renowned, famous was Soma at his birth; So too am I illustrious, most glorious of all that is.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 58 · A priest's prayer for power and glory - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A priest's prayer for power and glory की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A priest's prayer for power and glory स्तुति]: May Indra Maghavan give me name and glory. May Heaven and Earth, this couple, make me famous. May Savitar the deity make me honoured. Here may the man who gives the guerdon love me.

2. [A priest's prayer for power and glory स्तुति]: Indra from Heaven and Earth receiveth glory among the plants the Waters have their glory; Even so may we be glorious'mid all the Universal Gods.

3. [A priest's prayer for power and glory स्तुति]: Indra and Agni were renowned, famous was Soma at his birth; So too am I illustrious, most glorious of all that is.

title: Sukta 59 · A charm to protect cattle and men
deity: A charm to protect cattle and men
text:
औषधिः।
१-३ अथर्वा। रुद्रः, अरुन्धती औषधिः। अनुष्टुप्।
अ॒न॒डुद्भ्य॒स्त्वं प्र॑थ॒मं धे॒नुभ्य॒स्त्वम॑रुन्धति ।
अधे॑नवे॒ वय॑से॒ शर्म॑ यच्छ॒ चतु॑ष्पदे ॥१॥
शर्म॑ यच्छ॒त्वोष॑धिः स॒ह दे॒वीर॑रुन्ध॒ती।
कर॒त् पय॑स्वन्तं गो॒ष्ठम॑य॒क्ष्मां उ॒त पूरु॑षान्॥२॥
वि॒श्वरू॑पां सु॒भगा॑म॒च्छाव॑दामि जीव॒लाम्।
सा नो॑ रु॒द्रस्या॒स्तां हे॒तिं दू॒रं न॑यतु॒ गोभ्यः॑ ॥३॥
translation_en:
First, O Arundhatī, protect our oxen and milky kine: Protect each one that is infirm, each quadruped that yields no milk.

Let the Plant give us sheltering aid, Arundhatī allied with Gods; Avert Consumption from our men and make our cow-pen rich in milk.

I welcome the auspicious Plant, life-giving, wearing every hue. Far from our cattle may it turn the deadly dart which Rudra casts.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 59 · A charm to protect cattle and men - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to protect cattle and men की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to protect cattle and men स्तुति]: First, O Arundhatī, protect our oxen and milky kine: Protect each one that is infirm, each quadruped that yields no milk.

2. [A charm to protect cattle and men स्तुति]: Let the Plant give us sheltering aid, Arundhatī allied with Gods; Avert Consumption from our men and make our cow-pen rich in milk.

3. [A charm to protect cattle and men स्तुति]: I welcome the auspicious Plant, life-giving, wearing every hue. Far from our cattle may it turn the deadly dart which Rudra casts.

title: Sukta 60 · The wooing of a bride
deity: The wooing of a bride
text:
पतिलाभः।
१-३ अथर्वा। अर्यमा। अनुष्टुप्।
अ॒यमा या॑त्यर्य॒मा पु॒रस्ता॒द् विषि॑तस्तुपः ।
अ॒स्या इ॒चछन्न॒ग्रुवै॒ पति॑मु॒त जा॒याम॒जान॑ये ॥१॥
अश्र॑मदि॒यम॑र्यमन्न॒न्यासां॒ सम॑नं य॒ती।
अ॒ङ्गो न्वऽर्यमन्न॒स्या अ॒न्याः सम॑न॒माय॑ति ॥२॥
धा॒ता दा॑धार पृथि॒वीं धा॒ता द्यामु॒त सूर्य॑म्।
धा॒तास्या अ॒ग्रुवै॒ पतिं॒ दधा॑तु प्रतिका॒म्यऽम्॥३॥
translation_en:
With forelock loosened o'er his brow here comes the wooer of the bride, Seeking a husband for this maid, a wife for this unmarried man.

Wooer! this girl hath toiled in vain, going to others' marriages. Now to her wedding, verily, wooer! another maid shall come.

Dhātar upholds the spacious earth, upholds the sky, upholds the Sun. Dhātar bestow upon this maid a husband suited to her wish!
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 60 · The wooing of a bride - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा The wooing of a bride की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [The wooing of a bride स्तुति]: With forelock loosened o'er his brow here comes the wooer of the bride, Seeking a husband for this maid, a wife for this unmarried man.

2. [The wooing of a bride स्तुति]: Wooer! this girl hath toiled in vain, going to others' marriages. Now to her wedding, verily, wooer! another maid shall come.

3. [The wooing of a bride स्तुति]: Dhātar upholds the spacious earth, upholds the sky, upholds the Sun. Dhātar bestow upon this maid a husband suited to her wish!

title: Sukta 61 · A prayer for prosperity and greatness
deity: A prayer for prosperity and greatness
text:
विश्वस्रष्टा।
१-३ अथर्वा। रुद्रः। १ त्रिष्टुप्, २-३ भुरिक्।
मह्य॒मापो॒ मधु॑म॒देर॑यन्तां॒ मह्यं॒ सूरो॑ अभर॒ज्ज्योति॑षे॒ कम्।
मह्यं॑ दे॒वा उ॒त विश्वे॑ तपो॒जा मह्यं॑ दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता व्यचो॑ धात्॥१॥
अ॒हं वि॑वेच पृथि॒वीमु॒त द्याम॒हमृ॒तूंर॑जनयं स॒प्त सा॒कम्।
अ॒हं स॒त्यमनृ॑तं॒ यद् वदा॑म्य॒हं दैवीं॒ परि॒ वाचं॒ विश॑श्च ॥२॥
अ॒हं ज॑जान पृथि॒वीमु॒त द्याम॒हमृ॒तूंर॑जनयं स॒प्त सिन्धू॑न्।
अ॒हं स॒त्वमनृ॑तं॒ यद् वदा॑मि यो अ॑ग्नीषो॒मावजु॑षे॒ सखा॑या ॥३॥
translation_en:
The Waters send me what is sweet and pleasant, Sūra bring all I need for light and vision! The deities, and all of pious nature, and Savitar the God afford me freedom!

I set the heaven and the earth asunder, I brought all seven sea- sons into being. My word is truth, what I deny is falsehood, above celestial Vāk, above the nations.

I gave existence to the earth and heaven, I made the seasons and the seven rivers. My word is truth; what I deny is falsehood, I who rejoice in Agni's, Soma's friendship.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 61 · A prayer for prosperity and greatness - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for prosperity and greatness की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for prosperity and greatness स्तुति]: The Waters send me what is sweet and pleasant, Sūra bring all I need for light and vision! The deities, and all of pious nature, and Savitar the God afford me freedom!

2. [A prayer for prosperity and greatness स्तुति]: I set the heaven and the earth asunder, I brought all seven sea- sons into being. My word is truth, what I deny is falsehood, above celestial Vāk, above the nations.

3. [A prayer for prosperity and greatness स्तुति]: I gave existence to the earth and heaven, I made the seasons and the seven rivers. My word is truth; what I deny is falsehood, I who rejoice in Agni's, Soma's friendship.

title: Sukta 62 · A prayer for purification and riches
deity: A prayer for purification and riches
text:
पावमानम्।
१-३ अथर्वा। रुद्रः, वैश्वानरः, वातः, द्यावापृथिवि। त्रिष्टुप्।
वै॒श्वा॒न॒रो र॒श्मिभि॑र्नः पुनातु॒ वातः॑ प्रा॒णेने॑षि॒रो नभो॑भिः ।
द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी पय॑सा॒ पय॑स्वती ऋ॒ताव॑री य॒ज्ञिये॑ न पुनीताम्॥१॥
वै॒श्वा॒न॒रीं सू॒नृता॒मा र॑भध्वं॒ यस्या॒ आशा॑स्त॒न्वोऽवी॒तपृ॑ष्ठाः ।
तया॑ गृ॒णन्तः॑ सध॒मादे॑षु व॒यं स्या॑म॒ पत॑यो रयी॒नाम्॥२॥
वै॒श्वा॒न॒रीं वर्च॑स॒ आ र॑भध्वं शु॒द्धा भव॑न्तः॒ शुच॑यः पाव॒काः ।
इ॒हेड॑या सध॒मादं॒ मद॑न्तो॒ ज्योक् प॑श्येम॒ सूर्य॑मु॒च्चर॑न्तम्॥३॥
translation_en:
Cleanse us Vaisvānara with rays of splendour! With breath and clouds let quickening Vāyu cleanse us. And, rich in milky rain, let Earth and Heaven, worshipful, holy, cleanse us with their water.

Lay hold on Sūnritā whose forms and regions have fair smooth backs, her who is all men's treasure. Through her may we, in sacrificial banquets singing her glory, be the lords of riches.

For splendour, seize on her whom all men worship, becoming pure yourselves, and bright, and brilliant. Here, through our prayer rejoicing in the banquet, long may we look upon the Sun ascending.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 62 · A prayer for purification and riches - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for purification and riches की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for purification and riches स्तुति]: Cleanse us Vaisvānara with rays of splendour! With breath and clouds let quickening Vāyu cleanse us. And, rich in milky rain, let Earth and Heaven, worshipful, holy, cleanse us with their water.

2. [A prayer for purification and riches स्तुति]: Lay hold on Sūnritā whose forms and regions have fair smooth backs, her who is all men's treasure. Through her may we, in sacrificial banquets singing her glory, be the lords of riches.

3. [A prayer for purification and riches स्तुति]: For splendour, seize on her whom all men worship, becoming pure yourselves, and bright, and brilliant. Here, through our prayer rejoicing in the banquet, long may we look upon the Sun ascending.

title: Sukta 63 · The symbolical liberation of a sacrificial victim
deity: The symbolical liberation of a sacrificial victim
text:
वर्चोबलप्राप्तिः।
१-४ द्रुणः। १ निर्ऋतिः, २ यमः, ३ मृत्युः, ४ अग्नि। १-3 जगती, २ अतिजगतीगर्भा, ४ अनुष्टुप्।
यत् ते॑ दे॒वी निरृ॑तिराब॒बन्ध॒ दाम॑ ग्री॒वास्व॑विमो॒क्यं यत्।
तत् ते वि ष्या॒म्यायु॑षे॒ वर्च॑से॒ बला॑यादोम॒दमन्न॑मद्धि॒ प्रसू॑तः ॥१॥
नमो॑ऽस्तु ते निरृते तिग्मतेजोऽय॒स्मया॒न् वि चृ॑ता बन्धपा॒शान्।
य॒मो मह्यं॒ पुन॒रित् त्वां द॑दाति॒ तस्मै॑ य॒माय॒ नमो॑ अस्तु मृ॒त्यवे॑ ॥२॥
अ॒य॒स्मये॑ द्रुप॒दे बे॑धिषे इ॒हाभिहि॑तो मृ॒त्युभि॒र्ये स॒हस्र॑म्।
य॒मेन॒ त्वं पि॒तृभिः॑ संविदा॒न उ॑त्त॒मं नाक॒मधि॑ रोहये॒मम्॥३॥
संस॒मिद् यु॑वसे वृष॒न्नग्ने॒ विश्वा॑न्य॒र्यृ आ।
इ॒डस्प॒दे समि॑ध्यसे॒ स नो॒ वसू॒न्या भ॑र ॥४॥
translation_en:
That collar round thy neck, not to be loosened, which Nirriti the Goddess bound and fastened, I loose for thy long life and strength and vigour. Eat, liberated, food that brings no sorrow.

To thee, sharp-pointed Nirriti, be homage! Loose thou the binding fetters wrought of iron. To me, in truth, again doth Yama give thee. To him, to Yama, yea, to Death, be homage!

Compassed by death which comes in thousand manners, here art thou fastened to the iron pillar. Unanimous with Yama and the Fathers, make this man rise and reach the loftiest heaven.

Thou, mighty Agni, good and true, gatherest up all precious things. Bring us all treasures as thou art enkindled at libation's place.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 63 · The symbolical liberation of a sacrificial victim - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा The symbolical liberation of a sacrificial victim की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [The symbolical liberation of a sacrificial victim स्तुति]: That collar round thy neck, not to be loosened, which Nirriti the Goddess bound and fastened, I loose for thy long life and strength and vigour. Eat, liberated, food that brings no sorrow.

2. [The symbolical liberation of a sacrificial victim स्तुति]: To thee, sharp-pointed Nirriti, be homage! Loose thou the binding fetters wrought of iron. To me, in truth, again doth Yama give thee. To him, to Yama, yea, to Death, be homage!

3. [The symbolical liberation of a sacrificial victim स्तुति]: Compassed by death which comes in thousand manners, here art thou fastened to the iron pillar. Unanimous with Yama and the Fathers, make this man rise and reach the loftiest heaven.

4. [The symbolical liberation of a sacrificial victim स्तुति]: Thou, mighty Agni, good and true, gatherest up all precious things. Bring us all treasures as thou art enkindled at libation's place.

title: Sukta 64 · To promote unanimity in an assembly
deity: To promote unanimity in an assembly
text:
सांमनस्यम्।
१-३ अथर्वा। सांमनस्यम्, १ विश्वे देवाः। अनुष्टुप्, (२ त्रिष्टुप्)।
सं जा॑नीध्वं॒ सं पृ॑च्यध्वं॒ सं वो॒ मनां॑सि जानताम्।
दे॒वा भा॒गं यथा॒ पूर्वे॑ संजाना॒ना उ॒पास॑ते ॥१॥
स॒मा॒नो मन्त्रः॒ समि॑तिः समा॒नी स॑मा॒नं व्र॒तं स॒ह चि॒त्तमे॑षाम्।
स॒मा॒नेन॑ वो ह॒विषा॑ जुहोमि समा॒नं चेतो॑ अभि॒संवि॑शध्वम्॥२॥
स॒मा॒नी व॒ आकू॑तिः समा॒ना हृद॑यानि वः ।
स॒मा॒नम॑स्तु वो॒ मनो॒ यथा॑ वः॒ सुस॒हास॑ति ॥३॥
translation_en:
Agree and be united: let your minds be all of one accord, Even as the Gods of ancient days, unanimous, await their share.

The rede is common, common the assembly, common the law, so be their thoughts united. I offer up your general oblation: together entertain one common purpose.

One and the same be your resolve, be all your hearts in har- mony: One and the same be all your minds that all may happily con- sent.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 64 · To promote unanimity in an assembly - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा To promote unanimity in an assembly की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [To promote unanimity in an assembly स्तुति]: Agree and be united: let your minds be all of one accord, Even as the Gods of ancient days, unanimous, await their share.

2. [To promote unanimity in an assembly स्तुति]: The rede is common, common the assembly, common the law, so be their thoughts united. I offer up your general oblation: together entertain one common purpose.

3. [To promote unanimity in an assembly स्तुति]: One and the same be your resolve, be all your hearts in har- mony: One and the same be all your minds that all may happily con- sent.

title: Sukta 65 · A sacrificial charm against enemies
deity: A sacrificial charm against enemies
text:
शत्रुनाशनम्।
१-३ अथर्वा।(चन्द्रमाः) इन्द्रः, पराशरः। अनुष्टुप्, १ पथ्यापङ्क्तिः।
अव॑ म॒न्युरवाय॒ताव॑ बा॒हू म॑नो॒युजा॑ ।
परा॑शर॒ त्वं तेषां॒ परा॑ञ्चं॒ शुष्म॑मर्द॒याधा॑ नो र॒यिमा कृधि ॥१॥
निर्ह॑स्तेभ्यो नैर्ह॒स्तं यं दे॑वाः॒ शरु॒मस्य॑थ ।
वृ॒श्चामि॒ शत्रू॑णां बा॒हून॒नेन॑ ह॒विषा॒हम्॥२॥
इन्द्र॑श्चकार प्रथ॒मं नै॑र्ह॒स्तमसु॑रेभ्यः ।
जय॑न्तु सत्वा॑नो॒ मम॑ स्थि॒रेणेन्द्रे॑ण मे॒दिना॑ ॥३॥
translation_en:
The angry spirit hath relaxed: loose are the arms that act with mind. Do thou, destroyer, overcome and drive these foemen's might away, and then bring opulence to us.

The shaft for handless fiends which, Gods! ye cast against the handless ones, With this, in shape of sacrifice, I rend the arms of enemies.

Indra made first for Asuras the shaft designed for handless foes: Victorious shall my heroes be with Indra as their constant friend.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 65 · A sacrificial charm against enemies - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A sacrificial charm against enemies की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A sacrificial charm against enemies स्तुति]: The angry spirit hath relaxed: loose are the arms that act with mind. Do thou, destroyer, overcome and drive these foemen's might away, and then bring opulence to us.

2. [A sacrificial charm against enemies स्तुति]: The shaft for handless fiends which, Gods! ye cast against the handless ones, With this, in shape of sacrifice, I rend the arms of enemies.

3. [A sacrificial charm against enemies स्तुति]: Indra made first for Asuras the shaft designed for handless foes: Victorious shall my heroes be with Indra as their constant friend.

title: Sukta 66 · A charm for the destruction and plunder of enemies
deity: A charm for the destruction and plunder of enemies
text:
शत्रुनाशनम्।
१-३ अथर्वा। इन्द्रः। अनुष्टुप्, १ त्रिष्टुप्।
निर्ह॑स्तः शत्रु॑रभि॒दास॑न्नस्तु॒ ये सेना॑भि॒र्युध॑मा॒यन्त्य॒स्मान्।
सम॑र्पयेन्द्र मह॒ता व॒धेन॒ द्रात्वे॑षामघहा॒रो विवि॑द्धः ॥१॥
आ॒त॒न्वा॒ना आ॒यच्छ॒न्तोऽस्य॑न्तो॒ ये च॒ धाव॑थ ।
निर्ह॑स्ताः शत्रवः स्थ॒नेन्द्रो॑ वोऽद्य परा॑शरीत्॥२॥
निर्ह॑स्ताः सन्तु॒ शत्र॒वोऽङ्गै॑षां म्लापयामसि ।
अथै॑षामिन्द्र॒ वेदां॑सि शत॒शो वि भ॑जामहै ॥३॥
translation_en:
Handless be every foeman who assaileth, they who with missiles come to fight against us! Dash them together with great slaughter, Indra! and let their robber chief run pierced with arrows.

Ye who run hither bending bows, brandishing swords and cast- ing darts. Handless be ye, O enemies! Let Indra mangle you to-day.

Handless be these our enemies! We enervate their languid limbs. So let us part among ourselves, in hundreds, Indra! all their wealth.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 66 · A charm for the destruction and plunder of enemies - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm for the destruction and plunder of enemies की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm for the destruction and plunder of enemies स्तुति]: Handless be every foeman who assaileth, they who with missiles come to fight against us! Dash them together with great slaughter, Indra! and let their robber chief run pierced with arrows.

2. [A charm for the destruction and plunder of enemies स्तुति]: Ye who run hither bending bows, brandishing swords and cast- ing darts. Handless be ye, O enemies! Let Indra mangle you to-day.

3. [A charm for the destruction and plunder of enemies स्तुति]: Handless be these our enemies! We enervate their languid limbs. So let us part among ourselves, in hundreds, Indra! all their wealth.

title: Sukta 67 · A charm for the destruction and plunder of enemies
deity: A charm for the destruction and plunder of enemies
text:
शत्रुनाशनम्।
१-३ अथर्वा। इन्द्रः। अनुष्टुप्।
परि॒ व॑र्त्मा॑नि स॒र्वत॒ इन्द्रः॑ पू॒षा च॑ सस्रतुः ।
मुह्य॑न्त्व॒द्यामूः सेना॑ अ॒मित्रा॑णां परस्त॒राम्॥१॥
मू॒ढा अ॒मित्रा॑श्चरताशी॒र्षाण॑ इ॒वाहयः॑ ।
तेषां॑ वो अ॒ग्निमू॑ढाना॒मिन्द्रो॑ हन्तु॒ वरं॑वरम्॥२॥
ऐषु॑ नह्य॒ वृषा॒जिनं॑ हरि॒णस्या॒ भियं॑ कृधि ।
परा॑ङ॒मित्र॒ एष॑त्व॒र्वाची॒ गौरुपे॑षतु ॥३॥
translation_en:
Indra and Pūshan have gone forth along the ways on every side. To-day those hosts of enemies must flee bewildered far away.

Ye foes, come hitherward dismayed like serpents when their heads are gone. Let Indra slay each bravest one of you whom Agni hath con- fused.

Gird thou a bullock's hide on these, make those as timid as the deer. Let the foe flee away, and let his kine come hither-ward to us.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 67 · A charm for the destruction and plunder of enemies - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm for the destruction and plunder of enemies की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm for the destruction and plunder of enemies स्तुति]: Indra and Pūshan have gone forth along the ways on every side. To-day those hosts of enemies must flee bewildered far away.

2. [A charm for the destruction and plunder of enemies स्तुति]: Ye foes, come hitherward dismayed like serpents when their heads are gone. Let Indra slay each bravest one of you whom Agni hath con- fused.

3. [A charm for the destruction and plunder of enemies स्तुति]: Gird thou a bullock's hide on these, make those as timid as the deer. Let the foe flee away, and let his kine come hither-ward to us.

title: Sukta 68 · A charm to accompany the shaving of the beard
deity: A charm to accompany the shaving of the beard
text:
वपनम्।
१-३ अथर्वा। १ सविता, आदित्याः, रुद्राः, वसवः, २ अदितिः, आपः, प्रजापतिः, ३ सविता, सोमः, वरुणः। १ पुरोविराडतिशाक्वरगर्भा चतुष्पदा जगती, २ अनुष्टुप्, ३ अतिजगतीगर्भा त्रिष्टुप्।
आयम॑गन्त्सवि॒ता क्षु॒रेणो॒ष्णेन॑ वाय उद॒केनेहि॑ ।
आ॒दि॒त्या रु॒द्रा वस॑व उन्दन्तु॒ सचे॑तसः॒ सोम॑स्य॒ राज्ञो॑ वपत॒ प्रचे॑तसः ॥१॥
अदि॑तिः॒ श्मश्रु॑ वप॒त्वाप॑ उन्दन्तु॒ वर्च॑सा ।
चिकि॑त्सतु प्र॒जाप॑तिर्दीर्घायु॒त्वाय॒ चक्ष॑से ॥२॥
येनाव॑पत् सवि॒ता क्षु॒रेण॒ सोम॑स्य॒ राज्ञो॒ वरु॑णस्य वि॒द्वान्।
तेन॑ ब्रह्माणो वपते॒दम॒स्य गोमा॒नश्व॑वान॒यम॑स्तु प्र॒जावा॑न्॥३॥
translation_en:
Savitar hath come hither with the razor: come thou, O Vāyu, with the heated water. One-minded let Ādityas, Rudras, Vasus moisten the hair: shave ye who know King Soma.

Let Aditi shave the beard, and let the Waters bathe it with their strength: Prajāpati restore his health for sight and days of lengthened life!

The razor used by Savitar, for shaving, who knoweth Varuna and royal Soma, Even with this shave ye this man, O Brāhman. Let him be rich in horses, kine, and children.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 68 · A charm to accompany the shaving of the beard - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to accompany the shaving of the beard की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to accompany the shaving of the beard स्तुति]: Savitar hath come hither with the razor: come thou, O Vāyu, with the heated water. One-minded let Ādityas, Rudras, Vasus moisten the hair: shave ye who know King Soma.

2. [A charm to accompany the shaving of the beard स्तुति]: Let Aditi shave the beard, and let the Waters bathe it with their strength: Prajāpati restore his health for sight and days of lengthened life!

3. [A charm to accompany the shaving of the beard स्तुति]: The razor used by Savitar, for shaving, who knoweth Varuna and royal Soma, Even with this shave ye this man, O Brāhman. Let him be rich in horses, kine, and children.

title: Sukta 69 · A priest's prayer for power and glory
deity: A priest's prayer for power and glory
text:
वर्चःप्राप्तिः।
१-३ अथर्वा। बृहस्पतिः, अश्विनौ। अनुष्टुप्।
गि॒राव॑र॒गरा॑टेषु॒ हिर॑ण्ये॒ गोषु॒ यद् यशः॑ ।
सुरा॑यां सि॒च्यमा॑नायां की॒लाले॒ मधु॒ तन्मयि॑ ॥१॥
अश्वि॑ना सार॒घेण॑ मा॒ मधु॑नाङ्क्तं शुभस्पती ।
यथा॒ भर्ग॑स्वतीं॒ वाच॑मा॒वदा॑नि॒ जनाँ॑ अनु॑ ॥२॥
मयि॒ वर्चो॒ अथो॒ यशोऽथो॑ य॒ज्ञस्य॒ यत् पयः॑ ।
तन्मयि॑ प्र॒जाप॑तिर्दि॒वि द्यामि॑व दृंहतु ॥३॥
translation_en:
Mine be the glory in the hill, in vales, in cattle, and in gold, Mine be the sweetness that is found in nectar and in flowing wine!

With your delicious honey balm me, Asvins, Lords of splendid light! That clear and resonant may be the voice I utter to mankind.

In me be strength, in me be fame, in me the power of sacrifice: Prajāpati establish this in me as firm as light in heaven!
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 69 · A priest's prayer for power and glory - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A priest's prayer for power and glory की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A priest's prayer for power and glory स्तुति]: Mine be the glory in the hill, in vales, in cattle, and in gold, Mine be the sweetness that is found in nectar and in flowing wine!

2. [A priest's prayer for power and glory स्तुति]: With your delicious honey balm me, Asvins, Lords of splendid light! That clear and resonant may be the voice I utter to mankind.

3. [A priest's prayer for power and glory स्तुति]: In me be strength, in me be fame, in me the power of sacrifice: Prajāpati establish this in me as firm as light in heaven!

title: Sukta 70 · A benediction on cow and calf
deity: A benediction on cow and calf
text:
अघ्न्याः।
१-३ काङ्कायनः। अघ्न्याः। जगती।
यथा॑ मां॒सं॑ यथा॒ सुरा॒ यथा॒क्षा अ॑धि॒देव॑ने ।
यथा॑ पुं॒सो वृ॑षण्य॒त स्त्रि॒यां नि॑ह॒न्यते॒ मनः॑ ।
ए॒वा ते॑ अघ्न्ये॒ मनोऽधि॑ व॒त्से नि ह॑न्यताम्॥१॥
यथा॑ ह॒स्ती ह॑स्ति॒न्याः प॒देन॑ प॒दमु॑द्यु॒जे।
यथा॑ पुं॒सो वृ॑षण्य॒त स्त्रि॒यां नि॑ह॒न्यते॒ मनः॑ ।
ए॒वा ते॑ अघ्न्ये॒ मनोऽधि॑ व॒त्से नि ह॑न्यताम्॥२॥
यथा॑ प्र॒धिर्यथो॑प॒धिर्यथा॒ नभ्यं॑ प्र॒धावधि॑ ।
यथा॑ पुं॒सो वृ॑षण्य॒त स्त्रि॒यां नि॑ह॒न्यते॒ मनः॑ ।
ए॒वा ते॑ अघ्न्ये॒ मनोऽधि॑ व॒त्से नि ह॑न्यताम्॥३॥
translation_en:
As wine associates with flesh, as dice attend the gaming-board, As an enamoured man's desire is firmly set upon a dame, So let thy heart and soul, O Cow, be firmly set upou thy calf.

As the male elephant pursues with eager step his female's track, As an enamoured man's desire is firmly set upon a dame, So let thy heart and soul, O Cow, be firmly set upon the calf.

Close as the felly and the spoke, fixt as the wheel-rim on the nave, As an enamoured man's desire is firmly set upon a dame, So let thy heart and soul, O Cow, be firmly set upon thy calf.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 70 · A benediction on cow and calf - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A benediction on cow and calf की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A benediction on cow and calf स्तुति]: As wine associates with flesh, as dice attend the gaming-board, As an enamoured man's desire is firmly set upon a dame, So let thy heart and soul, O Cow, be firmly set upou thy calf.

2. [A benediction on cow and calf स्तुति]: As the male elephant pursues with eager step his female's track, As an enamoured man's desire is firmly set upon a dame, So let thy heart and soul, O Cow, be firmly set upon the calf.

3. [A benediction on cow and calf स्तुति]: Close as the felly and the spoke, fixt as the wheel-rim on the nave, As an enamoured man's desire is firmly set upon a dame, So let thy heart and soul, O Cow, be firmly set upon thy calf.

title: Sukta 71 · A priest's benediction after meat
deity: A priest's benediction after meat
text:
अन्नम्।
१-३ ब्रह्मा। अग्निः, ३ वैश्वानरः, देवाः। जगती, ३ त्रिष्टुप्।
यदन्न॒मद्मि॑ बहु॒धा विरू॑पं॒ हिर॑ण्य॒मश्व॑मु॒त गाम॒जामवि॑म्।
यदे॒व किं च॑ प्रतिज॒ग्रहाह॑म॒ग्निष्टद्धोता॒ सुहु॑तं कृनोतु ॥१॥
यन्मा॑ हु॒तमहु॑तमाज॒गाम॑ द॒त्तं पि॒तृभि॒रनु॑मतं मनु॒ष्यैः ।
यस्मा॑न्मे॒ मन॒ उदि॑व॒ रार॑जीत्य॒ग्निष्टद्धोता॒ सुहु॑तं कृणोतु ॥२॥
यदन्न॒मद्म्यनृ॑तेन देवा दा॒स्यन्नदा॑स्यन्नु॒त सं॑गृ॒णामि॑ ।
वै॒श्वा॒न॒रस्य॑ मह॒तो म॑हि॒म्ना शि॒वं मह्यं॒ मधु॑मद॒स्त्वन्न॑म्॥३॥
translation_en:
What food I eat of varied form and nature, food whether gold, or horse, sheep, goat, or bullock, Whatever gift I have received, may Agni the Hotar make it sacrifice well-offered.

Whatever, sacrificed or not, hath reached me, bestowed by men and sanctioned by the Fathers, Whereby my heart seems to leap up, may Agni the Hotar make that sacrifice well-offered.

What food I eat unjustly, Gods! or, doubtful between bestow- ing and refusing, swallow, Through greatness of Vaisvānara the mighty may that same food be sweet to me and blessed!
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 71 · A priest's benediction after meat - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A priest's benediction after meat की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A priest's benediction after meat स्तुति]: What food I eat of varied form and nature, food whether gold, or horse, sheep, goat, or bullock, Whatever gift I have received, may Agni the Hotar make it sacrifice well-offered.

2. [A priest's benediction after meat स्तुति]: Whatever, sacrificed or not, hath reached me, bestowed by men and sanctioned by the Fathers, Whereby my heart seems to leap up, may Agni the Hotar make that sacrifice well-offered.

3. [A priest's benediction after meat स्तुति]: What food I eat unjustly, Gods! or, doubtful between bestow- ing and refusing, swallow, Through greatness of Vaisvānara the mighty may that same food be sweet to me and blessed!

title: Sukta 72 · A charm to restore or increase virile power
deity: A charm to restore or increase virile power
text:
वाजीकरणम्।
१-३ अथर्वाङ्गिराः। शेपोऽर्कः। १ जगती, २ अनुष्टुप्, ३ भुरिक्।
यथा॑सि॒तः प्र॒थय॑ते॒ वशाँ॒ अनु॒ वपूं॑षि कृ॒ण्वन्नसु॑रस्य मा॒यया॑ ।
ए॒वा ते॒ शेपः॒ सह॑सा॒यम॒र्कोऽङ्गे॒नाङ्गं॒ संस॑मकं कृणोतु ॥१॥
यथा॒ पस॑स्तायाद॒रं वाते॑न स्थूल॒भं कृ॒तम्।
याव॒त् पर॑स्वतः॒ पस॒स्ताव॒त् ते वर्धतां॒ पसः॑ ॥२॥
या॒व॒द॒ङ्गीनं॒ पार॑स्वतं॒ हास्ति॑नं॒ गार्द॑भं च॒ यत्।
याव॒दश्वस्य वा॒जिन॒स्ताव॑त् ते वर्धतां॒ पसः॑ ॥३॥
translation_en:
Sicut anguis niger ad voluntatem se extendit, Asurarum arte magica formas novas efficiens, sic fascinum tuum, partem cum parte, conjunctum, hic hymnus efficiat.

Velut penis (tayadarus quem ventus permagnum fecit, quantus. est onagri penis, tantus penis tuus increscat.

Quantum estonagri membrum masculinum, elephanti, asinique, quantum est fortis equi, tantus penis tuus increscat.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 72 · A charm to restore or increase virile power - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to restore or increase virile power की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to restore or increase virile power स्तुति]: Sicut anguis niger ad voluntatem se extendit, Asurarum arte magica formas novas efficiens, sic fascinum tuum, partem cum parte, conjunctum, hic hymnus efficiat.

2. [A charm to restore or increase virile power स्तुति]: Velut penis (tayadarus quem ventus permagnum fecit, quantus. est onagri penis, tantus penis tuus increscat.

3. [A charm to restore or increase virile power स्तुति]: Quantum estonagri membrum masculinum, elephanti, asinique, quantum est fortis equi, tantus penis tuus increscat.

title: Sukta 73 · A King's charm to conciliate his discontented kinsmen
deity: A King's charm to conciliate his discontented kinsmen
text:
सांमनस्यम्।
१-३ अथर्वा। सांमनस्यम्, वरुणसोमाग्निबृहस्पतिवसवः, ३ वास्तोष्पतिः, १,३ भुरिक्, २ त्रिष्टुप्।
एह या॑तु॒ वरु॑णः॒ सोमो॑ अ॒ग्निर्बृह॒स्पति॒र्वसु॑भि॒रेह या॑तु ।
अ॒स्य श्रिय॑मुप॒संया॑त॒ सर्व॑ उ॒ग्रस्य॑ चे॒त्तुः संम॑नसः सजाताः ॥१॥
यो वः॒ शुष्मो॒ हृद॑येष्व॒न्तराकू॑ति॒र्या वो॒ मन॑सि॒ प्रवि॑ष्टा ।
तान्त्सी॑वयामि ह॒विषा॑ घृ॒तेन॒ मयि॑ सजाता र॒मति॑र्वो अस्तु ॥२॥
इ॒हैव स्त॒ माप॑ या॒ताध्य॒स्मत् पू॒षा प॒रस्ता॒दप॑थं वः कृणोतु ।
वास्तो॒ष्पति॒रनु॑ वो जोहवीतु॒ मयि॑ सजाता र॒मति॑र्वो अस्तु ॥३॥
translation_en:
Let Varuna come hither, Soma, Agni, Brihaspati come hither with the Vasus! Unanimous, ye kinsmen, come united, come to the glory of this mighty guardian.

The inclination which your hearts have harboured, the purpose which hath occupied your spirits, This I annul with sacrifice and butter. In me be your sweet resting-place, O kinsmen.

Stand even here; forsake me not. Before us may Pūshan make your path unfit to travel. Vāstoshpati incessantly recall you! In me be your sweet resting- place, O kinsmen!
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 73 · A King's charm to conciliate his discontented kinsmen - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A King's charm to conciliate his discontented kinsmen की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A King's charm to conciliate his discontented kinsmen स्तुति]: Let Varuna come hither, Soma, Agni, Brihaspati come hither with the Vasus! Unanimous, ye kinsmen, come united, come to the glory of this mighty guardian.

2. [A King's charm to conciliate his discontented kinsmen स्तुति]: The inclination which your hearts have harboured, the purpose which hath occupied your spirits, This I annul with sacrifice and butter. In me be your sweet resting-place, O kinsmen.

3. [A King's charm to conciliate his discontented kinsmen स्तुति]: Stand even here; forsake me not. Before us may Pūshan make your path unfit to travel. Vāstoshpati incessantly recall you! In me be your sweet resting- place, O kinsmen!

title: Sukta 74 · A King's charm to secure the fidelity of his people
deity: A King's charm to secure the fidelity of his people
text:
सांमनस्यम्।
१-३ अथर्वा। सांमनस्यम्, नाना देवताः, त्रिणामा। अनुष्टुप्, ३ त्रिषटुप्।
सं वः॑ पृच्यन्तां त॒न्वः॑१ सं मनां॑सि॒ समु॑ व्र॒ता।
सं वोऽयं ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॒र्भगः॑ सं वो॑ अजीगमत्॥१॥
सं॒ज्ञप॑नं वो॒ मन॒सोऽथो॑ सं॒ज्ञप॑नं हृ॒दः ।
अथो॒ भग॑स्य॒ यच्छ्रा॒न्तं तेन॒ संज्ञ॑पयामि वः ॥२॥
यथा॑दि॒त्या वसु॑भिः संबभू॒वुर्म॒रुद्भि॑रु॒ग्रा अहृ॑णीयमानाः ।
एवा त्रि॑णाम॒न्नहृ॑णीयमान इ॒मान् जना॒न्त्संम॑नसस्कृधी॒ह॥३॥
translation_en:
Close gathered be your bodies: be your minds and vows in. unison! Here present Brāhmanaspati and Bhaga have assembled you.

Let there be union of your minds, let there be union of your hearts: All that is troubled in your lot with this I mend and harmonize.

As, free from jealousy, the strong Ādityas have been the Vasus' and the Rudras' fellows. So free from jealousy, Lord of Three Titles! cause thou these people here to be one-minded.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 74 · A King's charm to secure the fidelity of his people - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A King's charm to secure the fidelity of his people की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A King's charm to secure the fidelity of his people स्तुति]: Close gathered be your bodies: be your minds and vows in. unison! Here present Brāhmanaspati and Bhaga have assembled you.

2. [A King's charm to secure the fidelity of his people स्तुति]: Let there be union of your minds, let there be union of your hearts: All that is troubled in your lot with this I mend and harmonize.

3. [A King's charm to secure the fidelity of his people स्तुति]: As, free from jealousy, the strong Ādityas have been the Vasus' and the Rudras' fellows. So free from jealousy, Lord of Three Titles! cause thou these people here to be one-minded.

title: Sukta 75 · A charm to effect the removal of an enemy
deity: A charm to effect the removal of an enemy
text:
सपत्नक्षयणम्।
१-३ कबन्धः। इन्द्रः। अनुष्टुप्, ३ षट्-पदा जगती।
निर॒मुं नु॑द॒ ओक॑सः स॒पत्नो॒ यः पृ॑त॒न्यति॑ ।
नै॒र्बा॒ध्येऽन ह॒विषेन्द्र॑ एनं॒ परा॑शरीत्॥१॥
प॒र॒मां तं प॑रा॒वत॒मिन्द्रो॑ नुदतु वृत्र॒हा।
यतो॒ न पुन॒राय॑ति शश्व॒तीभ्यः॒ समा॑भ्यः ॥२॥
एतु॑ ति॒स्रः प॑रा॒वत॒ एतु॒ पञ्च॒ जनाँ॒ अति॑ ।
एतु॑ ति॒स्रोऽति॑ रोच॒ना यतो॒ न पुन॒राय॑ति ।
शश्व॒तीभ्यः॒ समा॑भ्यो॒ यावत् सूर्यो॒ अस॑द् दि॒वि॥३॥
translation_en:
Forth from his dwelling drive that man, the foeman who assaileth us: Through the Expellent sacrifice hath Indra rent and mangled him.

Indra, Foe-Slayer, drive him forth into the distance most remote, Whence never more shall be return in all the years that are to come.

To the three distances, beyond mankind's Five Races, let him go, Beyond the three skies let him go, whence he shall never come- again In all the years that are to be, long as the Sun is in the heaven.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 75 · A charm to effect the removal of an enemy - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to effect the removal of an enemy की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to effect the removal of an enemy स्तुति]: Forth from his dwelling drive that man, the foeman who assaileth us: Through the Expellent sacrifice hath Indra rent and mangled him.

2. [A charm to effect the removal of an enemy स्तुति]: Indra, Foe-Slayer, drive him forth into the distance most remote, Whence never more shall be return in all the years that are to come.

3. [A charm to effect the removal of an enemy स्तुति]: To the three distances, beyond mankind's Five Races, let him go, Beyond the three skies let him go, whence he shall never come- again In all the years that are to be, long as the Sun is in the heaven.

title: Sukta 76 · A benediction on a new-born Kshatriya child
deity: A benediction on a new-born Kshatriya child
text:
आयुष्यम्।
१-४ कबन्धः। सान्तपनाग्निः। अनुष्टुप्, ३ ककुम्मती।
य ए॑नं परि॒षीद॑न्ति समा॒दध॑ति॒ चक्ष॑से ।
सं॒प्रेद्धो॑ अ॒ग्निर्जि॒ह्वाभि॒रुदे॑तु॒ हृद॑या॒दधि॑ ॥१॥
अ॒ग्नेः सा॑न्तप॒नस्या॒हमायु॑षे प॒दमा र॑भे ।
अ॒द्धा॒तिर्यस्य॒ पश्य॑ति धू॒ममु॒द्यन्त॑मास्य॒तः ॥२॥
यो अ॑स्य स॒मिधं॒ वेद॑ क्ष॒त्रिये॑ण स॒माहि॑ताम्।
नाभि॑ह्वा॒रे प॒दं नि द॑धाति॒ स मृ॒त्यवे॑ ॥३॥
नैनं घ्नन्ति पर्या॒यिणो॒ न स॒न्नाँ अव॑ गच्छति ।
अ॒ग्नेर्यः क्ष॒त्रियो॑ वि॒द्वान् नाम॑ गृ॒ह्णात्यायु॑षे ॥४॥
translation_en:
Those who are sitting round this babe prepare him to be looked upon. Let Agni thoroughly inflamed with all his tongues rise from his- heart.

For length of life I use the name of Agni the Consuming God, Whose smoke the sage who knows the truth beholds proceeding. from his mouth.

The man who knows his fuel laid in order by the Kshatriya Sets not his foot upon the steep declivity that leads to Death.

Those who encompass slay him not: he goes not near his lurk— ing foes The Kshatriya who, knowing well, takes Agni's name for length of life.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 76 · A benediction on a new-born Kshatriya child - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A benediction on a new-born Kshatriya child की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A benediction on a new-born Kshatriya child स्तुति]: Those who are sitting round this babe prepare him to be looked upon. Let Agni thoroughly inflamed with all his tongues rise from his- heart.

2. [A benediction on a new-born Kshatriya child स्तुति]: For length of life I use the name of Agni the Consuming God, Whose smoke the sage who knows the truth beholds proceeding. from his mouth.

3. [A benediction on a new-born Kshatriya child स्तुति]: The man who knows his fuel laid in order by the Kshatriya Sets not his foot upon the steep declivity that leads to Death.

4. [A benediction on a new-born Kshatriya child स्तुति]: Those who encompass slay him not: he goes not near his lurk— ing foes The Kshatriya who, knowing well, takes Agni's name for length of life.

title: Sukta 77 · A charm to bring the cattle home
deity: A charm to bring the cattle home
text:
प्रतिष्ठापनम्।
१-३ कबन्धः। जातवेदाः। अनुष्टुप्।
अस्था॒द् द्यौरस्था॑त् पृथि॒व्यस्था॒द् विश्व॑मि॒दं जग॑त्।
आ॒स्थाने॒ पर्व॑ता अस्थु॒ स्थाम्न्यश्वां॑ अतिष्ठिपम्॥१॥
य उ॒दान॑ट् प॒राय॑णं॒ य उ॒दान॒ण् न्याय॑नम्।
आ॒वर्त॑नं नि॒वर्त॑नं॒ यो गो॒पा अपि॒ तं हु॑वे ॥२॥
जात॑वेदो॒ नि व॑र्तय श॒तं ते॑ सन्त्वा॒वतः॑ ।
स॒हस्रं॑ त उपा॒वृत॒स्तभि॑र्नः॒ पुन॒रा कृ॑धि ॥३॥
translation_en:
Firm stands the heaven, firm stands the earth, firm stands this universal world, Firm stand the rooted mountains. I have put the horses in the stall.

I call the Herdsman, him who knows the way to drive the cattle forth, Who knows the way to drive them home, to drive them back and drive them in.

O Jātavedas turn them back: a hundred homeward ways be thine! Thou hast a thousand avenues: by these restore our kine to us.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 77 · A charm to bring the cattle home - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to bring the cattle home की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to bring the cattle home स्तुति]: Firm stands the heaven, firm stands the earth, firm stands this universal world, Firm stand the rooted mountains. I have put the horses in the stall.

2. [A charm to bring the cattle home स्तुति]: I call the Herdsman, him who knows the way to drive the cattle forth, Who knows the way to drive them home, to drive them back and drive them in.

3. [A charm to bring the cattle home स्तुति]: O Jātavedas turn them back: a hundred homeward ways be thine! Thou hast a thousand avenues: by these restore our kine to us.

title: Sukta 78 · A nuptial benediction
deity: A nuptial benediction
text:
दम्पत्यो रयिप्राप्तये प्रार्थना।
१-३ अथर्वा। १-२ चन्द्रमाः, ३ त्वष्टा। अनुष्टुप्।
तेन॑ भू॒तेन॑ ह॒विषा॒यमा प्या॑यतां॑ पुनः॑ ।
जा॒यां याम॑स्मा॒ आवा॑क्षु॒स्तां रसे॑ना॒भि व॑र्धताम्॥१॥
अ॒भि व॑र्धतां॒ पय॑सा॒भि रा॒ष्ट्रेण॑ वर्धताम्।
र॒य्या स॒हस्र॑वर्चसे॒मौ स्तामनु॑पक्षितौ ॥२॥
त्वष्टा॑ जा॒याम॑जनय॒त् त्वष्टा॑स्यै॒ त्वां पति॑म्।
त्वष्टा॑ स॒हस्र॒मायूं॑षि दी॒र्घमायुः॑ कृणोतु वाम्॥३॥
translation_en:
Let this man be again bedewed with this presented sacrifice. And comfort with the sap of life the bride whom they have brought to him.

With life's sap let him comfort her, and raise her high with princely sway. In wealth that hath a thousand powers, this pair be inexhausti- ble!

Tvashtar formed her to be thy dame, Tvashtar made thee to be her lord. Long life let Tvashtar give you both. Let Tvashtar give a thousand lives.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 78 · A nuptial benediction - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A nuptial benediction की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A nuptial benediction स्तुति]: Let this man be again bedewed with this presented sacrifice. And comfort with the sap of life the bride whom they have brought to him.

2. [A nuptial benediction स्तुति]: With life's sap let him comfort her, and raise her high with princely sway. In wealth that hath a thousand powers, this pair be inexhausti- ble!

3. [A nuptial benediction स्तुति]: Tvashtar formed her to be thy dame, Tvashtar made thee to be her lord. Long life let Tvashtar give you both. Let Tvashtar give a thousand lives.

title: Sukta 79 · A prayer for seasonable rain and prosperity
deity: A prayer for seasonable rain and prosperity
text:
ऊर्जःप्राप्तिः।
१-३ अथर्वा। संस्फानम्। गायत्री, ३ त्रिपदा प्राजापतया गायत्री।
अ॒यं नो॒ नभ॑स॒स्पतिः॑ सं॒स्फानो॑ अ॒भि र॑क्षतु ।
अस॑मातिं गृहेषु॑ नः ॥१॥
त्वं नो॑ नभसस्पत ऊर्जं॑ गृ॒हेषु॑ धारय ।
आ पु॒ष्टमेत्वा वसु॑ ॥२॥
देव॑ संस्फान सहस्रापो॒षस्ये॑शिषे ।
तस्य॑ नो रास्व॒ तस्य॑ नो धेहि॒ तस्य॑ ते भक्ति॒वांसः॑ स्याम ॥३॥
translation_en:
May this our Lord of Cloudy Sky, bedewed with liquid drops preserve unequalled riches in our homes.

Lord of the Cloudy Sky, bestow vigour and strength on our abodes. Let wealth and treasure come to us.

Thou, God bedewed with drops, art Lord of infinite prosperity. Grant us thereof, give us thereof: may we enjoy this boon of thine.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 79 · A prayer for seasonable rain and prosperity - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for seasonable rain and prosperity की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for seasonable rain and prosperity स्तुति]: May this our Lord of Cloudy Sky, bedewed with liquid drops preserve unequalled riches in our homes.

2. [A prayer for seasonable rain and prosperity स्तुति]: Lord of the Cloudy Sky, bestow vigour and strength on our abodes. Let wealth and treasure come to us.

3. [A prayer for seasonable rain and prosperity स्तुति]: Thou, God bedewed with drops, art Lord of infinite prosperity. Grant us thereof, give us thereof: may we enjoy this boon of thine.

title: Sukta 80 · A prayer for help and protection
deity: A prayer for help and protection
text:
अरिष्टक्षयणम्।
१-३ अथर्वा। चन्द्रमाः। १ भुरिक्, २ अनुष्टुप्, ३ प्रस्तारपङक्तिः।
अ॒न्तरि॑क्षेण पतति॒ विश्वा॑ भू॒ताव॒चाक॑शत्।
शुनो॑ दि॒व्यस्य॒ यन्मह॒स्तेना॑ ते ह॒विषा॑ विधेम ॥१॥
ये त्रयः॑ कालका॒ञ्जा दि॒वि दे॒वा इ॑व श्रि॒ताः ।
तान्त्सर्वा॑नह्व ऊ॒तये॒ऽस्मा अ॑रि॒ष्टता॑तये ॥२॥
अ॒प्सु ते॒ जन्म॑ दि॒वि ते॑ स॒धस्थं॑ समु॒द्रे अ॒न्तर्म॑हि॒मा ते॑ पृथि॒व्याम्।
शुनो॑ दि॒व्यस्य॒ यन्मह॒स्तेना॑ ते ह॒विषा॑ विधेम ॥३॥
translation_en:
He flieth in the firmament observing all the things that be: We with this offering will adore the greatness of the Heavenly Hound.

The three, the Kālakānjas, set aloft in heaven as they were Gods All these I call to be our help and keep this man secure from harm.

In waters is thy birth, in heaven thy station, thy majesty on earth and in the ocean. We with this offering will adore the greatness of the Heavenly Hound.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 80 · A prayer for help and protection - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for help and protection की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for help and protection स्तुति]: He flieth in the firmament observing all the things that be: We with this offering will adore the greatness of the Heavenly Hound.

2. [A prayer for help and protection स्तुति]: The three, the Kālakānjas, set aloft in heaven as they were Gods All these I call to be our help and keep this man secure from harm.

3. [A prayer for help and protection स्तुति]: In waters is thy birth, in heaven thy station, thy majesty on earth and in the ocean. We with this offering will adore the greatness of the Heavenly Hound.

title: Sukta 81 · A charm to facilitate child-birth
deity: A charm to facilitate child-birth
text:
गर्भाधानम्।
१-३ अथर्वा। आदित्यः, ३ त्वष्टा। अनुष्टुप्।
य॒न्तासि॒ यच्छ॑से॒ हस्ता॒वप॒ रक्षां॑सि सेधसि ।
प्र॒जां धनं॑ च गृह्णा॒नः प॑रिह॒स्तो अ॑भूद॒यम्॥१॥
परि॑हस्त॒ वि धा॑रय॒ योनिं॒ गर्भा॑य॒ धात॑वे ।
मर्या॑दे पु॒त्रमा धे॑हि॒ तं त्वमा ग॑मयागमे ॥२॥
यं प॑रिह॒स्तमबि॑भ॒रदि॑तिः पुत्रका॒म्या।
त्वष्टा॒ तम॑स्या॒ आ ब॑ध्ना॒द् यथा॑ पु॒त्रं जना॒दिति॑॥३॥
translation_en:
Thou art a grasper, holding fast both hands: drivest fiends away. A holder both of progeny and riches hath this Ring become.

Prepare accordantly, O Ring, the mother for the infant's birth. On the right way bring forth the boy. Make him come hither. I am here.

The Amulet which Aditi wore when desirous of a son, Tvashtar hath bound upon this dame and said, Be mother of a boy.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 81 · A charm to facilitate child-birth - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to facilitate child-birth की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to facilitate child-birth स्तुति]: Thou art a grasper, holding fast both hands: drivest fiends away. A holder both of progeny and riches hath this Ring become.

2. [A charm to facilitate child-birth स्तुति]: Prepare accordantly, O Ring, the mother for the infant's birth. On the right way bring forth the boy. Make him come hither. I am here.

3. [A charm to facilitate child-birth स्तुति]: The Amulet which Aditi wore when desirous of a son, Tvashtar hath bound upon this dame and said, Be mother of a boy.

title: Sukta 82 · A charm to win a bride
deity: A charm to win a bride
text:
जायाकामना।
१-३ भगः। इन्द्रः। अनुष्टुप्।
आ॒गच्छ॑त॒ आग॑तस्य॒ नाम॑ गृह्णाम्याय॒तः ।
इन्द्र॑स्य वृत्र॒घ्नो व॑न्वे वास॒वस्य॑ श॒तक्र॑तोः ॥१॥
येन॑ सू॒र्यां सा॑वि॒त्रीम॒श्विनो॒हतुः॑ प॒था।
तेन॒ माम॑ब्रवी॒द् भगो॑ जा॒यामा व॑हता॒दिति॑ ॥२॥
यस्ते॑ऽङ्कु॒शो व॑सु॒दानो॑ बृ॒हन्नि॑न्द्र हिर॒ण्ययः॑ ।
तेना॑ जनीय॒ते जा॒यां मह्यं॑ धेहि शचीपते ॥३॥
translation_en:
I call the name of him who comes, hath come, and still draws- nigh to us. Foe-slaying Indra's name I love, the Vasus' friend with hundred powers.

Thus Bhaga spake to me: Let him bring thee a consort by the path. Whereon the Asvins brought the bride Sūryā the child of Savitar.

Great, Indra. is that hook of thine, bestowing treasure, wrought of gold: Therewith, O Lord of Might, bestow a wife on me who long to wed.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 82 · A charm to win a bride - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to win a bride की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to win a bride स्तुति]: I call the name of him who comes, hath come, and still draws- nigh to us. Foe-slaying Indra's name I love, the Vasus' friend with hundred powers.

2. [A charm to win a bride स्तुति]: Thus Bhaga spake to me: Let him bring thee a consort by the path. Whereon the Asvins brought the bride Sūryā the child of Savitar.

3. [A charm to win a bride स्तुति]: Great, Indra. is that hook of thine, bestowing treasure, wrought of gold: Therewith, O Lord of Might, bestow a wife on me who long to wed.

title: Sukta 83 · A charm against sores and pustules (apachitas)
deity: A charm against sores and pustules (apachitas)
text:
भैषज्यम्।
१-४ भगः। २ सूर्यः, चन्द्रमाः, २ रोहिणी, ३ रामायणी। अनुष्टुप्, ४ एकावसाना द्विपदा निचृदार्च्यनुष्टुप्।
अप॑चितः॒ प्र प॑तत सुप॒र्णो व॑स॒तेरि॑व ।
सूर्यः॑ कृ॒णोतु॑ भेष॒जं च॒न्द्रमा॒ वोऽपो॑च्छतु ॥१॥
एन्येका॒ श्येन्येका॑ कृ॒ष्णैका॒ रोहि॑णी॒ द्वे।
सर्वा॑सामग्रभं॒ नामावी॑रघ्नी॒रपे॑तन ॥२॥
अ॒सूति॑का रामाय॒ण्यऽप॒चित् प्र प॑तिष्यति ।
ग्लरि॒तः प्र प॑तिष्यति॒ स ग॑लु॒न्तो न॑शिष्यति ॥३॥
वी॒हि स्वामाहु॑तिं जुषा॒णो मन॑सा॒ स्वाहा॒ मन॑सा॒ यदि॒दं जु॒होमि॑ ॥४॥
translation_en:
Hence, Sores and Pustules, fly away even as the eagle from his home. Let Sūrya bring a remedy, the Moon shine forth and banish you.

One bright with variegated tints, one white, one black, a couple red:— The'names of all have I declared. Begone, and injure not our men.

Hence, childless, shall the Pustule flee, grand-daughter of the dusky one. The Boil shall fly away from us, the morbid growth shall vanish hence. Taste, happy in thy mind, thine own oblation, as I with Svāhā with my heart present it.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 83 · A charm against sores and pustules (apachitas) - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm against sores and pustules (apachitas) की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm against sores and pustules (apachitas) स्तुति]: Hence, Sores and Pustules, fly away even as the eagle from his home. Let Sūrya bring a remedy, the Moon shine forth and banish you.

2. [A charm against sores and pustules (apachitas) स्तुति]: One bright with variegated tints, one white, one black, a couple red:— The'names of all have I declared. Begone, and injure not our men.

3. [A charm against sores and pustules (apachitas) स्तुति]: Hence, childless, shall the Pustule flee, grand-daughter of the dusky one. The Boil shall fly away from us, the morbid growth shall vanish hence. Taste, happy in thy mind, thine own oblation, as I with Svāhā with my heart present it.

title: Sukta 84 · A charm to accompany the symbolical loosing of sacrificial victims
deity: A charm to accompany the symbolical loosing of sacrificial victims
text:
निर्ऋतिमोचनम्।
१-४ भगः।निर्ऋतिः। १ भुरिग्जगती, २ त्रिपदार्षी बृहती, ३ जगती, ४ भुरिक् त्रिष्टुप् (जगती)
यस्या॑स्त आ॒सनि॑ घो॒रे जु॒होम्ये॒षां ब॒द्धाना॑मव॒सर्ज॑नाय॒ कम्।
भूमि॒रिति॑ त्वाभि॒प्रम॑न्वते॒ जना॒ निरृ॑ति॒रिति॑ त्वा॒हं परि॑ वेद स॒र्वतः॑ ॥१॥
भूते॑ ह॒विष्म॑ती भवै॒ष ते॑ भा॒गो यो अ॒स्मासु॑ ।
मु॒ञ्चेमान॒मूनेन॑सः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥२॥
ए॒वो ष्व॑१स्मन्नि॑रृतेऽने॒हा त्वम॑य॒स्मया॒न् वि चृ॑ता बन्धपा॒शान्।
य॒मो मह्यं॒ पुन॒रित् त्वां द॑दाति॒ तस्मै॑ य॒माय॒ नमो॑ अस्तु मृ॒त्यवे॑ ॥३॥
अ॒य॒स्मये॑ द्रुप॒दे बे॑धिष इ॒हाभिहि॑तो मृ॒त्युभि॒र्ये स॒हस्र॑म्।
य॒मेन॒ त्वं पि॒तृभिः॑ संविदा॒न उ॑त्त॒मं नाक॒मधि॑ रोहये॒मम्॥४॥
translation_en:
Thou in whose dread mouth I present oblation, that these bound victims may obtain their freedom, The people deem that thou art Earth: I know thee thoroughly, and I say thou art Destruction.

Be thou enriched, O Welfare, with oblations, here among us is thine allotted portion. Free—Hail to thee!—from sin those here and yonder.

Do thou, Destruction, thus, without a rival, release us from the iron bonds that hind us. To me doth Yama verily restore thee. To him, to Yama, yea, to Death be worship!

Thou hast been fastened to an iron pillar, here compassed with a thousand deaths around thee. In full accord with Yama and the Fathers, send this man up- ward to the loftiest heaven.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 84 · A charm to accompany the symbolical loosing of sacrificial victims - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to accompany the symbolical loosing of sacrificial victims की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to accompany the symbolical loosing of sacrificial victims स्तुति]: Thou in whose dread mouth I present oblation, that these bound victims may obtain their freedom, The people deem that thou art Earth: I know thee thoroughly, and I say thou art Destruction.

2. [A charm to accompany the symbolical loosing of sacrificial victims स्तुति]: Be thou enriched, O Welfare, with oblations, here among us is thine allotted portion. Free—Hail to thee!—from sin those here and yonder.

3. [A charm to accompany the symbolical loosing of sacrificial victims स्तुति]: Do thou, Destruction, thus, without a rival, release us from the iron bonds that hind us. To me doth Yama verily restore thee. To him, to Yama, yea, to Death be worship!

4. [A charm to accompany the symbolical loosing of sacrificial victims स्तुति]: Thou hast been fastened to an iron pillar, here compassed with a thousand deaths around thee. In full accord with Yama and the Fathers, send this man up- ward to the loftiest heaven.

title: Sukta 85 · A charm against Consumption
deity: A charm against Consumption
text:
यक्ष्मनाशनम्।
१-३ अथर्वा। वनस्पतिः। अनुष्टुप्।
व॒र॒णो वा॑रयाता अ॒यं दे॒वो वन॒स्पतिः॑ ।
यक्ष्मो॒ यो अ॒स्मिन्नावि॑ष्ट॒स्तमु॑ दे॒वा अ॑वीवरन्॥१॥
इन्द्र॑स्य॒ वच॑सा व॒यं मि॒त्रस्य॒ वरु॑णस्य च ।
दे॒वानां॒ सर्वे॑षां वा॒चा यक्ष्मं॑ ते वारयामहे ॥२॥
यथा॑ वृ॒त्र इ॒मा आप॑स्त॒स्तम्भ॑ वि॒श्वधा॑ य॒तीः ।
ए॒वा ते॑ अ॒ग्निना॒ यक्ष्मं॑ वैश्वान॒रेण॑ वारये ॥३॥
translation_en:
Let Varana the heavenly tree here present keep disease away. The Gods have driven off Decline that entered and possessed this man.

We with the speech of Indra and of Mitra and of Varuna. We with the speech of all the Gods will drive Decline away from thee.

Even as Vritra checked and stayed these waters flowing every way, With Agni, God of all mankind. I check and banish thy Decline.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 85 · A charm against Consumption - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm against Consumption की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm against Consumption स्तुति]: Let Varana the heavenly tree here present keep disease away. The Gods have driven off Decline that entered and possessed this man.

2. [A charm against Consumption स्तुति]: We with the speech of Indra and of Mitra and of Varuna. We with the speech of all the Gods will drive Decline away from thee.

3. [A charm against Consumption स्तुति]: Even as Vritra checked and stayed these waters flowing every way, With Agni, God of all mankind. I check and banish thy Decline.

title: Sukta 86 · A glorification of a newly consecrated King
deity: A glorification of a newly consecrated King
text:
वृषकामना।
१-३ अथर्वा। एकवृषः। अनुष्टुप्।
वृषेन्द्र॑स्य॒ वृषा॑ दि॒वो वृषा॑ पृथि॒व्या अ॒यम्।
वृषा॒ विश्व॑स्य भू॒तस्य॒ त्वमे॑कवृ॒षो भ॑व ॥१॥
स॒मु॒द्र ई॑शे स्र॒वता॑म॒ग्निः पृ॑थि॒व्या व॒शी।
च॒न्द्रमा॒ नक्ष॑त्राणामीशे॒ त्वमे॑कवृ॒षो भ॑व ॥२॥
स॒म्राड॒स्यसु॑राणां क॒कुन्म॑नु॒ष्याऽणाम्।
दे॒वाना॑मर्ध॒भाग॑सि॒ त्वमे॑कवृ॒षो भ॑व ॥३॥
translation_en:
This is the Lord of Indra, this the Lord of Heaven, the Lord of Earth, The Lord of all existing things: the one and only Lord be thou,

The Sea is regent of the floods, Agni is ruler of the land, The Moon is regent of the stars: the one and only Lord be thou.

Thou art the King of Asuras, the crown and summit of man- kind: Thou art the partner of the Gods: the one and only Lord be thou.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 86 · A glorification of a newly consecrated King - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A glorification of a newly consecrated King की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A glorification of a newly consecrated King स्तुति]: This is the Lord of Indra, this the Lord of Heaven, the Lord of Earth, The Lord of all existing things: the one and only Lord be thou,

2. [A glorification of a newly consecrated King स्तुति]: The Sea is regent of the floods, Agni is ruler of the land, The Moon is regent of the stars: the one and only Lord be thou.

3. [A glorification of a newly consecrated King स्तुति]: Thou art the King of Asuras, the crown and summit of man- kind: Thou art the partner of the Gods: the one and only Lord be thou.

title: Sukta 87 · A benediction addressed to a newly elected King
deity: A benediction addressed to a newly elected King
text:
राज्ञः संवरणम्।
१-३ अथर्वा। ध्रुवः। अनुष्टुप्।
आ त्वा॑हार्षम॒न्तर॑भूर्ध्रु॒वस्ति॒ष्ठावि॑चाचलत्।
विश॑स्त्वा॒ सर्वा॑ वाञ्छन्तु॒ मा त्वद् रा॒ष्ट्रमधि॑ भ्रशत्॥१॥
इ॒हैवैधि॒ माप॑ च्योष्ठाः॒ पर्व॑त इ॒वावि॑चाचलत्।
इन्द्र॑ इवे॒ह ध्रु॒वस्ति॑ष्ठे॒ह रा॒ष्ट्रमु॑ धारय ॥२॥
इन्द्र॑ ए॒तम॑दीधरत् ध्रु॒वं ध्रु॒वेण॑ ह॒विषा॑ ।
तस्मै॒ सोमो॒ अधि॑ ब्रवद॒यं च॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पतिः॑ ॥३॥
translation_en:
Here art thou: I have chosen thee. Stand stedfast and immov- able. Let all the clans desire thee: let not thy kingdom fall away.

Be even here: fall not away: be like a mountain unremoved. Stand stedfast here like Indra's self, and hold the kingship in the grasp.

This man hath Indra stablished, made secure by constant sacri- fice. Soma, and Brāhmanaspati here present bless and comfort him!
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 87 · A benediction addressed to a newly elected King - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A benediction addressed to a newly elected King की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A benediction addressed to a newly elected King स्तुति]: Here art thou: I have chosen thee. Stand stedfast and immov- able. Let all the clans desire thee: let not thy kingdom fall away.

2. [A benediction addressed to a newly elected King स्तुति]: Be even here: fall not away: be like a mountain unremoved. Stand stedfast here like Indra's self, and hold the kingship in the grasp.

3. [A benediction addressed to a newly elected King स्तुति]: This man hath Indra stablished, made secure by constant sacri- fice. Soma, and Brāhmanaspati here present bless and comfort him!

title: Sukta 88 · A benediction addressed to a newly elected King
deity: A benediction addressed to a newly elected King
text:
ध्रुवो राजा।
१-३ अथर्वा। ध्रुवः। अनुष्टुप्, ३ त्रिष्टुप्।
ध्रु॒वा द्यौर्ध्रु॒वा पृ॑थि॒वी ध्रु॒वं विश्व॑मि॒दं जग॑त्।
ध्रु॒वासः॒ पर्व॑ता इ॒मे ध्रु॒वो राजा॑ वि॒शाम॒यम्॥१॥
ध्रु॒वं ते॒ राजा॒ वरु॑णो ध्रु॒वं दे॒वो बृह॒स्पतिः॑ ।
ध्रु॒वं त॒ इन्द्र॑श्चा॒ग्निश्च॑ रा॒ष्ट्रं धा॑रयतां ध्रु॒वम्॥२॥
ध्रु॒वोऽच्यु॑तः॒ प्र मृ॑णीहि॒ शत्रू॑न्छत्रूय॒तोऽध॑रान् पादयस्व ।
सर्वा॒ दिशः॒ संम॑नसः स॒ध्रीची॑र्ध्रु॒वाय॑ ते॒ समि॑तिः कल्पतामि॒ह॥३॥
translation_en:
Firm is the sky, firm is the earth, and firm is all this living world; Firm are these mountains on their base, and stedfast is this King of men.

Stedfast may Varuna the King, stedfast the God Brihaspati, Stedfast may Indra stedfast, too, may Agni keep thy stedfast reign.

Firm, never to be shaken, crush thy foemen, under thy feet lay those who strive against thee. One-minded, true to thee be all the regions: faithful to thee, the firm, be this assembly!
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 88 · A benediction addressed to a newly elected King - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A benediction addressed to a newly elected King की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।
