1. [A benediction addressed to a newly elected King स्तुति]: Firm is the sky, firm is the earth, and firm is all this living world; Firm are these mountains on their base, and stedfast is this King of men.

2. [A benediction addressed to a newly elected King स्तुति]: Stedfast may Varuna the King, stedfast the God Brihaspati, Stedfast may Indra stedfast, too, may Agni keep thy stedfast reign.

3. [A benediction addressed to a newly elected King स्तुति]: Firm, never to be shaken, crush thy foemen, under thy feet lay those who strive against thee. One-minded, true to thee be all the regions: faithful to thee, the firm, be this assembly!

title: Sukta 89 · A man's love charm
deity: A man's love charm
text:
प्रीतिसंजननम्।
१-३ अथर्वा। (रुद्रः,) १ सोमः, २ वातः, ३ मित्रावरुणौ। अनुष्टुप्।
इ॒दं यत् प्रे॒ण्यः शिरो॑ द॒त्तं सोमे॑न॒ वृष्ण्य॑म्।
ततः॒ परि॒ प्रजा॑तेन॒ हार्दिं॑ ते शोचयामसि ॥१॥
शो॒चया॑मसि ते॒ हार्दिं॑ शो॒चया॑मसि ते॒ मनः॑ ।
वातं॑ धू॒म इ॑व स॒ध्र्य॑१ङ्मामे॒वान्वे॑तु ते॒ मनः॑ ॥२॥
मह्यं॑ त्वा मि॒त्रावरु॑णौ॒ मह्यं॑ दे॒वी सर॑स्वती ।
मह्यं॑ त्वा॒ मध्यं॒ भूम्या॑ उ॒भावन्तौ॒ सम॑स्यताम्॥३॥
translation_en:
This strength that Soma hath bestowed, the head of her who gladdeneth,— With that which thence hath been produced we make thy spirit sorrowful.

We make thy spirit sorrowful, we fill thy mind with pain and grief. As smoke accompanies the wind, so let thy fancy follow me.

May Varuna and Mitra, may Sarasvati the Goddess, May the centre of the earth, and both her limits bring thee close to me.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 89 · A man's love charm - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A man's love charm की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A man's love charm स्तुति]: This strength that Soma hath bestowed, the head of her who gladdeneth,— With that which thence hath been produced we make thy spirit sorrowful.

2. [A man's love charm स्तुति]: We make thy spirit sorrowful, we fill thy mind with pain and grief. As smoke accompanies the wind, so let thy fancy follow me.

3. [A man's love charm स्तुति]: May Varuna and Mitra, may Sarasvati the Goddess, May the centre of the earth, and both her limits bring thee close to me.

title: Sukta 90 · A charm to cure a poisoned man
deity: A charm to cure a poisoned man
text:
इषुनिष्कासनम्।
१-३ अथर्वा। रुद्रः। अनुष्टुप्, ३ आर्षी भुरिगुष्णिक्।
यां ते॑ रु॒द्र इषु॒मास्य॒दङ्गे॑भ्यो॒ हृद॑याय च ।
इ॒दं ताम॒द्य त्वद् व॒यं विषू॑चीं॒ वि वृ॑हामसि ॥१॥
यास्ते॑ श॒तं ध॒मन॒योऽङ्गा॒न्यनु॒ विष्ठि॑ताः ।
तासां॑ ते॒ सर्वा॑सां व॒यं निर्वि॒षाणि॑ ह्वयामसि ॥२॥
नम॑स्ते रु॒द्रास्य॑ते॒ नमः॒ प्रति॑हितायै ।
नमो॑ विसृ॒ज्यमा॑नायै॒ नमो॒ निप॑तितायै ॥३॥
translation_en:
The shaft that Rudra hath shot forth against thy members and thy heart, Here do we draw from thee to-day, and turn it hence to every side.

From all the hundred vessels spread throughout the members of thy frame. From all those vessels and canals we call the poisonous matter forth.

Worship to thee, the archer, and O Rudra, to thy levelled shaft! Yea, worship to thine arrow when it left the bow, and when it fell!
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 90 · A charm to cure a poisoned man - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to cure a poisoned man की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to cure a poisoned man स्तुति]: The shaft that Rudra hath shot forth against thy members and thy heart, Here do we draw from thee to-day, and turn it hence to every side.

2. [A charm to cure a poisoned man स्तुति]: From all the hundred vessels spread throughout the members of thy frame. From all those vessels and canals we call the poisonous matter forth.

3. [A charm to cure a poisoned man स्तुति]: Worship to thee, the archer, and O Rudra, to thy levelled shaft! Yea, worship to thine arrow when it left the bow, and when it fell!

title: Sukta 91 · A charm against disease
deity: A charm against disease
text:
यक्ष्मनाशनम्।
१-३ भृग्वङ्गिराः। यक्ष्मनाशनम्, ३ आपः। अनुष्टुप्।
इ॒मं यव॑मष्टायो॒गैः ष॑ड्यो॒गेभि॑रचर्कृषुः ।
तेना॑ ते त॒न्वो॒३रपो॑ ऽपा॒चीन॒मप॑ व्यये ॥१॥
न्य॑१ग्वातो॑ वाति॒ न्यऽक् तपति॑ सूर्यः॑ ।
नी॒चीन॑म॒घ्न्या दु॑हे॒ न्यऽग् भवतु ते॒ रपः॑ ॥२॥
आप॒ इद् वा उ॑ भेष॒जीरापो॑ अमीव॒चात॑नीः ।
आपो॑ विश्व॑स्य भेष॒जीस्तास्ते॑ कृण्वन्तु भेष॒जम्॥३॥
translation_en:
They made this barley ready with a team of eight, a team of six. With this I drive to westward, far away, thy bodily disease.

Vita breathes downward from above, and downward Sūrya sends his heat: Downward is drawn the milch-cow's milk: so downward go thy malady!

The Waters verily bring health, the Waters drive disease away. The Waters cure all malady: may they bring medicine for thee.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 91 · A charm against disease - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm against disease की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm against disease स्तुति]: They made this barley ready with a team of eight, a team of six. With this I drive to westward, far away, thy bodily disease.

2. [A charm against disease स्तुति]: Vita breathes downward from above, and downward Sūrya sends his heat: Downward is drawn the milch-cow's milk: so downward go thy malady!

3. [A charm against disease स्तुति]: The Waters verily bring health, the Waters drive disease away. The Waters cure all malady: may they bring medicine for thee.

title: Sukta 92 · A charm to strengthen and inspirit a war-horse
deity: A charm to strengthen and inspirit a war-horse
text:
वाजी।
१-३ अथर्वा। इन्द्रः, वाजी। त्रिष्टुप्, १ जगती।
वात॑रम्हा भव वाजिन् यु॒ज्यमा॑न॒ इन्द्र॑स्य याहि प्रस॒वे मनो॑जवाः ।
यु॒ञ्जन्तु॑ त्वा म॒रुतो॑ वि॒श्ववे॑दस॒ आ ते॒ त्वष्टा॑ प॒त्सु ज॒वं द॑धातु ॥१॥
ज॒वस्ते॑ अर्व॒न् निहि॑तो॒ गुहा॒ यः श्ये॒ने वात॑ उ॒त योऽच॑र॒त् परी॑त्तः ।
तेन॒ त्वं वा॑जि॒न् बल॑वा॒न् बले॑ना॒जिं ज॑य॒ सम॑ने पारयि॒ष्णुः ॥२॥
त॒नूष्टे॑ वाजिन् त॒न्वं॑१ नय॑न्ती वा॒मम॒स्मभ्यं॒ धाव॑तु॒ शर्म॒ तुभ्य॑म्।
अह्रु॑तो म॒हो ध॒रुणा॑य दे॒वो दि॒वीऽव ज्योतिः॒ स्वमा मि॑मीयात्॥३॥
translation_en:
Be fleet as wind, Strong Steed, when thou art harnessed; go forth as swift as thought at lndra's sending. Let the possessors of all wealth, the Maruts, yoke thee, and Tvashtar in thy feet lay swiftness.

That speed, that lies concealed in thee, O Charger, speed granted to the hawk or wind that wandered, Therewith, Strong Steed, saving in shock of battle endowed with might by might win thou the contest.

Bearing thy body, Charger, may thy body run blessing us and winning thee protection. May he, unswerving, to uphold the mighty, stablish his lustre as a God in heaven.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 92 · A charm to strengthen and inspirit a war-horse - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to strengthen and inspirit a war-horse की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to strengthen and inspirit a war-horse स्तुति]: Be fleet as wind, Strong Steed, when thou art harnessed; go forth as swift as thought at lndra's sending. Let the possessors of all wealth, the Maruts, yoke thee, and Tvashtar in thy feet lay swiftness.

2. [A charm to strengthen and inspirit a war-horse स्तुति]: That speed, that lies concealed in thee, O Charger, speed granted to the hawk or wind that wandered, Therewith, Strong Steed, saving in shock of battle endowed with might by might win thou the contest.

3. [A charm to strengthen and inspirit a war-horse स्तुति]: Bearing thy body, Charger, may thy body run blessing us and winning thee protection. May he, unswerving, to uphold the mighty, stablish his lustre as a God in heaven.

title: Sukta 93 · A prayer for protection from poison
deity: A prayer for protection from poison
text:
स्वस्त्ययनम्।
१-३ शन्तातिः। रुद्रः, १ यमो, मृत्युः, शर्वः, २ भवः, शर्वः
३ विश्वे देवाः, मरुतः, अग्नीषोमौ, वरुणः, वातपर्जन्यौ। त्रिष्टुप्।
य॒मो मृ॒त्युर॑घमा॒रो नि॑रृ॒थो ब॒भ्रुः श॒र्वोऽस्ता॒ नील॑शिखण्डः ।
दे॒व॒ज॒नाः सेन॑योत्तस्थि॒वांस॒स्ते अ॒स्माकं॒ परि॑ वृञ्जन्तु वी॒रान्॥१॥
मन॑सा॒ होमै॒र्हर॑सा घृ॒तेन॑ श॒र्वायास्त्र॑ उ॒त राज्ञे॑ भ॒वाय॑ ।
न॒म॒स्येऽभ्यो॒ नम॑ एभ्यः कृणोम्य॒न्यत्रा॒स्मद॒घवि॑षा नयन्तु ॥२॥
त्राय॑ध्वं नो अ॒घवि॑षाभ्यो व॒धाद् विश्वे॑ देवा मरुतो विश्ववेदसः ।
अ॒ग्नीषोमा॒ वरु॑णः पू॒तद॑क्षा वातापर्ज॒न्ययोः॑ सुम॒तौ स्या॑म ॥३॥
translation_en:
Yama, Death direly fatal, the Destroyer, with his black crest, Sarva the tawny archer, And all the Gods uprisen with their army, may these on every side avoid our heroes.

With mind, burnt offerings, butter, and libation, to royal Bhava and the archer Sarva, To these the worshipful I pay my worshimay they turn else- where things with deadly venom.

Save us, All-Gods and all-possessing Maruts, from murderous stroke and things that slay with poison. Pure is the might of Varuna, Agni, Soma. May Vāta's and Parjanya's favour bless us.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 93 · A prayer for protection from poison - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for protection from poison की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for protection from poison स्तुति]: Yama, Death direly fatal, the Destroyer, with his black crest, Sarva the tawny archer, And all the Gods uprisen with their army, may these on every side avoid our heroes.

2. [A prayer for protection from poison स्तुति]: With mind, burnt offerings, butter, and libation, to royal Bhava and the archer Sarva, To these the worshipful I pay my worshimay they turn else- where things with deadly venom.

3. [A prayer for protection from poison स्तुति]: Save us, All-Gods and all-possessing Maruts, from murderous stroke and things that slay with poison. Pure is the might of Varuna, Agni, Soma. May Vāta's and Parjanya's favour bless us.

title: Sukta 94 · A charm to reconcile a King's discontented people
deity: A charm to reconcile a King's discontented people
text:
सांमनस्यम्।
१-३ अथर्वाङ्गिराः। सरस्वती। अनुष्टुप्, २ विराड्-जगती।
सं वो॒ मनां॑सि॒ सं व्र॒ता समाकू॑तीर्नमामसि ।
अ॒मी ये विव्र॑ता॒ स्थन॒ तान् वः॒ सं न॑मयामसि ॥१॥
अ॒हं गृ॑भ्णामि॒ मन॑सा॒ मनां॑सि॒ मम॑ चि॒त्तमनु॑ चि॒त्तेभि॒रेत॑ ।
मम॒ वशे॑षु॒ हृद॑यानि वः कृणोमि॒ मम॑ या॒तमनु॑वर्त्मान॒ एत॑ ॥२॥
ओते॑ मे॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी ओता॑ दे॒वी सर॑स्वती ।
ओतौ॑ म॒ इन्द्र॑श्चा॒ग्निश्च॒र्ध्यास्मे॒दं स॑रस्वति ॥३॥
translation_en:
We bend your minds in union, bend in harmony your hopes and plans: You there, who turn to sundered ways, we bend and bow in unison.

I with my spirit make your spirits captive: these with their thoughts follow my thought and wishes. I make your hearts submissive to mine order closely attending go where I precede you.

I have invoked both Heaven and Earth, invoked divine Sarasvati, Indra and Agni have I called: Sarasvati, so may we thrive!
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 94 · A charm to reconcile a King's discontented people - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to reconcile a King's discontented people की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to reconcile a King's discontented people स्तुति]: We bend your minds in union, bend in harmony your hopes and plans: You there, who turn to sundered ways, we bend and bow in unison.

2. [A charm to reconcile a King's discontented people स्तुति]: I with my spirit make your spirits captive: these with their thoughts follow my thought and wishes. I make your hearts submissive to mine order closely attending go where I precede you.

3. [A charm to reconcile a King's discontented people स्तुति]: I have invoked both Heaven and Earth, invoked divine Sarasvati, Indra and Agni have I called: Sarasvati, so may we thrive!

title: Sukta 95 · A charm to remove disease
deity: A charm to remove disease
text:
कुष्ठौषधिः।
१-३ भृग्वङ्गिराः। वनस्पतिः। अनुष्टुप्।
अ॒श्व॒त्थो दे॑व॒सद॑नस्तृ॒तीय॑स्यामि॒तो दि॒वि।
तत्रा॒मृत॑स्य॒ चक्ष॑णं दे॒वाः कुष्ठ॑मवन्वत ॥१॥
हि॒र॒ण्ययी॒ नौर॑चर॒द्धिर॑ण्यबन्धना दि॒वि।
तत्रा॒मृत॑स्य॒ पुष्पं॑ दे॒वाः कुष्ठ॑मवन्वत ॥२॥
गर्भो॑ अ॒स्योष॑धीनां॒ गर्भो॑ हि॒मव॑तामु॒त।
गर्भो॒ विश्व॑स्य भू॒तस्ये॒मं मे॑ अग॒दं कृ॑धि ॥३॥
translation_en:
In the third heaven above us stands the Asvattha tree, the seat of Gods. There the Gods gained the Kushtha plant, embodiment of end- less life.

There moved through heaven a golden ship, a ship with cordage wrought of gold. There Gods obtained the Kushtha plant, the flower of immor- tality.

Thou art the infant of the plants, the infant of the Snowy Hills: The germ of every thing that is: free this my friend from his disease.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 95 · A charm to remove disease - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to remove disease की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to remove disease स्तुति]: In the third heaven above us stands the Asvattha tree, the seat of Gods. There the Gods gained the Kushtha plant, embodiment of end- less life.

2. [A charm to remove disease स्तुति]: There moved through heaven a golden ship, a ship with cordage wrought of gold. There Gods obtained the Kushtha plant, the flower of immor- tality.

3. [A charm to remove disease स्तुति]: Thou art the infant of the plants, the infant of the Snowy Hills: The germ of every thing that is: free this my friend from his disease.

title: Sukta 96 · A prayer for deliverance from sin and sorrow
deity: A prayer for deliverance from sin and sorrow
text:
चिकित्सा।
१-३ भृग्वङ्गिराः। वनस्पतिः, ३ सोमः। अनुष्टुप्, ३ त्रिपाद्विराण्नाम गायत्री।
या ओष॑धयः॒ सोम॑राज्ञीर्ब॒ह्वीः श॒तवि॑चक्षणाः ।
बृह॒स्पति॑प्रसूता॒स्ता नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥१॥
मु॒ञ्चन्तु॑ मा शप॒थ्या॒३दथो॑ वरु॒ण्याऽदु॒त।
अथो॑ य॒मस्य॒ पड्वी॑शाद् विश्व॑स्माद् देवकिल्बि॒षात्॥२॥
यच्चक्षु॑षा॒ मन॑सा॒ यच्च॑ वा॒चोपा॑रि॒म जाग्र॑तो॒ यत् स्व॒पन्तः॑ ।
सोम॒स्तानि॑ स्व॒धया॑ नः पुनातु ॥३॥
translation_en:
The many plants of hundred shapes and forms that Soma rules as King, Commanded by Brihaspati, deliver us from grief and woe!

Let them release me from the curse and from the noose of Varupa, Free me from Yama's fetter, and from every sin against the Gods!

From every fault in look, in word, in spirit that we, awake or sleeping, have committed, May Soma, with his godlike nature, cleanse us.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 96 · A prayer for deliverance from sin and sorrow - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for deliverance from sin and sorrow की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for deliverance from sin and sorrow स्तुति]: The many plants of hundred shapes and forms that Soma rules as King, Commanded by Brihaspati, deliver us from grief and woe!

2. [A prayer for deliverance from sin and sorrow स्तुति]: Let them release me from the curse and from the noose of Varupa, Free me from Yama's fetter, and from every sin against the Gods!

3. [A prayer for deliverance from sin and sorrow स्तुति]: From every fault in look, in word, in spirit that we, awake or sleeping, have committed, May Soma, with his godlike nature, cleanse us.

title: Sukta 97 · A prayer for the success and prosperity of a King
deity: A prayer for the success and prosperity of a King
text:
अभिभूर्वीरः
-३ अथर्वा। १,३ देवाः, २ मित्रावरुणौ। १ त्रिष्टुप्, २ जगती, ३ भुरिक्।
अ॒भि॒भूर्य॒ज्ञो अ॑भि॒भूर॒ग्निर॑भि॒भूः सोमो॑ अभि॒भूरिन्द्रः॑ ।
अ॒भ्य॑हं विश्वाः॒ पृत॑ना॒ यथासा॑न्ये॒वा वि॑धेमा॒ग्निहो॑त्रा इ॒दं ह॒विः ॥१॥
स्व॒धास्तु॑ मित्रावरुणा विपश्चिता प्र॒जाव॑त् क्ष॒त्रं मधु॑ने॒ह पि॑न्वतम्।
बाधे॑थां दू॒रं निरृ॑तिं परा॒चैः कृ॒तं चि॒देनः॒ प्र मु॑मुक्तम॒स्मत्॥२॥
इ॒मं वी॒रमनु॑ हर्षध्वमु॒ग्रमिन्द्रं॑ सखायो॒ अनु॒ सं र॑भध्वम्।
ग्रा॒म॒जितं॑ गो॒जितं॒ वज्र॑बाहुं॒ जय॑न्त॒मज्म॑ प्रमृ॒णन्त॒मोज॑सा ॥३॥
translation_en:
The sacrifice is victor, Agni victor, victorious is Soma, Indra conquers: So will we bring oblation unto Agni, this sacrifice that I may win all battles.

Praise to you, Mitra-Varupa, hymn-singers! Here swell with meath dominion blest with children. Far into distant regions drive Destruction, and even from committed sin absolve us.

In this strong hero be ye glad and joyful: cleave ye to him even as ye cleave to Indra. Victorious, kine-winner, thunder-wielder, who quells a host and with his might destroys it.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 97 · A prayer for the success and prosperity of a King - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for the success and prosperity of a King की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for the success and prosperity of a King स्तुति]: The sacrifice is victor, Agni victor, victorious is Soma, Indra conquers: So will we bring oblation unto Agni, this sacrifice that I may win all battles.

2. [A prayer for the success and prosperity of a King स्तुति]: Praise to you, Mitra-Varupa, hymn-singers! Here swell with meath dominion blest with children. Far into distant regions drive Destruction, and even from committed sin absolve us.

3. [A prayer for the success and prosperity of a King स्तुति]: In this strong hero be ye glad and joyful: cleave ye to him even as ye cleave to Indra. Victorious, kine-winner, thunder-wielder, who quells a host and with his might destroys it.

title: Sukta 98 · Praise of Indra
deity: Praise of Indra
text:
अजरं क्षत्रम्।
१-३ अथर्वाः। इन्द्रः। त्रिष्टुप्, २ बृहतीगर्भास्तारपङ्क्तिः।
इन्द्रो॑ जयाति॒ न परा॑ जयाता अधिरा॒जो राज॑सु राजयातै ।
च॒र्कृत्य॒ ईड्यो॒ वन्द्य॑श्चोप॒सद्यो॑ नम॒स्योऽभवे॒ह॥१॥
त्वमि॑न्द्राधिरा॒जः श्र॑व॒स्युस्त्वं भू॑र॒भिभू॑ति॒र्जना॑नाम्।
त्वं दैवी॒र्विश॑ इ॒मा वि रा॒जायु॑ष्मत् क्ष॒त्रम॒जरं॑ ते अस्तु ॥२॥
प्राच्या॑ दि॒शस्त्वमि॑न्द्रासि॒ राजो॒तोदी॑च्या दि॒शो वृ॑त्रहन्छत्रु॒होऽसि ।
यत्र॒ यन्ति॑ स्रो॒त्यास्तज्जि॒तं ते॑ दक्षिण॒तो वृ॑ष॒भ ए॑षि॒ हव्यः॑ ॥३॥
translation_en:
Indra be victor, never to be vanquished, to reign among the Kings as sovran ruler! Here be thou meet for praise and supplication, to be revered and waited on and worshipped.

Thou fain for glory, an imperial ruler, hast won dominion over men, O Indra, Of these celestial tribes be thou the sovran: long-lasting be thy sway and undecaying!

Thou governest the north and eastern regions, Indra! fiend- slayer! thou destroycst foemen. Thou hast won all, far as the rivers wander. Bull, called to help, on our right hand thou goest.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 98 · Praise of Indra - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा Praise of Indra की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [Praise of Indra स्तुति]: Indra be victor, never to be vanquished, to reign among the Kings as sovran ruler! Here be thou meet for praise and supplication, to be revered and waited on and worshipped.

2. [Praise of Indra स्तुति]: Thou fain for glory, an imperial ruler, hast won dominion over men, O Indra, Of these celestial tribes be thou the sovran: long-lasting be thy sway and undecaying!

3. [Praise of Indra स्तुति]: Thou governest the north and eastern regions, Indra! fiend- slayer! thou destroycst foemen. Thou hast won all, far as the rivers wander. Bull, called to help, on our right hand thou goest.

title: Sukta 99 · A prayer for protection in battle
deity: A prayer for protection in battle
text:
संग्रामजयः।
१-३ अथर्वा। इन्द्रः, सोमः, सविता च। अनुष्टुप्, ३ भुरिग्बृहती (सौम्या सावित्री)।
अ॒भि त्वे॑न्द्र॒ वरि॑मतः पु॒रा त्वां॑हूर॒णाद्धु॑वे ।
ह्वया॑म्यु॒ग्रं चे॒त्तारं॑ पु॒रुणा॑मानमेक॒जम्॥१॥
यो अ॒द्य सेन्यो॑ व॒धो जिघां॑सन् न उ॒दीर॑ते ।
इन्द्र॑स्य॒ तत्र॑ बा॒हू स॑म॒न्तं परि॑ दद्मः ॥२॥
परि॑ दद्म॒ इन्द्र॑स्य बा॒हू स॑म॒न्तं त्रा॒तुस्त्राय॑तां नः ।
देव॑ सवितः॒ सोम॑ राजन्त्सु॒मन॑सं मा कृणु स्व॒स्तये॑ ॥३॥
translation_en:
Indra, before affliction comes, I call thee from the wide expanse. The mighty guardian, born alone, wearer of many names, I call.

Whatever deadly missile launched to-day flies forth to slaughter us. We take both arms of Indra to encompass us on every side.

We draw about us both the arms of Indra, our deliverer. May they protect us thoroughly. O Savitar, thou God, O royal Soma, make thou me pious- minded for my welfare.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 99 · A prayer for protection in battle - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for protection in battle की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for protection in battle स्तुति]: Indra, before affliction comes, I call thee from the wide expanse. The mighty guardian, born alone, wearer of many names, I call.

2. [A prayer for protection in battle स्तुति]: Whatever deadly missile launched to-day flies forth to slaughter us. We take both arms of Indra to encompass us on every side.

3. [A prayer for protection in battle स्तुति]: We draw about us both the arms of Indra, our deliverer. May they protect us thoroughly. O Savitar, thou God, O royal Soma, make thou me pious- minded for my welfare.

title: Sukta 100 · A charm against poison
deity: A charm against poison
text:
विषदूषणम्।
१-३ गरुत्मान्। वनस्पतिः। अनुष्टुप्।
दे॒वा अ॑दुः॒ सूर्यो॑ अदाद् द्यौर॑दात् पृथि॒व्यऽदात्।
ति॒स्रः सर॑स्वतिरदुः॒ सचि॑त्ता विष॒दूष॑णम्॥१॥
यद् वो॑ दे॒वा उ॑पजीका॒ आसि॑ञ्च॒न् धन्व॑न्युद॒कम्।
तेन॑ दे॒वप्र॑सूतेने॒दं दू॑षयता वि॒षम्॥२॥
असु॑राणां दुहि॒तासि॒ सा दे॒वाना॑मसि॒ स्वसा॑ ।
दि॒वस्पृ॑थि॒व्याः संभू॑ता॒ सा च॑कर्थार॒सं वि॒षम्॥३॥
translation_en:
The Gods and Sūrya gave the gift, the Earth and Heaven best- owed the boon. The three Sarasvatis in full accord bestowed the antidote.

That water, Upajīkās! which Gods poured for you on thirsty land, With that same water sent by Gods, drive ye away this poison here.

The daughter of the Asuras art thou, and sister of the Gods. Thou who hast sprung from heaven and earth hast robbed the poison of its power.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 100 · A charm against poison - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm against poison की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm against poison स्तुति]: The Gods and Sūrya gave the gift, the Earth and Heaven best- owed the boon. The three Sarasvatis in full accord bestowed the antidote.

2. [A charm against poison स्तुति]: That water, Upajīkās! which Gods poured for you on thirsty land, With that same water sent by Gods, drive ye away this poison here.

3. [A charm against poison स्तुति]: The daughter of the Asuras art thou, and sister of the Gods. Thou who hast sprung from heaven and earth hast robbed the poison of its power.

title: Sukta 101 · A charm to promote virile vigour
deity: A charm to promote virile vigour
text:
वाजीकरणम्।
१-३ अथर्वाङ्गिराः। ब्रह्मणसपतिः। अनुष्टुप्।
आ वृ॑षायस्व श्वसि॒हि वर्ध॑स्व प्र॒थय॑स्व च ।
य॒था॒ङ्गं व॑र्धतां॒ शेप॒स्तेन॑ यो॒षित॒मिज्ज॑हि ॥१॥
येन॑ कृ॒षं वा॒जय॑न्ति॒ येन॑ हि॒न्वन्त्यातु॑रम्।
तेना॒स्य ब्र॑ह्मणस्पते॒ धनु॑रि॒वा ता॑नया॒ पसः॑ ॥२॥
आहं त॑नोमि ते॒ पसो॒ अधि॒ ज्यामि॑व॒ धन्व॑नि ।
क्रम॒स्वर्श॑ इव रो॒हित॒मन॑वग्लायता॒ सदा॑ ॥३॥
translation_en:
Taurum age, palpita, incresce et teipsum extende: per totum membrum increscat penis: hoc tu caede feminam.

Quo debilem stimulant, quo aegrum excitant (homines), hoc, O Brahmanaspatis, hujus penem in arcus modum extende.

Velut nervum in arcu ego tuum fascinum extendo. Aggredere (mulierem) semper indefessus velut cervus damam.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 101 · A charm to promote virile vigour - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to promote virile vigour की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to promote virile vigour स्तुति]: Taurum age, palpita, incresce et teipsum extende: per totum membrum increscat penis: hoc tu caede feminam.

2. [A charm to promote virile vigour स्तुति]: Quo debilem stimulant, quo aegrum excitant (homines), hoc, O Brahmanaspatis, hujus penem in arcus modum extende.

3. [A charm to promote virile vigour स्तुति]: Velut nervum in arcu ego tuum fascinum extendo. Aggredere (mulierem) semper indefessus velut cervus damam.

title: Sukta 102 · A man's love charm
deity: A man's love charm
text:
अभिसांमनस्यम्।
१-३ जमदग्निः। अश्विनौ। अनुष्टुप्।
यथा॒यं वा॒हो अ॑श्विना स॒मैति॒ सं च॒ वर्त॑ते ।
ए॒वा माम॒भि ते॒ मनः॑ स॒मैतु॒ सं च॑ वर्तताम्॥१॥
आहं खि॑दामि ते॒ मनो॑ राजा॒श्वः पृ॒ष्ट्यामि॑व ।
रे॒ष्मच्छि॑न्नं॒ यथा॒ तृणं॒ मयि॑ ते वेष्टतां॒ मनः॑ ॥२॥
आञ्ज॑नस्य म॒दुघ॑स्य॒ कुष्ठ॑स्य॒ नल॑दस्य च ।
तु॒रो भग॑स्य॒ हस्ता॑भ्यामनु॒रोध॑न॒मुद् भ॑रे ॥३॥
translation_en:
Even as this ox, O Asvins, steps and turns together with his mate, So let thy fancy turn itself, come nearer, and unite with me.

I, as the shaft-horse draws the mare beside him, draw thee to myself. Like grass that storm and wind have rent, so be thy mind at- tached to me!

Swiftly from Bhaga's hands I bear away a love-compelling charm Of ointment and of sugar-cane, of Spikenard and the Kushtha plant.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 102 · A man's love charm - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A man's love charm की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A man's love charm स्तुति]: Even as this ox, O Asvins, steps and turns together with his mate, So let thy fancy turn itself, come nearer, and unite with me.

2. [A man's love charm स्तुति]: I, as the shaft-horse draws the mare beside him, draw thee to myself. Like grass that storm and wind have rent, so be thy mind at- tached to me!

3. [A man's love charm स्तुति]: Swiftly from Bhaga's hands I bear away a love-compelling charm Of ointment and of sugar-cane, of Spikenard and the Kushtha plant.

title: Sukta 103 · A charm to check the approach of a hostile army
deity: A charm to check the approach of a hostile army
text:
शत्रुनाशनम्।
१-३ उच्छोचनः।इन्द्राग्नी, १ बृहस्पतिः, सविता, मित्रोः, अर्यमा, भगः,अश्विनौ, २-३ इन्द्रः, अग्निः। अनुष्टुप्।
सं॒दानं॑ वो॒ बृह॒स्पतिः॑ सं॒दानं॑ सवि॒ता क॑रत्।
सं॒दानं॑ मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा सं॒दानं॒ भगो॑ अ॒श्विना॑ ॥१॥
सं प॑र॒मान्त्सम॑व॒मानथो॒ सं द्या॑मि मध्य॒मान्।
इन्द्र॒स्तान् पर्य॑हा॒र्दाम्ना॒ तान॑ग्ने॒ सं द्या॒ त्वम्॥२॥
अ॒मी ये युध॑मा॒यन्ति॑ के॒तून् कृ॒त्वानी॑क॒शः ।
इन्द्र॒स्तान् पर्य॑हा॒र्दाम्न॒ तान॑ग्ने॒ सं द्या॒ त्वम्॥३॥
translation_en:
Brihaspati and Savitar prepare a rope to bind you fast! Let Bhaga, Mitra, Aryaman, and both the Asvins make the bond.

I bind together all of them, the first, the last, the middlemost. Indra hath girded these with cord: bind them together, Agni, thou!

Those yonder who approach to fight, with banners raised along their ranks, Indra hath girded these with cord: bind them together, Agni, thou!
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 103 · A charm to check the approach of a hostile army - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to check the approach of a hostile army की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to check the approach of a hostile army स्तुति]: Brihaspati and Savitar prepare a rope to bind you fast! Let Bhaga, Mitra, Aryaman, and both the Asvins make the bond.

2. [A charm to check the approach of a hostile army स्तुति]: I bind together all of them, the first, the last, the middlemost. Indra hath girded these with cord: bind them together, Agni, thou!

3. [A charm to check the approach of a hostile army स्तुति]: Those yonder who approach to fight, with banners raised along their ranks, Indra hath girded these with cord: bind them together, Agni, thou!

title: Sukta 104 · The same
deity: The same
text:
शत्रुनाशनम्।
१-३ प्रशोचनः। इन्द्राग्नी, ३ इन्द्रानी, सोम इन्द्रश्च। अनुष्टुप्।
आ॒दाने॑न सं॒दाने॑ना॒मित्रा॒ना द्या॑मसि ।
अ॒पा॒ना ये चै॑षां प्रा॒णा असु॒नासू॒न्त्सम॑च्छिदन्॥१॥
इ॒दमा॒दान॑मकरं॒ तप॒सेन्द्रे॑ण॒ संशि॑तम्।
अ॒मित्रा॒ येऽत्र॑ नः॒ सन्ति॒ तान॑ग्न॒ आ द्या॒ त्वम्॥२॥
ऐना॑न् द्यतामिन्द्रा॒ग्नी सोमो॑ राजा॑ च मे॒दिनौ॑ ।
इन्द्रो॑ म॒रुत्वा॑ना॒दान॑म॒मित्रे॑भ्यः कृणोतु नः ॥३॥
translation_en:
We bind our foemen with a bond that binds them close and holds them fast. Their breath and respiration I dissever, and their lives from life.

This bond, made keen by Indra, I have formed with heat of holy zeal. Securely bind our enemies, O Agni, who are standing here.

Indra and Agni bind them fast, Soma the King, and both the Friends! May Indra, girt by Maruts, make a bond to bind our enemies.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 104 · The same - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा The same की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [The same स्तुति]: We bind our foemen with a bond that binds them close and holds them fast. Their breath and respiration I dissever, and their lives from life.

2. [The same स्तुति]: This bond, made keen by Indra, I have formed with heat of holy zeal. Securely bind our enemies, O Agni, who are standing here.

3. [The same स्तुति]: Indra and Agni bind them fast, Soma the King, and both the Friends! May Indra, girt by Maruts, make a bond to bind our enemies.

title: Sukta 105 · A charm to cure cough
deity: A charm to cure cough
text:
कासशमनम्।
१-३ उन्मोचनः। कासा। अनुष्टुप्।
यथा॒ मनो॑ मनस्के॒तः॑ प॑रा॒पत॑त्याशु॒मत्।
ए॒वा त्वं कासे॒ प्र प॑त॒ मन॒सोऽनु॑ प्रवा॒य्यऽम्॥१॥
यथा॒ बाणः॒ सुसं॑शितः परा॒पत॑त्याशु॒मत्।
ए॒वा त्वं कासे॒ प्र प॑त पृथि॒व्या अनु॑ सं॒वत॑म्॥२॥
यथा॒ सूर्य॑स्य र॒श्मयः॑ परा॒पत॑न्त्याशु॒मत्।
ए॒वा त्वं कासे॒ प्र प॑त समु॒द्रस्यानु॑ विक्ष॒रम्॥३॥
translation_en:
Rapidly as the fancy flies forth with conceptions of the mind. So following the fancy's flight, O Cough, flee rapidly away.

Rapidly as an arrow flies away with keenly-sharpened point, So swiftly flee away, O Cough, over the region of the earth!

Rapidly as the beams of light, the rays of Sūrya, fly away, So, Cough! fly rapidly away over the current of the sea!
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 105 · A charm to cure cough - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to cure cough की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to cure cough स्तुति]: Rapidly as the fancy flies forth with conceptions of the mind. So following the fancy's flight, O Cough, flee rapidly away.

2. [A charm to cure cough स्तुति]: Rapidly as an arrow flies away with keenly-sharpened point, So swiftly flee away, O Cough, over the region of the earth!

3. [A charm to cure cough स्तुति]: Rapidly as the beams of light, the rays of Sūrya, fly away, So, Cough! fly rapidly away over the current of the sea!

title: Sukta 106 · A charm to protect a house from fire
deity: A charm to protect a house from fire
text:
दूर्वाशाला
१-३ प्रमोचनः। दूर्वाशाला। अनुष्टुप्।
आय॑ने ते प॒राय॑णे दूर्वा॑ रोहतु पु॒ष्पिणीः॑ ।
उत्सो॑ वा॒ तत्र॒ जाय॑तां ह्रदो वा॑ पु॒ण्डरी॑कवान्॥१॥
अ॒पामि॒दं न्यय॑नं समु॒द्रस्य॑ नि॒वेश॑नम्।
मध्ये॑ ह्र॒दस्य॑ नो गृ॒हाः प॑रा॒चीना॒ मुखा॑ कृधि ॥२॥
हि॒मस्य॑ त्वा ज॒रायु॑णा॒ शाले॒ परि॑ व्ययामसि ।
शी॒तह्र॑दा॒ हि नो॒ भुवो॒ऽग्निष्कृ॑णोतु भेष॒जम्॥३॥
translation_en:
Let flowery Dūrvā grass grow up about thine exit and approach. There let a spring of water rise, or lake with blooming lotuses.

This is the place where waters meet, here is the gathering of the flood. Our home is set amid the lake: turn thou thy jaws away from it.

O House, we compass thee about with coolness to envelop thee. Cool as a lake be thou to us. Let Agni bring us healing balm!
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 106 · A charm to protect a house from fire - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to protect a house from fire की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to protect a house from fire स्तुति]: Let flowery Dūrvā grass grow up about thine exit and approach. There let a spring of water rise, or lake with blooming lotuses.

2. [A charm to protect a house from fire स्तुति]: This is the place where waters meet, here is the gathering of the flood. Our home is set amid the lake: turn thou thy jaws away from it.

3. [A charm to protect a house from fire स्तुति]: O House, we compass thee about with coolness to envelop thee. Cool as a lake be thou to us. Let Agni bring us healing balm!

title: Sukta 107 · A charm to protect men and cattle
deity: A charm to protect men and cattle
text:
विश्वजित्।
१-४ शन्तातिः। विश्वजित्। अनुष्टुप्।
विश्व॑जित् त्रायमा॒णायै॑ मा॒ परि॑ देहि ।
त्राय॑माणे द्वि॒पाच्च॒ सर्वं॑ नो॒ रक्ष॒ चतु॑ष्पा॒द् यच्च॑ नः॒ स्वम्॥१॥
त्राय॑माणे विश्व॒जिते॑ मा॒ परि॑ देहि ।
विश्व॑जिद् द्वि॒पाच्च॒ सर्वं॑ नो॒ रक्ष॒ चतु॑ष्पाद् यच्च॑ नः॒ स्वम्॥२॥
विश्व॑जित् कल्या॒ण्यैऽ मा॒ परि॑ देहि ।
कल्या॑णि द्वि॒पाच्च॒ सर्वं॑ नो॒ रक्ष॒ चतु॑ष्पाद् यच्च॑ नः॒ स्वम्॥३॥
कल्या॑णि सर्व॒विदे॑ मा॒ परि॑ देहि ।
सर्व॑विद् द्वि॒पाच्च॒ सर्वं॑ नो॒ रक्ष॒ चतु॑ष्पाद् यच्च॑ नः॒ स्वम्॥४॥
translation_en:
Entrust me, Visvajit, to Trāyamānā. Guard, Trāyamānā, all our men, guard all our wealth of quadrupeds.

To Visvajit entrust me, Trāyamānā. O Visvajit, guard all our men, etc.

To Visvajit entrust me, O Kalyāni. Guard, O Kalyāni, all our men, etc.

To Sarvavid entrust me, O Kalyāni. O Sarvavid, guard all our men, guard all our wealth of quadrupeds.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 107 · A charm to protect men and cattle - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to protect men and cattle की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to protect men and cattle स्तुति]: Entrust me, Visvajit, to Trāyamānā. Guard, Trāyamānā, all our men, guard all our wealth of quadrupeds.

2. [A charm to protect men and cattle स्तुति]: To Visvajit entrust me, Trāyamānā. O Visvajit, guard all our men, etc.

3. [A charm to protect men and cattle स्तुति]: To Visvajit entrust me, O Kalyāni. Guard, O Kalyāni, all our men, etc.

4. [A charm to protect men and cattle स्तुति]: To Sarvavid entrust me, O Kalyāni. O Sarvavid, guard all our men, guard all our wealth of quadrupeds.

title: Sukta 108 · A prayer for wisdom
deity: A prayer for wisdom
text:
मेधावर्धनम्।
१-५ शौनकः। मेधा, ४ अग्निः। अनुष्टुप्, २ उरोबृहती, ३ पथ्यबृहती।
त्वं नो॑ मेधे प्रथ॒मा गोभि॒रश्वे॑भि॒रा ग॑हि ।
त्वं सूर्य॑स्य र॒श्मिभि॒स्त्वं नो॑ असि य॒ज्ञिया॑ ॥१॥
मे॒धाम॒हं प्र॑थ॒मां ब्रह्म॑ण्वतीं॒ ब्रह्म॑जूता॒मृषि॑ष्टुताम्।
प्रपी॑तां ब्रह्मचा॒रिभि॑र्दे॒वाना॒मव॑से हुवे ॥२॥
यां मे॒धामृ॒भवो॑ वि॒दुर्यां मे॒धामसु॑रा वि॒दुः ।
ऋष॑यो भ॒द्रां मे॒धां यां वि॒दुस्तां मय्या वे॑शयामसि ॥३॥
यामृष॑यो भूत॒कृतो॑ मे॒धां मे॑धा॒विनो॑ वि॒दुः ।
तया॒ माम॒द्य मे॒धयाग्ने॑ मेधा॒विनं॑ कृणु ॥४॥
मे॒धां सा॒यं मे॒धां प्रा॒तर्मे॒धां म॒ध्यन्दि॑नं॒ परि॑ ।
मे॒धां सूर्य॑स्य र॒श्मिभि॒र्वच॒सा वे॑शयामहे ॥५॥
translation_en:
Intelligence, come first to us with store of horses and of kine! Thou with the rays of Sūrya art our worshipful and holy one.

The first, devout Intelligence, lauded by sages, sped by prayer, Drunk by Brahmachāris, for the favour of the Gods I call.

That excellent Intelligence which Ribhus know, and Asuras, Intelligence which sages know, we cause to enter into me.

Do thou, O Agni, make me wise this day with that Intelligence. Which the creative ishis, which the men endowed with wisdom knew.

Intelligence at eve, at morn, Intelligence at noon of day, With the Sun's beams, and by our speech we plant in us Intelligence.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 108 · A prayer for wisdom - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for wisdom की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for wisdom स्तुति]: Intelligence, come first to us with store of horses and of kine! Thou with the rays of Sūrya art our worshipful and holy one.

2. [A prayer for wisdom स्तुति]: The first, devout Intelligence, lauded by sages, sped by prayer, Drunk by Brahmachāris, for the favour of the Gods I call.

3. [A prayer for wisdom स्तुति]: That excellent Intelligence which Ribhus know, and Asuras, Intelligence which sages know, we cause to enter into me.

4. [A prayer for wisdom स्तुति]: Do thou, O Agni, make me wise this day with that Intelligence. Which the creative ishis, which the men endowed with wisdom knew.

5. [A prayer for wisdom स्तुति]: Intelligence at eve, at morn, Intelligence at noon of day, With the Sun's beams, and by our speech we plant in us Intelligence.

title: Sukta 109 · A charm to heal punctured wounds
deity: A charm to heal punctured wounds
text:
पिप्पली-भैषज्यम्।
१-३ अथर्वा। पिप्पली-भैषज्यं, आयुः। अनुष्टुप्।
पि॒प्प॒ली क्षि॑प्तभेष॒ज्यू॒३ताति॑विद्धभेष॒जी।
तां दे॒वाः सम॑कल्पयन्नि॒यं जीवि॑त॒वा अल॑म्॥१॥
पि॒प्प॒ल्यः॑१ सम॑वदन्ताय॒तीर्जन॑ना॒दधि॑ ।
यं जी॒वम॒श्नवा॑महै॒ न स रि॑ष्याति॒ पूरु॑षः ॥२॥
असु॑रास्त्वा॒ न्यऽखनन् दे॒वास्त्वोद॑वप॒न् पुनः॑ ।
वा॒तीकृ॑तस्य भेष॒जीमथो॑ क्षि॒प्तस्य॑ भेष॒जीम्॥३॥
translation_en:
The Berry heals the missile's rent, it heals the deeply-piercing wound. The Gods prepared and fashioned it. This hath sufficient power for life.

When from their origin they came, the Berries spake among themselves: The man whom we shall find alive shall never suffer injury.

Asuras buried thee in earth: the Gods again uplifted thee. Healer of sickness caused by wounds and healer of the missile's rent.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 109 · A charm to heal punctured wounds - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to heal punctured wounds की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to heal punctured wounds स्तुति]: The Berry heals the missile's rent, it heals the deeply-piercing wound. The Gods prepared and fashioned it. This hath sufficient power for life.

2. [A charm to heal punctured wounds स्तुति]: When from their origin they came, the Berries spake among themselves: The man whom we shall find alive shall never suffer injury.

3. [A charm to heal punctured wounds स्तुति]: Asuras buried thee in earth: the Gods again uplifted thee. Healer of sickness caused by wounds and healer of the missile's rent.

title: Sukta 110 · A benediction on a new-born child
deity: A benediction on a new-born child
text:
दीर्घायुः प्राप्तिः।
१-३ अथर्वा। अग्निः। त्रिष्टुप्, १ पङ्क्तिः।
प्र॒त्नो हि कमीड्यो॑ अध्व॒रेषु॑ स॒नाच्च॒ होता॒ नव्य॑श्च सत्सि ।
स्वां चा॑ग्ने त॒न्वं पि॒प्राय॑स्वा॒स्मभ्यं॑ च॒ सौभ॑ग॒मा य॑जस्व ॥१॥
ज्ये॒ष्ठ॒घ्न्यं जा॒तो वि॒चृतो॑र्य॒मस्य॑ मूल॒बर्ह॑णा॒त् परि॑ पाह्येनम्।
अत्ये॑नं नेषद् दुरि॒तानि॒ विश्वा॑ दीर्घायु॒त्वाय॑ श॒तशा॑रदाय ॥२॥
व्या॒घ्रेऽह्न्य॑जनिष्ट वी॒रो न॑क्षत्र॒जा जाय॑मानः सु॒वीरः॑ ।
स मा व॑धीत् पि॒तरं॒ वर्ध॑मानो॒ मा मा॒तरं॒ प्र मि॑नी॒ज्जनि॑त्रीम्॥३॥
translation_en:
Yea, ancient, meet for praise at sacrifices, ever and now thou sittest down as Hotar. And now, O Agni, make thy person friendly, and win felicity for us by worship.

Neath Jyaishthaghni and Yama's Two Releasers this child was born: preserve him from uprooting. He shall conduct him safe past all misfortunes to lengthened life that lasts a hundred autumns.

Born on the Tiger's day was he, a hero, the Constellations' child, born brave and manly. Let him not wound, when grown in strength, his father, nor disregard his mother, her who bare him.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 110 · A benediction on a new-born child - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A benediction on a new-born child की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A benediction on a new-born child स्तुति]: Yea, ancient, meet for praise at sacrifices, ever and now thou sittest down as Hotar. And now, O Agni, make thy person friendly, and win felicity for us by worship.

2. [A benediction on a new-born child स्तुति]: Neath Jyaishthaghni and Yama's Two Releasers this child was born: preserve him from uprooting. He shall conduct him safe past all misfortunes to lengthened life that lasts a hundred autumns.

3. [A benediction on a new-born child स्तुति]: Born on the Tiger's day was he, a hero, the Constellations' child, born brave and manly. Let him not wound, when grown in strength, his father, nor disregard his mother, her who bare him.

title: Sukta 111 · A charm for insanity
deity: A charm for insanity
text:
उन्मत्ततामोचनम्।
१-४ अथर्वा। अग्निः। अनुष्टुप्, १ परानुष्टुप् त्रिष्टुप्।
इ॒मं मे॑ अग्ने॒ पुरु॑षं मुमुग्ध्य॒यं यो ब॒द्धः सुय॑तो॒ लाल॑पीति ।
अतोऽधि॑ ते कृणवद् भाग॒धेयं॑ य॒दानु॑न्मदि॒तोऽस॑ति ॥१॥
अ॒ग्निष्टे॒ नि श॑मयतु॒ यदि॑ ते॒ मन॒ उद्यु॑तम्।
कृ॒णोमि॑ वि॒द्वान् भे॑ष॒जं यदानु॑न्मदि॒तोऽस॑सि ॥२॥
दे॒वै॒न॒सादुन्म॑दित॒मुन्म॑त्तं॒ रक्ष॑स॒स्परि॑ ।
कृ॒णोमि॑ वि॒द्वान् भे॑ष॒जं यदानु॑न्मदि॒तोऽस॑ति ॥३॥
पुन॑स्त्वा दुरप्स॒रसः॒ पुन॒रिन्द्रः॒ पुन॒र्भगः॑ ।
पुन॑स्त्वा दु॒र्विश्वे॑ दे॒वा यथानु॑न्मदि॒तोऽस॑सि ॥४॥
translation_en:
Unbind and loose for me this man, O Agni, who bound and well restrained is chattering folly. Afterward he will offer thee thy portion when he hath been delivered from his madness.

Let Agni gently soothe thy mind when fierce excitement troubles it. Well-skilled I make a medicine that thou no larger mayst be mad.

Insane through sin against the Gods, or maddened by a demon's power— Well-skilled I make a medicine to free thee from insanity.

May the Apsarases release, Indra and Bhaga let thee go. May all the Gods deliver thee that thou no longer mayst be mad.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 111 · A charm for insanity - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm for insanity की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm for insanity स्तुति]: Unbind and loose for me this man, O Agni, who bound and well restrained is chattering folly. Afterward he will offer thee thy portion when he hath been delivered from his madness.

2. [A charm for insanity स्तुति]: Let Agni gently soothe thy mind when fierce excitement troubles it. Well-skilled I make a medicine that thou no larger mayst be mad.

3. [A charm for insanity स्तुति]: Insane through sin against the Gods, or maddened by a demon's power— Well-skilled I make a medicine to free thee from insanity.

4. [A charm for insanity स्तुति]: May the Apsarases release, Indra and Bhaga let thee go. May all the Gods deliver thee that thou no longer mayst be mad.

title: Sukta 112 · A health-charm for man, woman, and son
deity: A health-charm for man, woman, and son
text:
पाशमोचनम्।
१-३ अथर्वा। अग्निः। त्रिष्टुप्।
मा ज्ये॒ष्ठं व॑धीद॒यम॑ग्न ए॒षां मू॑ल॒बर्ह॑णा॒त् परि॑ पाह्येनम्।
स ग्राह्याः॒ पाशा॒न् वि चृ॑त प्रजा॒नन् तुभ्यं॑ दे॒वा अनु॑ जानन्तु॒ विश्वे॑ ॥१॥
उन्मु॑ञ्च॒ पाशां॒स्त्वम॑ग्न ए॒षां त्रय॑स्त्रि॒भिरुत्सि॑ता॒ येभि॒रास॑न्।
स ग्राह्याः॒ पाशा॒न् वि चृ॑त प्रजा॒नन् पि॑तापु॒त्रौ मा॒तरं॑ मुञ्च॒ सर्वा॑न्॥२॥
येभिः॒ पाशैः॒ परि॑वित्तो॒ विब॒द्धोऽङ्गे॑अङ्ग॒ आर्पि॑त॒ उत्सि॑तश्च ।
वि ते मु॑च्यन्तं वि॒मुचो॒ हि सन्ति॑ भ्रूण॒घ्नि पू॑षन् दुरि॒तानि॑ मृक्ष्व ॥३॥
translation_en:
Let not this one, O Agni, wound the highest of these: preserve thou him from utter ruin. Knowing the way do thou untie the nooses of the she-fiend: let all the Gods approve thee.

Rend thou the; bonds of these asunder, Agni! the, threefold noose whereby the three were fastened. Knowing the way untie the she-fiend's nooses: free all, the son, the father, and the mother.

The elder brother's bonds, still left unwedded, fettered in every limb and bound securely, Loose these, for they are bonds for loosing: Pūshan, turn woes away upon the babe-destroyer.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 112 · A health-charm for man, woman, and son - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A health-charm for man, woman, and son की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A health-charm for man, woman, and son स्तुति]: Let not this one, O Agni, wound the highest of these: preserve thou him from utter ruin. Knowing the way do thou untie the nooses of the she-fiend: let all the Gods approve thee.

2. [A health-charm for man, woman, and son स्तुति]: Rend thou the; bonds of these asunder, Agni! the, threefold noose whereby the three were fastened. Knowing the way untie the she-fiend's nooses: free all, the son, the father, and the mother.

3. [A health-charm for man, woman, and son स्तुति]: The elder brother's bonds, still left unwedded, fettered in every limb and bound securely, Loose these, for they are bonds for loosing: Pūshan, turn woes away upon the babe-destroyer.

title: Sukta 113 · A charm to banish the fiend Grāhi
deity: A charm to banish the fiend Grāhi
text:
पापनाशनम्।
१-३ अथर्वा। पूषा। त्रिष्टुप्, ३ पङ्क्तिः।
त्रि॒ते दे॒वा अ॑मृजतै॒तदेन॑स्त्रि॒त ए॑नन्मनु॒ष्येऽषु ममृजे ।
ततो॒ यदि॑ त्वा॒ ग्राहि॑रान॒शे तां ते॑ दे॒वा ब्रह्म॑णा नाशयन्तु ॥१॥
मरी॑चीर्धू॒मान् प्र वि॒शानु॑ पाप्मन्नुदा॒रान् गच्छो॒त वा॑ नीहा॒रान्।
न॒दीनां॒ फेनाँ॒ अनु॒ तान् वि न॑श्य भ्रूण॒घ्नि पू॑षन् दुरि॒तानि॑ मृक्ष्व ॥२॥
द्वा॒द॒श॒धा निहि॑तं त्रि॒तस्याप॑मृष्टं मनुष्यैन॒सानि॑ ।
ततो॒ यदि॑ त्वा॒ ग्राहि॑रान॒शे तां ते॑ दे॒वा ब्रह्म॑णा नाशयन्तु ॥३॥
translation_en:
This sin the Gods wiped off and laid on Trita, and Trita wiped it off on human beings. Thence if the female fiend hath made thee captive, the Gods by prayer shall banish her and free thee.

Enter the particles of light and vapours, go to the rising fogs or mists, O Evil! Hence! vanish in the foams of rivers. Pūshan, wipe woes away upon the babe-destroyer!

Stored in twelve separate places lies what Trita hath wiped away, the sins of human beings. Thence if the female fiend hath made thee captive, the Gods by prayer shall banish her and free thee.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 113 · A charm to banish the fiend Grāhi - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to banish the fiend Grāhi की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to banish the fiend Grāhi स्तुति]: This sin the Gods wiped off and laid on Trita, and Trita wiped it off on human beings. Thence if the female fiend hath made thee captive, the Gods by prayer shall banish her and free thee.

2. [A charm to banish the fiend Grāhi स्तुति]: Enter the particles of light and vapours, go to the rising fogs or mists, O Evil! Hence! vanish in the foams of rivers. Pūshan, wipe woes away upon the babe-destroyer!

3. [A charm to banish the fiend Grāhi स्तुति]: Stored in twelve separate places lies what Trita hath wiped away, the sins of human beings. Thence if the female fiend hath made thee captive, the Gods by prayer shall banish her and free thee.

title: Sukta 114 · A prayer for pardon of faults and errors in sacrificing
deity: A prayer for pardon of faults and errors in sacrificing
text:
उन्मोचनम्।
१-३ ब्रह्म। विश्वे देवाः। अनुष्टुप्।
यद् दे॑वा देव॒हेड॑नं॒ देवा॑सश्चकृ॒मा व॒यम्।
आदि॑त्या॒स्तस्मा॑न्नो यू॒यमृ॒तस्य॒र्तेन॑ मुञ्चत ॥१॥
ऋ॒तस्य॒र्ते॑ना॑दित्या॒ यज॑त्रा मु॒ञ्चते॒ह नः॑ ।
य॒ज्ञं यद् य॑ज्ञवाहसः॒ शिक्ष॑न्तो॒ नोप॑शेकि॒म॥२॥
मेद॑स्वता॒ यज॑मानाः स्रु॒चाज्या॑नि॒ जुह्व॑तः ।
अ॒का॒मा वि॑श्वे वो देवाः॒ शिक्ष॑न्तो॒ नोप॑ शेकि॒म ॥३॥
translation_en:
Whatever God-provoking wrong we priests have done, O Deities. Therefrom do ye deliver us, Ādityas! by the right of Law.

Here set us free, O holy ones, Ādityas, by the right of Law. When striving, bringing sacrifice, we failed to offer it aright.

With ladle full of fatness we, worshippers, pouring holy oil, Striving, have failed, O all ye Gods, against our will, to offer it.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 114 · A prayer for pardon of faults and errors in sacrificing - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for pardon of faults and errors in sacrificing की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for pardon of faults and errors in sacrificing स्तुति]: Whatever God-provoking wrong we priests have done, O Deities. Therefrom do ye deliver us, Ādityas! by the right of Law.

2. [A prayer for pardon of faults and errors in sacrificing स्तुति]: Here set us free, O holy ones, Ādityas, by the right of Law. When striving, bringing sacrifice, we failed to offer it aright.

3. [A prayer for pardon of faults and errors in sacrificing स्तुति]: With ladle full of fatness we, worshippers, pouring holy oil, Striving, have failed, O all ye Gods, against our will, to offer it.

title: Sukta 115 · A prayer for forgiveness of sins
deity: A prayer for forgiveness of sins
text:
पापमोचनम्।
१-३ ब्रह्मा। विश्वे देवाः। अनुष्टुप्।
यद् वि॒द्वांसो॒ यदवि॑द्वांस॒ एनां॑सि चकृ॒मा व॒यम्।
यू॒यं न॒स्तस्मा॑न्मुञ्चत॒ विश्वे॑ देवाः सजोषसः ॥१॥
यदि॒ जाग्र॒द् यदि॒ स्वप॒न्नेन॑ एन॒स्योऽक॑रम्।
भू॒तं मा॒ तस्मा॒द् भव्यं॑ च द्रुप॒दादि॑व मुञ्चताम्॥२॥
द्रु॒प॒दादि॑व मुमुचा॒नः स्वि॒न्नः स्ना॒त्वा मला॑दिव ।
पू॒तं प॒वित्रे॑णे॒वाज्यं॒ विश्वे॑ शुम्भन्तु॒ मैन॑सः ॥३॥
translation_en:
Whatever wrong we wittingly or in our ignorance have done, Do ye deliver us therefrom, O all ye Gods, of one accord.

If I, a sinner, when awake or sleeping have committed sin, Free me therefrom as from a stake, from present and from future guilt.

As one unfastened from a stake, or cleansed by bathing after toil, As butter which the sieve hath cleansed, so all shall purge me from the sin.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 115 · A prayer for forgiveness of sins - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for forgiveness of sins की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for forgiveness of sins स्तुति]: Whatever wrong we wittingly or in our ignorance have done, Do ye deliver us therefrom, O all ye Gods, of one accord.

2. [A prayer for forgiveness of sins स्तुति]: If I, a sinner, when awake or sleeping have committed sin, Free me therefrom as from a stake, from present and from future guilt.

3. [A prayer for forgiveness of sins स्तुति]: As one unfastened from a stake, or cleansed by bathing after toil, As butter which the sieve hath cleansed, so all shall purge me from the sin.

title: Sukta 116 · A prayer for pardon of sin against mother, father, son, or brother
deity: A prayer for pardon of sin against mother, father, son, or brother
text:
मधुमदन्नम्।
१-३ जाटिकायनः। विवस्वान्। जगती, २ त्रिष्टुप्।
यद् या॒मं च॒क्रुर्नि॒खन॑न्तो॒ अग्रे॒ कार्षी॑वणा अन्न॒विदो॒ न वि॒द्यया॑ ।
वै॒व॒स्व॒ते राज॑नि॒ तज्जु॑हो॒म्यथ॑ य॒ज्ञियं॒ मधु॑मदस्तु॒ नोऽन्न॑म्॥१॥
वै॒व॒स्व॒तः कृ॑णवद् भाग॒धेयं॒ मधु॑भागो॒ मधु॑ना॒ सं सृ॑जाति ।
मा॒तुर्यदेन॑ इषि॒तं न॒ आग॒न् यद् वा॑ पि॒ताप॑राद्धो जिही॒डे॥२॥
यदी॒दं मा॒तुर्यदि॑ पि॒तुर्नः॒ परि॒ भ्रातुः॑ पु॒त्राच्चेत॑स॒ एन॒ आग॑न्।
याव॑न्तो अ॒स्मान् पि॒तरः॒ सच॑न्ते॒ तेषां॒ सर्वे॑षां शि॒वो अ॑स्तु म॒न्युः ॥३॥
translation_en:
The wealth which husbandmen aforetime, digging, like men who find their food with knowledge, buried, This to the King, Vivasvān's son, I offer, Sweet be our food and fit for sacrificing!

May he, Vaivasvata, prepare our portion; May he whose share is mead with mead besprinkle. Our sin in hasty mood against our mother, or guilt whereby a sire is wronged and angered.

Whether this sin into our heart hath entered regarding mother, father, son or brother, Auspicious be to us the zeal and spirit of all the fathers who are here among us.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 116 · A prayer for pardon of sin against mother, father, son, or brother - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for pardon of sin against mother, father, son, or brother की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for pardon of sin against mother, father, son, or brother स्तुति]: The wealth which husbandmen aforetime, digging, like men who find their food with knowledge, buried, This to the King, Vivasvān's son, I offer, Sweet be our food and fit for sacrificing!

2. [A prayer for pardon of sin against mother, father, son, or brother स्तुति]: May he, Vaivasvata, prepare our portion; May he whose share is mead with mead besprinkle. Our sin in hasty mood against our mother, or guilt whereby a sire is wronged and angered.

3. [A prayer for pardon of sin against mother, father, son, or brother स्तुति]: Whether this sin into our heart hath entered regarding mother, father, son or brother, Auspicious be to us the zeal and spirit of all the fathers who are here among us.

title: Sukta 117 · A prayer for freedom from debt
deity: A prayer for freedom from debt
text:
आनृण्यम्।
१-३ कौशिकः। अग्निः। त्रिष्टुप्।
अ॒प॒मित्य॒मप्र॑तीत्तं॒ यदस्मि॑ य॒मस्य॒ येन॑ ब॒लिना॒ चरा॑मि ।
इ॒दं तद॑ग्ने अनृ॒णो भ॑वामि॒ त्वं पाशा॑न् वि॒चृतं॑ वेत्थ॒ सर्वा॑न्॥१॥
इ॒हैव सन्तः॒ प्रति॑ दद्म एनज्जी॒वा जी॒वेभ्यो॒ नि ह॑राम एनत्।
अ॒प॒मित्य॑ धा॒न्यं॑१ यज्ज॒घसा॒हमि॒दं तद॑ग्ने अनृ॒णो भ॑वामि ॥२॥
अ॒नृ॒णा अ॒स्मिन्न॑नृ॒णाः पर॑स्मिन् तृ॒तीये॑ लो॒के अ॑नृ॒णाः स्या॑म ।
ये दे॑व॒यानाः॑ पितृ॒याणा॑श्च लो॒काः सर्वा॑न् प॒थो अ॑नृ॒णा आ क्षि॑येम ॥३॥
translation_en:
That which I eat, a debt which still is owing, the tribute due to Yama, which supports me, Thereby may I be free from debt, O Agni. Thou knowest how to rend all bonds asunder.

Still dwelling here we give again this present; we send it forth, the living from the living. Throwing away the grain whence I have eaten, thereby shall I be free from debt, O Agni.

May we be free in this world and that yonder, in the third world may we be unindebted. May we, debt-free, abide in all the pathways, in all the worlds which Gods and Fathers visit.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 117 · A prayer for freedom from debt - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for freedom from debt की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for freedom from debt स्तुति]: That which I eat, a debt which still is owing, the tribute due to Yama, which supports me, Thereby may I be free from debt, O Agni. Thou knowest how to rend all bonds asunder.

2. [A prayer for freedom from debt स्तुति]: Still dwelling here we give again this present; we send it forth, the living from the living. Throwing away the grain whence I have eaten, thereby shall I be free from debt, O Agni.

3. [A prayer for freedom from debt स्तुति]: May we be free in this world and that yonder, in the third world may we be unindebted. May we, debt-free, abide in all the pathways, in all the worlds which Gods and Fathers visit.

title: Sukta 118 · A prayer for pardon of cheating at play
deity: A prayer for pardon of cheating at play
text:
आनृण्यम्।
१-३ कौशिकः। अग्निः। त्रिष्टुप्।
यद्धस्ता॑भ्यां चकृ॒म किल्बि॑षाण्य॒क्षानां॑ ग॒त्नुमु॑प॒लिप्स॑मानाः ।
उ॒ग्रं॒प॒श्ये उ॑ग्र॒जितौ॒ तद॒द्याप्स॒रसा॒वनु॑ दत्तामृ॒णं नः॑ ॥१॥
उग्रं॑पश्ये॒ राष्ट्र॑भृ॒त् किल्बि॑षाणि॒ यद॒क्षवृ॑त्त॒मनु॑ दत्तं न ए॒तत्।
ऋ॒णान्नो॒ नर्णमेर्त्स॑मानो य॒मस्य॑ लो॒के अधि॑रज्जु॒रा॑यत्॥२॥
यस्मा॑ ऋ॒णं यस्य॑ जा॒यामु॒पैमि॒ यं याच॑मानो अ॒भ्यैमि॑ देवाः ।
ते वाचं॑ वादिषु॒र्मोत्त॑रां॒ मद्देव॑पत्नी॒ अप्स॑रसा॒वधी॑तम्॥३॥
translation_en:
If we have sinned with both our hands, desiring to take the host of dice for our possession, May both Apsarases to-day forgive us that debt, the fiercely- conquering, fiercely-looking.

Stern viewers of their sins who rule the people, forgive us what hash happened as we gambled. Not urging us to pay the debt we owed him, he with a cord hath gone to Yama's kingdom.

My creditor, the man whose wife I visit, he, Gods! whom I approach with supplication, Let not these men dominate me in speaking. Mind this, ye two Apsarases, Gods' Consorts!
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 118 · A prayer for pardon of cheating at play - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for pardon of cheating at play की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for pardon of cheating at play स्तुति]: If we have sinned with both our hands, desiring to take the host of dice for our possession, May both Apsarases to-day forgive us that debt, the fiercely- conquering, fiercely-looking.

2. [A prayer for pardon of cheating at play स्तुति]: Stern viewers of their sins who rule the people, forgive us what hash happened as we gambled. Not urging us to pay the debt we owed him, he with a cord hath gone to Yama's kingdom.

3. [A prayer for pardon of cheating at play स्तुति]: My creditor, the man whose wife I visit, he, Gods! whom I approach with supplication, Let not these men dominate me in speaking. Mind this, ye two Apsarases, Gods' Consorts!

title: Sukta 119 · A prayer for release from debts incurred without intention of payment
deity: A prayer for release from debts incurred without intention of payment
text:
आनृण्यम्।
१-३ कौशिकः। वैश्वानरोऽग्निः। त्रिष्टुप्।
यददी॑व्यन्नृ॒णम॒हं कृ॒णोम्यदा॑स्यन्नग्न उ॒त सं॑गृ॒णामि॑ ।
वै॒श्वा॒न॒रो नो॑ अधि॒पा वसि॑ष्ठ॒ उदिन्न॑याति सुकृ॒तस्य॑ लो॒कम्॥१॥
वै॒श्वा॒न॒राय॒ प्रति॑ वेदयामि॒ यद्यृ॒णं सं॑ग॒रो दे॒वता॑सु ।
स ए॒तान् पाशा॑न् वि॒चृतं॑ वेद॒ सर्वा॒नथ॑ प॒क्वेन॑ स॒ह सं भ॑वेम ॥२॥
वै॒श्वा॒न॒रः प॑वि॒ता मा॑ पुनातु॒ यत् सं॑ग॒रम॑भि॒धावा॑म्या॒शाम्।
अना॑जान॒न् मन॑सा॒ याच॑मानो॒ यत् तत्रैनो॒ अप॒ तत् सु॑वामि ॥३॥
translation_en:
The debt which I incur, not gaming, Agni! and, not intending to repay, acknowledge, That may Vaisvānara, the best, our sovran, carry away into the world of virtue.

I cause Vaisvānara to know, confessing the debt whose payment to the Gods is promised. He knows to tear asunder all these nooses: so may we dwell with him the gentle-minded.

Vaisvānara the Purifier purge me when I oppose their hope and break my promise, Unknowing in my heart. With supplication, whatever guilt there is in that, I banish.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 119 · A prayer for release from debts incurred without intention of payment - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for release from debts incurred without intention of payment की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for release from debts incurred without intention of payment स्तुति]: The debt which I incur, not gaming, Agni! and, not intending to repay, acknowledge, That may Vaisvānara, the best, our sovran, carry away into the world of virtue.

2. [A prayer for release from debts incurred without intention of payment स्तुति]: I cause Vaisvānara to know, confessing the debt whose payment to the Gods is promised. He knows to tear asunder all these nooses: so may we dwell with him the gentle-minded.

3. [A prayer for release from debts incurred without intention of payment स्तुति]: Vaisvānara the Purifier purge me when I oppose their hope and break my promise, Unknowing in my heart. With supplication, whatever guilt there is in that, I banish.

title: Sukta 120 · A prayer for pardon of sins and felicity hereafter
deity: A prayer for pardon of sins and felicity hereafter
text:
सुकृतस्य लोकः।
१-३ कौशिकः। अन्तरिक्षं, पृथिवी, द्यौः, अग्निः। १ जगती, २ पङ्क्तिः, ३ त्रिष्टुप्।
यद॒न्तरि॑क्षं पृथि॒वीमु॒त द्यां यन्मा॒तरं॑ पि॒तरं॑ वा जिहिंसि॒म।
अ॒यं तस्मा॒द् गार्ह॑पत्यो नो अ॒ग्निरुदिन्न॑याति सुकृ॒तस्य॑ लो॒कम्॥१॥
भूमि॑र्मा॒तादि॑तिर्नो ज॒नित्रं॒ भ्राता॒न्तरि॑क्षम॒भिश॑स्त्या नः ।
द्यौर्नः॑ पि॒ता पित्र्या॒च्छं भ॑वाति जा॒मिमृ॒त्वा माव॑ पत्सि लो॒कात्॥२॥
यत्रा॑ सु॒हार्दः॑ सु॒कृतो॒ मद॑न्ति वि॒हाय॒ रोगं॑ त॒न्वः॑१ स्वायाः॑ ।
अश्लो॑णा॒ अङ्गै॒रह्रु॑ताः स्व॒र्गे तत्र॑ पश्येम पि॒तरौ॑ च पु॒त्रान्॥३॥
translation_en:
If we have injured Air, or Earth, or Heaven, if we have wronged our Mother or our Father, May Agni Gārhapatya here absolve us, and bear us up into the world of virtue.

Earth is our Mother, Aditi our birth-place: our brother Air save us from imprecation! Dyaus, Father, save us, from the world of Fathers! My world not lost, may I approach my kindred.

There where our virtuous friends, who left behind them their bodily infirmities, are happy, Free from distortion of the limbs and lameness, may we behold, in heaven, our sons and parents.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 120 · A prayer for pardon of sins and felicity hereafter - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for pardon of sins and felicity hereafter की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for pardon of sins and felicity hereafter स्तुति]: If we have injured Air, or Earth, or Heaven, if we have wronged our Mother or our Father, May Agni Gārhapatya here absolve us, and bear us up into the world of virtue.

2. [A prayer for pardon of sins and felicity hereafter स्तुति]: Earth is our Mother, Aditi our birth-place: our brother Air save us from imprecation! Dyaus, Father, save us, from the world of Fathers! My world not lost, may I approach my kindred.
