title: Sukta 121 · A prayer for happiness in heaven
deity: A prayer for happiness in heaven
text:
सुकृतलोकप्राप्तिः
-४ कौशिकः। अग्निः, ३ तारके। १-२ त्रिष्टुप्, ३-४ अनुष्टुप्।
वि॒षाणा॒ पाशा॒न् वि ष्याध्य॒स्मद् य उ॑त्त॒मा अ॑ध॒मा वा॑रु॒णा ये।
दु॒ष्वप्न्यं॑ दुरि॒तं नि ष्वा॒स्मदथ॑ गच्छेम सुकृ॒तस्य॑ लो॒कम्॥१॥
यद् दारु॑णि ब॒ध्यसे॒ यच्च॒ रज्ज्वां॒ यद् भूम्यां॑ ब॒ध्यसे॒ यच्च॑ वा॒चा।
अ॒यं तस्मा॒द् गार्ह॑पत्यो नो अ॒ग्निरुदिन्न॑याति सुकृ॒तस्य॑ लो॒कम्॥२॥
उद॑गातां॒ भग॑वती वि॒चृतौ॒ नाम॒ तार॑के ।
प्रेहामृत॑स्य यच्छतां॒ प्रैतु॑ बद्धक॒मोच॑नम्॥३॥
वि जि॑हीष्व लो॒कं कृ॑णु ब॒न्धान्मु॑ञ्चासि॒ बद्ध॑कम्।
योन्या॑ इव॒ प्रच्यु॑तो॒ गर्भः॑ प॒थः सर्वां॒ अनु॑ क्षिय ॥४॥
translation_en:
Spreading them out, untie the snares that hold us, Varuna's bonds, the upper and the lower. Drive from us evil dream, drive off misfortune; then let us go in- to the world of virtue.

If thou art bound with cord or tied to timber, fixt in the earth, or by a word imprisoned, Our Agni Gārhapatya here shall free thee, and lead thee up into the world of virtue.

The two auspicious stars whose name is called Releasers have gone up. Send Amrit hither, let it come freeing the captive from his bonds!

Open thyself, make room: from bonds thou shalt release the prisoner. Freed, like an infant newly born, dwell in all pathways where thou wilt.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 121 · A prayer for happiness in heaven - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for happiness in heaven की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for happiness in heaven स्तुति]: Spreading them out, untie the snares that hold us, Varuna's bonds, the upper and the lower. Drive from us evil dream, drive off misfortune; then let us go in- to the world of virtue.

2. [A prayer for happiness in heaven स्तुति]: If thou art bound with cord or tied to timber, fixt in the earth, or by a word imprisoned, Our Agni Gārhapatya here shall free thee, and lead thee up into the world of virtue.

3. [A prayer for happiness in heaven स्तुति]: The two auspicious stars whose name is called Releasers have gone up. Send Amrit hither, let it come freeing the captive from his bonds!

4. [A prayer for happiness in heaven स्तुति]: Open thyself, make room: from bonds thou shalt release the prisoner. Freed, like an infant newly born, dwell in all pathways where thou wilt.

title: Sukta 122 · A prayer for happiness in heaven
deity: A prayer for happiness in heaven
text:
तृतीयो नाकः।
१-५ भृगुः। विश्वकर्मा। त्रिष्टुप्। ४-५ जगती।
ए॒तं भा॒गं परि॑ ददामि वि॒द्वान् विश्व॑कर्मन् प्रथम॒जा ऋ॒तस्य॑ ।
अ॒स्माभि॑र्द॒त्तं ज॒रसः॑ प॒रस्ता॒दच्छि॑न्नं॒ तन्तु॒मनु॒ सं त॑रेम ॥१॥
त॒तं तन्तु॒मन्वेके॑ तरन्ति॒ येषां॑ द॒त्तं पित्र्य॒माय॑नेन ।
अ॒ब॒न्ध्वेके॒ दद॑तः प्र॒यच्छ॑न्तो॒ दातुं॒ चेच्छिक्षा॒न्त्स स्व॒र्ग ए॒व॥२॥
अ॒न्वार॑भेथामनु॒संर॑भेथामे॒तं लो॒कं श्र॒द्दधा॑नाः सचन्ते ।
यद् वां॑ प॒क्वं परि॑विष्टम॒ग्नौ तस्य॒ गुप्त॑ये दम्पती॒ सं श्र॑येथाम्॥३॥
य॒ज्ञं यन्तं॒ मन॑सा बृ॒हन्त॑म॒न्वारो॑हामि॒ तप॑सा॒ सयो॑निः ।
उप॑हूता अग्ने ज॒रसः॑ प॒रस्ता॑त् तृ॒तीये॒ नाके॑ सध॒मादं॑ मदेम ॥४॥
शु॒द्धाः पू॒ता यो॒षितो॑ य॒ज्ञिया॑ इ॒मा ब्र॒ह्मणां॒ हस्ते॑षु प्रपृ॒थक् सा॑दयामि ।
यत्का॑म इ॒दम॑भिषि॒ञ्चामि॑ वो॒ऽहमिन्द्रो॑ म॒रुत्वा॒न्त्स ददातु॒ तन्मे॑ ॥५॥
translation_en:
This portion I who understand deliver to Visvakarman first-born son of Order. So may we follow to the end, unbroken, beyond old age, the thread which we have given.

This long-drawn thread some follow who have offered in order- ed course oblation to the Fathers: Some, offering and giving to the friendless, if they can give: herein they find their heaven. 3, Stand on my side and range yourselves in order, ye two! The faithful reach this world of Svarga. When your dressed food hath been bestowed on Agni, to guard it, wife and husband, come together!

Dwelling with zeal I mount in spirit after the lofty sacrifice as it departeth. Agni, may we, beyond decay, invited, in the third heaven, feast and enjoy the banquet.

These women here, cleansed, purified, and holy, I place at rest singly, in hands of Brāhmans. May Indra, Marut-girt, grant me the blessing I long for as I pour you this libation.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 122 · A prayer for happiness in heaven - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for happiness in heaven की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for happiness in heaven स्तुति]: This portion I who understand deliver to Visvakarman first-born son of Order. So may we follow to the end, unbroken, beyond old age, the thread which we have given.

2. [A prayer for happiness in heaven स्तुति]: This long-drawn thread some follow who have offered in order- ed course oblation to the Fathers: Some, offering and giving to the friendless, if they can give: herein they find their heaven. 3, Stand on my side and range yourselves in order, ye two! The faithful reach this world of Svarga. When your dressed food hath been bestowed on Agni, to guard it, wife and husband, come together!

3. [A prayer for happiness in heaven स्तुति]: Dwelling with zeal I mount in spirit after the lofty sacrifice as it departeth. Agni, may we, beyond decay, invited, in the third heaven, feast and enjoy the banquet.

4. [A prayer for happiness in heaven स्तुति]: These women here, cleansed, purified, and holy, I place at rest singly, in hands of Brāhmans. May Indra, Marut-girt, grant me the blessing I long for as I pour you this libation.

title: Sukta 123 · A prayer for happiness in heaven
deity: A prayer for happiness in heaven
text:
सौमनसम्।
१-५ भृगुः। विश्वे देवाः। त्रिष्टुप्, ३ द्विपदा साम्म्यनुष्टुप्, ४ एकावसाना द्विपदा प्राजापत्या भुरिगनुष्टु।
ए॒तं स॑धस्थाः॒ परि॑ वो ददामि॒ यं शे॑व॒धिमा॒वहा॑ज्जा॒तवे॑दाः ।
अ॒न्वा॒ग॒न्ता यज॑मानः स्व॒स्ति तं स्म॑ जानीत पर॒मे व्योऽमन्॥१॥
जा॒नी॒त स्मै॑नं पर॒मे व्योऽम॒न् देवाः॒ सध॑स्था वि॒द लो॒कमत्र॑ ।
अ॒न्वा॒ग॒न्ता यज॑मानः स्व॒स्तीऽष्टापू॒र्तं स्म॑ कृणुता॒विर॑स्मै ॥२॥
देवाः॒ पित॑रः॒ पित॑रो॒ देवाः॑ ।
यो अस्मि॒ सो अ॑स्मि ॥३॥
स प॑चामि॒ स द॑दामि॒ ।
स य॑जे॒ स द॒त्तान्मा यू॑षम्॥४॥
नाके॑ राज॑न् प्रति॑ तिष्ठ॒ तत्रै॒तत् प्रति॑ तिष्ठतु ।
वि॒द्धि पू॒र्तस्य॑ नो राज॒न्त्स दे॑व सु॒मना॑ भव ॥५॥
translation_en:
Ye who are present, unto you I offer this treasure brought to us by Jātavedas Happily will the sacrificer follow: do ye acknowledge him in highest heaven.

Do ye acknowledge him in highest heaven: ye know the world here present in assembly. In peace will he who sacrifices follow: show him the joy which comes from pious actions.

Gods are the Fathers, and the Fathers Gods. I am the very man I am.

I cook, I give, I offer up oblation. From what I gave let me not be disparted.

O King, take thou thy stand in heaven, there also let that gift be placed. Recognize, King, the gift which we have given, and be gracious, God!
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 123 · A prayer for happiness in heaven - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A prayer for happiness in heaven की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A prayer for happiness in heaven स्तुति]: Ye who are present, unto you I offer this treasure brought to us by Jātavedas Happily will the sacrificer follow: do ye acknowledge him in highest heaven.

2. [A prayer for happiness in heaven स्तुति]: Do ye acknowledge him in highest heaven: ye know the world here present in assembly. In peace will he who sacrifices follow: show him the joy which comes from pious actions.

3. [A prayer for happiness in heaven स्तुति]: Gods are the Fathers, and the Fathers Gods. I am the very man I am.

4. [A prayer for happiness in heaven स्तुति]: I cook, I give, I offer up oblation. From what I gave let me not be disparted.

5. [A prayer for happiness in heaven स्तुति]: O King, take thou thy stand in heaven, there also let that gift be placed. Recognize, King, the gift which we have given, and be gracious, God!

title: Sukta 124 · An Omen from the sky
deity: An Omen from the sky
text:
निर्ऋत्यपस्तरणम्।
१-३ अथर्वा। दिव्या आपः। त्रिष्टुप्।
दि॒वो नु मां बृ॑ह॒तो अ॒न्तरि॑क्षाद॒पां स्तो॒को अ॒भ्यऽपप्तद् रसे॑न ।
समि॑न्द्रि॒येण॒ पय॑सा॒हम॑ग्ने॒ छन्दो॑भिर्य॒ज्ञैः सु॒कृतां॑ कृ॒तेन॑ ॥१॥
यदि॑ वृ॒क्षाद॒भ्यप॑प्त॒त् फलं॒ तद् यद्य॒न्तरि॑क्षा॒त् स उ॑ वा॒युरे॒व।
यत्रास्पृ॑क्षत् त॒न्वो॒३यच्च॒ वास॑स॒ आपो॑ नुदन्तु॒ निरृ॑तिं परा॒चैः ॥२॥
अ॒भ्यञ्ज॑नं सुर॒भि सा समृ॑द्धि॒र्हिर॑ण्यं॒ वर्च॒स्तदु॑ पू॒त्रिम॑मे॒व।
सर्वा॑ प॒वित्रा॒ वित॒ताध्य॒स्मत् तन्मा ता॑री॒न्निरृ॑ति॒र्मो अरा॑तिः ॥३॥
translation_en:
From the high firmament, yea, out of heaven a water-drop with dew on me hath fallen. I, Agni! share the merit of the pious, with vigour, milk, and hymns and sacrifices.

If from a tree that fruit hath fallen downward if, aught from air that is vāyu. Where it hath touched my body or my garment, thence may the Waters drive Destruction backward.

It is a fragrant ointment, happy fortune, sheen all of gold, yea, purified from blemish. Spread over us are all purifications. Death and Malignity shall not subdue us.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 124 · An Omen from the sky - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा An Omen from the sky की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [An Omen from the sky स्तुति]: From the high firmament, yea, out of heaven a water-drop with dew on me hath fallen. I, Agni! share the merit of the pious, with vigour, milk, and hymns and sacrifices.

2. [An Omen from the sky स्तुति]: If from a tree that fruit hath fallen downward if, aught from air that is vāyu. Where it hath touched my body or my garment, thence may the Waters drive Destruction backward.

3. [An Omen from the sky स्तुति]: It is a fragrant ointment, happy fortune, sheen all of gold, yea, purified from blemish. Spread over us are all purifications. Death and Malignity shall not subdue us.

title: Sukta 125 · Glorification of a war-chariot
deity: Glorification of a war-chariot
text:
वीरस्य रथः।
१-३ अथर्वा। वनस्पतिः। त्रिष्टुप्, २ जगती।
वन॑स्पते वी॒ड्वऽङ्गो॒ हि भू॒या अ॒स्मत्स॑खा प्र॒तर॑णः सु॒वीरः॑ ।
गोभिः॒ संन॑द्धो असि वी॒डय॑स्वास्था॒ता ते॑ जयतु॒ जेत्वा॑नि ॥१॥
दि॒वस्पृ॑थि॒व्याः पर्योज॒ उद्भृ॑तं॒ वन॒स्पति॑भ्यः॒ पर्याभृ॑तं॒ सहः॑ ।
अ॒पामो॒ज्मानं॒ परि॒ गोभि॒रावृ॑त॒मिन्द्र॑स्य॒ वज्रं॑ ह॒विषा॒ रथं॑ यज ॥२॥
इन्द्र॒स्यौजो॑ म॒रुता॒मनी॑कं मि॒त्रस्य॒ गर्भो॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ नाभिः॑ ।
स इ॒मां नो॑ ह॒व्यदा॑तिं जुषा॒णो देव॑ रथ॒ प्रति॑ ह॒व्या गृभाय ॥३॥
translation_en:
Mayst thou, O Tree, be firm indeed in body, our friend that furthers us, a goodly hero. Put forth thy strength, compact with thongs of leather, and let thy rider win all spoils of battle.

Its mighty strength was borrowed from the heaven and earth: its conquering force was brought from sovrans of the wood. Honour with sacrifice the Car like Indra's bolt, the Car girt round with straps, the vigour of the floods.

Thou bolt of Indra, vanguard of the Maruts, close knit to Varuna and child of Mitra, As such, accepting gifts which here we offer, receive, O godlike Chariot, these oblations.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 125 · Glorification of a war-chariot - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा Glorification of a war-chariot की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [Glorification of a war-chariot स्तुति]: Mayst thou, O Tree, be firm indeed in body, our friend that furthers us, a goodly hero. Put forth thy strength, compact with thongs of leather, and let thy rider win all spoils of battle.

2. [Glorification of a war-chariot स्तुति]: Its mighty strength was borrowed from the heaven and earth: its conquering force was brought from sovrans of the wood. Honour with sacrifice the Car like Indra's bolt, the Car girt round with straps, the vigour of the floods.

3. [Glorification of a war-chariot स्तुति]: Thou bolt of Indra, vanguard of the Maruts, close knit to Varuna and child of Mitra, As such, accepting gifts which here we offer, receive, O godlike Chariot, these oblations.

title: Sukta 126 · Glorification of the war drum
deity: Glorification of the war drum
text:
दुन्दुभिः।
१-३ अथर्वा। दुन्दुभिः। भुरिक् त्रिष्टुप्, ३ पुरोबृहतीगर्भा त्रिष्टुप्।
उप॑ श्वासय पृथि॒वीमु॒त द्यां पु॑रु॒त्रा ते॑ वन्वतां॒ विष्ठि॑तं जग॑त्।
स दु॑न्दुभे स॒जूरिन्द्रे॑ण दे॒वैर्दू॒राद् दवी॑यो॒ अप॑ सेध॒ शत्रू॑न्॥१॥
आ क्र॑न्दय॒ बल॒मोजो॑ न॒ आ धा॑ अ॒भि ष्ट॑न दुरि॒ता बाध॑मानः ।
अप॑ सेध दुन्दुभे दु॒च्छुना॑मि॒त इन्द्र॑स्य मु॒ष्टिर॑सि वी॒डय॑स्व ॥२॥
प्रामूं ज॑या॒भी॒३मे ज॑यन्तु केतु॒मद् दु॑न्दुभिर्वा॑वदीतु ।
समश्व॑पर्णाः पतन्तु नो॒ नरो॒ऽस्माक॑मिन्द्र र॒थिनो॑ जयन्तु ॥३॥
translation_en:
Send forth thy voice aloud through earth and heaven, and let the world in all its breadth regard thee. O Drum, accordant with the Gods and Indra, drive thou afar, yea, very far, our foemen.

Thunder out strength and fill us full of vigour, yea, thunder forth and drive away misfortunes. Drive hence, O Drum, drive thou away mischances. Thou art the fist of Indra, show thy firmness.

Conquer those yonder and let these be victors. Let the Drum speak aloud as battle's signal. Let our men, winged with horses, fly together. Let our car- warriors, Indra! be triumphant.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 126 · Glorification of the war drum - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा Glorification of the war drum की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [Glorification of the war drum स्तुति]: Send forth thy voice aloud through earth and heaven, and let the world in all its breadth regard thee. O Drum, accordant with the Gods and Indra, drive thou afar, yea, very far, our foemen.

2. [Glorification of the war drum स्तुति]: Thunder out strength and fill us full of vigour, yea, thunder forth and drive away misfortunes. Drive hence, O Drum, drive thou away mischances. Thou art the fist of Indra, show thy firmness.

3. [Glorification of the war drum स्तुति]: Conquer those yonder and let these be victors. Let the Drum speak aloud as battle's signal. Let our men, winged with horses, fly together. Let our car- warriors, Indra! be triumphant.

title: Sukta 127 · A charm to banish various diseases
deity: A charm to banish various diseases
text:
यक्ष्मनाशनम्।
१-३ भृग्वङ्गिराः। यक्ष्मनाशनम्, वनस्पतिः। अनुष्टुप्, ३ त्र्यवसाना षट्-पदा जगती।
वि॒द्र॒धस्य॑ ब॒लास॑स्य॒ लोहि॑तस्य वनस्पते ।
वि॒सल्प॑कस्योषधे॒ मोच्छि॑षः पिशि॒तं च॒न॥१॥
यौ ते॑ बलास॒ तिष्ठ॑तः॒ कक्षे॑ मु॒ष्कावप॑श्रितौ ।
वेदा॒हं तस्य॑ भेष॒जं ची॒पुद्रु॑रभि॒चक्ष॑णम्॥२॥
यो अङ्ग्यो॒ यः कर्ण्यो॒ यो अ॒क्ष्योर्वि॒सल्प॑कः ।
वि वृ॑हामो वि॒सल्प॑कं विद्र॒धं हृ॑दयाम॒यम्।
परा॒ तमज्ञा॑तं॒ यक्ष्म॑मध॒राञ्चं॑ सुवामसि ॥३॥
translation_en:
Of abscess, of decline, of inflammation of the eyes. O Plant, Of penetrating pain, thou Herb, let not a particle remain.

Those nerves of thine, Consumption! which stand closely hidden in thy groin I know the balm for that disease: the magic cure is Sipudru.

We draw from thee piercing pain that penetrates and racks thy limbs, That pierces ears, that pierces eyes, the abscess, and the heart's disease. Downward and far away from thee we banish that unknown. decline.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 127 · A charm to banish various diseases - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to banish various diseases की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to banish various diseases स्तुति]: Of abscess, of decline, of inflammation of the eyes. O Plant, Of penetrating pain, thou Herb, let not a particle remain.

2. [A charm to banish various diseases स्तुति]: Those nerves of thine, Consumption! which stand closely hidden in thy groin I know the balm for that disease: the magic cure is Sipudru.

3. [A charm to banish various diseases स्तुति]: We draw from thee piercing pain that penetrates and racks thy limbs, That pierces ears, that pierces eyes, the abscess, and the heart's disease. Downward and far away from thee we banish that unknown. decline.

title: Sukta 128 · A charm for fair weather
deity: A charm for fair weather
text:
राजा
१-४ अङ्गिराः। सोमः, शकधूमः। अनुष्टुप्।
श॒क॒धूमं॒ नक्ष॑त्राणि॒ यद् राजा॑न॒मकु॑र्वत ।
भ॒द्रा॒हम॑स्मै॒ प्राय॑च्छन्नि॒दं रा॒ष्ट्रमसा॒दिति॑ ॥१॥
भ॒द्रा॒हं नो॑ म॒ध्यंदि॑ने भद्रा॒हं सा॒यम॑स्तु नः ।
भ॒द्रा॒हं नो॒ अह्नां॑ प्रा॒ता रात्री॑ भद्रा॒हम॑स्तु नः ॥२॥
अ॒हो॒रा॒त्राभ्यां॒ नक्ष॑त्रेभ्यः सूर्याचन्द्र॒मसा॑भ्याम्।
भ॒द्रा॒हम॒स्मभ्यं॑ राज॒न्छक॑धूम॒ त्वं कृ॑धि ॥३॥
यो नो॑ भद्रा॒हमक॑रः सा॒यं नक्त॒मथो॒ दिवा॑ ।
तस्मै॑ ते नक्षत्रराज॒ शक॑धूम॒ सदा॒ नमः॑ ॥४॥
translation_en:
What time the heavenly bodies chose the Weather Prophet as their King, They brought him favouring weather, and, Let this be his do- main, they said.

May we have weather fair at noon, May we have weather fair at eve, Fair weather when the morning breaks, fair weather when the night is come.

Fair weather to the day and night, and to the stars and sun and moon. Give favourable weather thou, King, Weather Prophet, unto us.

Be worship ever paid to thee, O Weather Prophet, King of Star s, Who gavest us oo weather in the evening and by night and day!
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 128 · A charm for fair weather - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm for fair weather की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm for fair weather स्तुति]: What time the heavenly bodies chose the Weather Prophet as their King, They brought him favouring weather, and, Let this be his do- main, they said.

2. [A charm for fair weather स्तुति]: May we have weather fair at noon, May we have weather fair at eve, Fair weather when the morning breaks, fair weather when the night is come.

3. [A charm for fair weather स्तुति]: Fair weather to the day and night, and to the stars and sun and moon. Give favourable weather thou, King, Weather Prophet, unto us.

4. [A charm for fair weather स्तुति]: Be worship ever paid to thee, O Weather Prophet, King of Star s, Who gavest us oo weather in the evening and by night and day!

title: Sukta 129 · A charm for success and happiness
deity: A charm for success and happiness
text:
भगप्राप्तिः
१-३ अथर्वाङ्गिराः। भगः। अनुष्टुप्।
भगे॑न मा शांश॒पेन॑ सा॒कमिन्द्रे॑ण मे॒दिना॑ ।
कृ॒णोमि॑ भ॒गिनं॒ माप॑ द्रा॒न्त्वरा॑तयः ॥१॥
येन॑ वृ॒क्षाँ अ॒भ्यभ॑वो॒ भगे॑न॒ वर्च॑सा स॒ह।
तेन॑ मा भ॒गिनं॑ कृ॒ण्वप॑ द्रा॒न्त्वरा॑तयः ॥२॥
यो अ॒न्धो यः पु॑नःस॒रो भगो॑ वृ॒क्षेष्वाहि॑तः ।
तेन॑ मा भ॒गिनं॑ कृ॒ण्वप॑ द्रा॒न्त्वरा॑तयः ॥३॥
translation_en:
With fortune of the Sisu tree—with Indra as my friend to aid I give myself a happy fate. Fly and begone, Malignities!

That splendour and felicity wherewith thou hast excelled the trees Give me therewith a happy fate. Fly and begone, Malignities

Blind fortune, with reverted leaves that is deposited in trees— Give me therewith a happy fate. Fly and begone, Malignities.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 129 · A charm for success and happiness - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm for success and happiness की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm for success and happiness स्तुति]: With fortune of the Sisu tree—with Indra as my friend to aid I give myself a happy fate. Fly and begone, Malignities!

2. [A charm for success and happiness स्तुति]: That splendour and felicity wherewith thou hast excelled the trees Give me therewith a happy fate. Fly and begone, Malignities

3. [A charm for success and happiness स्तुति]: Blind fortune, with reverted leaves that is deposited in trees— Give me therewith a happy fate. Fly and begone, Malignities.

title: Sukta 130 · A woman's love-charm
deity: A woman's love-charm
text:
स्मरः।
१-४ अथर्वाङ्गिराः। स्मरः। अनुष्टुप्, १ विराट् पुरस्ताद्बृहती।
र॒थ॒जितां॑ राथजिते॒यीना॑मप्स॒रसा॑म॒यं स्म॒रः ।
देवाः॒ प्र हि॑णुत स्म॒रम॒सौ मामनु॑ शोचतु ॥१॥
अ॒सौ मे॑ स्मरता॒दिति॑ प्रि॒यो मे॑ स्मरता॒दिति॑ ।
देवाः॒ प्र हि॑णुत स्म॒रम॒सौ मामनु॑ शोचतु ॥२॥
यथा॒ मम॒ स्मरा॑द॒सौ नामुष्या॒हं क॒दा च॒न।
देवाः॒ प्र हि॑णुत स्म॒रम॒सौ मामनु॑ शोचतु ॥३॥
उन्मा॑दयत मरुत॒ उद॑न्तरिक्ष मादय ।
अग्न॒ उन्मा॑दया॒ त्वम॒सौ मामनु॑ शोचतु ॥४॥
translation_en:
This is the Apsarases' love-spell, the conquering, resistless ones'. Send the spell forth, ye Deities! Let him consume with love of me.

I pray, may he remember me, think of me, loving and beloved. Send forth the spell, ye Deities! Let him consume with love of me.

That he may think of me, that I may never, never think of him,. Send forth the spell, ye Deities! Let him consume with love of me.

Madden him, Maruts, madden him. Madden him, madden him, O Air. Madden him, Agni, madden him. Let him consume with love of me.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 130 · A woman's love-charm - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A woman's love-charm की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A woman's love-charm स्तुति]: This is the Apsarases' love-spell, the conquering, resistless ones'. Send the spell forth, ye Deities! Let him consume with love of me.

2. [A woman's love-charm स्तुति]: I pray, may he remember me, think of me, loving and beloved. Send forth the spell, ye Deities! Let him consume with love of me.

3. [A woman's love-charm स्तुति]: That he may think of me, that I may never, never think of him,. Send forth the spell, ye Deities! Let him consume with love of me.

4. [A woman's love-charm स्तुति]: Madden him, Maruts, madden him. Madden him, madden him, O Air. Madden him, Agni, madden him. Let him consume with love of me.

title: Sukta 131 · A woman's love-charm
deity: A woman's love-charm
text:
स्मरः।
१-३ अथर्वाङ्गिराः। स्मरः। अनुष्टुप्।
नि शी॑र्ष॒तो नि प॑त्त॒त आ॒ध्यो॒३ नि ति॑रामि ते ।
देवाः प्र हि॑णुत स्म॒रम॒सौ मामनु॑ शोचतु ॥१॥
अनु॑म॒तेऽन्वि॒दं म॑न्य॒स्वाकू॑ते॒ समि॒दं नमः॑ ।
देवाः॒ प्र हि॑णुत स्म॒रम॒सौ मामनु॑ शोचतु ॥२॥
यद् धाव॑सि त्रियोज॒नं प॑ञ्चयोज॒नमाश्वि॑नम्।
तत॒स्त्वं पुन॒राय॑सि पु॒त्राणां॑ नो असः पि॒ता॥३॥
translation_en:
Down upon thee, from head to foot, I draw the pangs of long- ing love. Send forth the charm, ye Deities! Let him consume with love of me.

Assent to this, O Heavenly Grace! Celestial Purpose, guide it well! Send forth the charm, ye Deities! Let him consume with love of me.

If thou shouldst run three leagues away, five leagues, a horse's daily stage, Thence thou shalt come to me again and be the father of our sons.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 131 · A woman's love-charm - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A woman's love-charm की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A woman's love-charm स्तुति]: Down upon thee, from head to foot, I draw the pangs of long- ing love. Send forth the charm, ye Deities! Let him consume with love of me.

2. [A woman's love-charm स्तुति]: Assent to this, O Heavenly Grace! Celestial Purpose, guide it well! Send forth the charm, ye Deities! Let him consume with love of me.

3. [A woman's love-charm स्तुति]: If thou shouldst run three leagues away, five leagues, a horse's daily stage, Thence thou shalt come to me again and be the father of our sons.

title: Sukta 132 · The same
deity: The same
text:
स्मरः।
१-५ अथर्वाङ्गिराः। स्मरः। अनुष्टुप्, १ त्रिपदा अनुष्टुप्, २,४,५ बृहती, ३ भुरिक्।
यं दे॒वाः स्म॒रमसि॑ञ्चन्न॒प्स्व१न्तः शोशु॑चानं स॒हाध्या।
तं ते॑ तपामि॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ धर्म॑णा ॥१॥
यं विश्वे॑ दे॒वाः स्म॒रमसि॑ञ्चन्न॒प्स्व१न्तः शोशु॑चानं स॒हाध्या।
तं ते॑ तपामि॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ धर्म॑णा ॥२॥
यमि॑न्द्रा॒णी स्म॒रमसि॑ञ्चद॒प्स्व॑१न्तः शोशु॑चानं स॒हाध्या।
तं ते॑ तपामि॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ धर्म॑णा ॥३॥
यमि॑न्द्रा॒ग्नी स्म॒रमसि॑ञ्चताम॒प्स्व॑१न्तः शोशु॑चानं स॒हाध्या।
तं ते॑ तपामि॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ धर्म॑णा ॥४॥
यं मि॒त्रावरु॑णौ स्म॒रमसि॑ञ्चताम॒प्स्व॑१न्तः शोशु॑चानं स॒हाध्या।
तं ते॑ तपामि॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ धर्म॑णा ॥५॥
translation_en:
The Philter, burning with the pangs of yearning love, which Gods have poured within the bosom of the floods, That spell for thee I heat by Varuna's decree.

The charm which, burning with the pangs of love, the General Gods have poured within the bosom of the floods, That spell for thee I heat by Varuna's decree.

The Philter, burning with the pangs of longing, which Indrāni hath effused within the waters' depth, That spell for thee I heat by Varuna's decree.

The charm, aglow with longing, which Indra and Agni have effused within the bosom of the floods, That spell for thee I heat by Varuna's decree.

The charm aglow with longing which Mitra and Varuna have poured within the bosom of the floods, That spell for thee I heat by Varuna's decree.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 132 · The same - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा The same की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [The same स्तुति]: The Philter, burning with the pangs of yearning love, which Gods have poured within the bosom of the floods, That spell for thee I heat by Varuna's decree.

2. [The same स्तुति]: The charm which, burning with the pangs of love, the General Gods have poured within the bosom of the floods, That spell for thee I heat by Varuna's decree.

3. [The same स्तुति]: The Philter, burning with the pangs of longing, which Indrāni hath effused within the waters' depth, That spell for thee I heat by Varuna's decree.

4. [The same स्तुति]: The charm, aglow with longing, which Indra and Agni have effused within the bosom of the floods, That spell for thee I heat by Varuna's decree.

5. [The same स्तुति]: The charm aglow with longing which Mitra and Varuna have poured within the bosom of the floods, That spell for thee I heat by Varuna's decree.

title: Sukta 133 · A glorification of the sacred girdle
deity: A glorification of the sacred girdle
text:
मेखलाबन्धनम्।
१-५ अगस्त्यः। मेखला। १ भुरिक् २, ५ अनुष्टुप्, ३ त्रिष्टुप्, ४ जगती।
य इ॒मां दे॒वो मेख॑लामाब॒बन्ध॒ यः सं॑न॒नाह॒ य उ॑ नो यु॒योज॑ ।
यस्य॑ दे॒वस्य॑ प्र॒शिषा॒ चरा॑मः॒ स पा॒रमि॑च्छा॒त् स स उ॑ नो॒ वि मु॑ञ्चात्॥१॥
आहु॑तास्य॒भिहु॑त॒ ऋषी॑णाम॒स्यायु॑धम्।
पूर्वा॑ व्र॒तस्य॑ प्राश्न॒ती वी॑र॒घ्नी भ॑व मेखले ॥२॥
मृ॒त्योर॒हं ब्र॑ह्मचा॒री यदस्मि॑ नि॒र्याच॑न् भू॒तात् पुरु॑षं य॒माय॑ ।
तम॒हं ब्रह्म॑णा॒ तप॑सा॒ श्रमे॑णा॒नयै॑नं॒ मेख॑लया सिनामि ॥३॥
श्र॒द्धाया॑ दुहि॒ता तप॒सोऽधि॑ जा॒ता स्वस॒ ऋषी॑णां भूत॒कृतां॑ ब॒भूव॑ ।
सा नो॑ मेखले म॒तिमा धे॑हि मे॒धामथो॑ नो धेहि॒ तप॑ इन्द्रि॒यं च॑ ॥४॥
यां त्वा॒ पूर्वे॑ भूत॒कृत॒ ऋष॑यः परिबेधि॒रे।
सा त्वं परि॑ ष्वजस्व॒ मां दी॑र्घायु॒त्वाय॑ मेखले ॥५॥
translation_en:
By the direction of that God we journey, he will seek means to save and he will free us; The God who hath engirt us with this Girdle, he who hath fast- ened it, and made us ready.

Thou, weapon of the Rishis, art adored and served with sacrifice. First tasting of the votive milk, Zone, be a hero-slayer thou!

As I am now Death's Brahmachāri claiming out of the living world a man for Yama, So with Austerity and Prayer and Fervour I bind this Girdle round the man before me.

She hath become, Faith's daughter, sprung from Fervour, the sister of the world-creating Rishis; As such, O Girdle, give us thought and wisdom, give us religious zeal and mental vigour.

Thou whom primeval Rishis girt about them, they who made the world, As such do thou encircle me, O Girdle, for long days of life.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 133 · A glorification of the sacred girdle - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A glorification of the sacred girdle की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A glorification of the sacred girdle स्तुति]: By the direction of that God we journey, he will seek means to save and he will free us; The God who hath engirt us with this Girdle, he who hath fast- ened it, and made us ready.

2. [A glorification of the sacred girdle स्तुति]: Thou, weapon of the Rishis, art adored and served with sacrifice. First tasting of the votive milk, Zone, be a hero-slayer thou!

3. [A glorification of the sacred girdle स्तुति]: As I am now Death's Brahmachāri claiming out of the living world a man for Yama, So with Austerity and Prayer and Fervour I bind this Girdle round the man before me.

4. [A glorification of the sacred girdle स्तुति]: She hath become, Faith's daughter, sprung from Fervour, the sister of the world-creating Rishis; As such, O Girdle, give us thought and wisdom, give us religious zeal and mental vigour.

5. [A glorification of the sacred girdle स्तुति]: Thou whom primeval Rishis girt about them, they who made the world, As such do thou encircle me, O Girdle, for long days of life.

title: Sukta 134 · A priest's prayer for power to punish wrong-doers
deity: A priest's prayer for power to punish wrong-doers
text:
शत्रुनाशनम्।
१-३ शक्रः। वज्रः। १ परानुष्टुप् त्रिष्टुप्, २ अनुष्टुप्, ३ भुरिक् त्रिपदा गायत्री।
अ॒यं वज्र॑स्तर्पयतामृ॒तस्यावा॑स्य रा॒ष्ट्रमप॑ हन्तु जीवि॒तम्।
शृ॒णातु॑ ग्री॒वाः प्र शृ॑णातू॒ष्णिहा॑ वृ॒त्रस्ये॑व॒ शची॒पतिः॑ ॥१॥
अध॑रोऽधर॒ उत्त॑रेभ्यो गू॒ढः पृ॑थि॒व्या मोत् सृपत्।
वज्रे॒णाव॑हतः शयाम्॥२॥
यो जि॒नाति॒ तमन्वि॑च्छ यो जि॒नाति॒ तमिज्ज॑हि ।
जि॒न॒तो व॑ज्र॒ त्वं सी॒मन्त॑म॒न्वञ्च॒मनु॑ पातय ॥३॥
translation_en:
This Thunderbolt shall take its fill of Order, scare life away and overthrow the kingdom. Tear necks in pieces. rend napes asunder, even as the Lord of Might the neck of Vritra.

Down, down beneath the conquerors, let him not rise, concealed in earth, but lie down-smitten with the bolt.

Seek out the fierce oppressor, yea, strike only the oppressor dead. Down on the fierce oppressor's head strike at full length, O Thunderbolt!
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 134 · A priest's prayer for power to punish wrong-doers - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A priest's prayer for power to punish wrong-doers की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A priest's prayer for power to punish wrong-doers स्तुति]: This Thunderbolt shall take its fill of Order, scare life away and overthrow the kingdom. Tear necks in pieces. rend napes asunder, even as the Lord of Might the neck of Vritra.

2. [A priest's prayer for power to punish wrong-doers स्तुति]: Down, down beneath the conquerors, let him not rise, concealed in earth, but lie down-smitten with the bolt.

3. [A priest's prayer for power to punish wrong-doers स्तुति]: Seek out the fierce oppressor, yea, strike only the oppressor dead. Down on the fierce oppressor's head strike at full length, O Thunderbolt!

title: Sukta 135 · A priest's fulmination against an enemy
deity: A priest's fulmination against an enemy
text:
बलप्राप्तिः।
१-३ शुक्रः। वज्रः। अनुष्टुप्।
यद॒श्नामि॒ बलं॑ कुर्व इ॒त्थं वज्र॒मा द॑दे ।
स्क॒न्धान॒मुष्य॑ शा॒तय॑न् वृ॒त्रस्ये॑व॒ शची॒पतिः॑ ॥१॥
यत् पिबा॑मि॒ सं पि॑बामि समु॒द्र इ॑व संपि॒बः ।
प्रा॒णान॒मुष्य॑ सं॒पाय॒ सं पि॑बामो अ॒मुं व॒यम्॥२॥
यद् गिरा॑मि॒ सं गि॑रामि समु॒द्र इ॑व संगि॒रः ।
प्रा॒णान॒मुष्य॑ सं॒गीर्य॒ सं गि॑रामो अ॒मुं व॒यम्॥३॥
translation_en:
Whate'er I eat I turn to strength, and thus I grasp the Thunder- bolt, Rending the shoulders of that man as Indra shattered Vritra's neck.

I drink together what I drink, even as the sea that swallows all. Drinking the life-breath of that man, we drink that man and swallow him.

Whate'er I eat I swallow up, even as the sea that swallows all. Swallowing that man's vital breath, we swallow him completely up.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 135 · A priest's fulmination against an enemy - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A priest's fulmination against an enemy की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A priest's fulmination against an enemy स्तुति]: Whate'er I eat I turn to strength, and thus I grasp the Thunder- bolt, Rending the shoulders of that man as Indra shattered Vritra's neck.

2. [A priest's fulmination against an enemy स्तुति]: I drink together what I drink, even as the sea that swallows all. Drinking the life-breath of that man, we drink that man and swallow him.

3. [A priest's fulmination against an enemy स्तुति]: Whate'er I eat I swallow up, even as the sea that swallows all. Swallowing that man's vital breath, we swallow him completely up.

title: Sukta 136 · A charm to promote the growth of hair
deity: A charm to promote the growth of hair
text:
केशदृंहणम्।
१-३ वीतहव्यः। नितत्नि वनस्पतिः। अनुष्टुप् २ एकावसाना द्विपदा साम्नी बृहती।
दे॒वी दे॒व्यामधि॑ जा॒ता पृ॑थि॒व्याम॑स्योषधे ।
तां त्वा॑ नितत्नि॒ केशे॑भ्यो॒ दृंह॑णाय खनामसि ॥१॥
दृंह॑ प्र॒त्नान् ज॒नयाजा॑तान् जा॒तानु॒ वर्षी॑यसस्कृधि ॥२॥
यस्ते॒ केशो॑ऽव॒पद्य॑ते॒ समू॑लो॒ यश्च॑ वृ॒श्चते॑ ।
इ॒दं तं वि॒श्वभे॑षज्या॒भि षि॑ञ्चामि वी॒रुधा॑ ॥३॥
translation_en:
Born from the bosom of wide Earth the Goddess, godlike Plant, art thou: So we, Nitatnī! dig thee up to strengthen and fix fast the hair.

Make the old firm, make new hair spring, lengthen what has already grown.

Thy hair where it is falling off, and with the roots is torn away, I wet and sprinkle with the Plant, the remedy for all disease.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 136 · A charm to promote the growth of hair - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to promote the growth of hair की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to promote the growth of hair स्तुति]: Born from the bosom of wide Earth the Goddess, godlike Plant, art thou: So we, Nitatnī! dig thee up to strengthen and fix fast the hair.

2. [A charm to promote the growth of hair स्तुति]: Make the old firm, make new hair spring, lengthen what has already grown.

3. [A charm to promote the growth of hair स्तुति]: Thy hair where it is falling off, and with the roots is torn away, I wet and sprinkle with the Plant, the remedy for all disease.

title: Sukta 137 · A charm to promote the growth of hair
deity: A charm to promote the growth of hair
text:
केशवर्धनम्।
१-३ वीतहव्यः। वनस्पतिः। अनुष्टुप्।
यां ज॒मद॑ग्नि॒रख॑नद् दुहि॒त्रे के॑श॒वर्ध॑नीम्।
तां वी॒तह॑व्य॒ आभ॑र॒दसि॑तस्य गृ॒हेभ्यः॑ ॥१॥
अ॒भीशु॑ना॒ मेया॑ आसन् व्या॒मेना॑नु॒मेयाः॑ ।
केशा॑ न॒डा इ॑व वर्धन्तां शी॒र्ष्णस्ते॑ असि॒ताः परि॑ ॥२॥
दृंह॑ मूल॒माग्रं॑ यच्छ॒ वि मध्यं॑ यामयौषधे ।
केशा॑ न॒डा इ॑व वर्धन्तां शी॒र्ष्णस्ते॑ असि॒ताः परि॑ ॥३॥
translation_en:
The Plant which Jamadagni dug to make his daughter's locks. grow long, This same hath Vitahavya brought to us from Asita's abode.

They might be measured with a rein, meted with both extended arms. Let the black locks spring thick and strong and grow like reeds upon thy head.

Strengthen the roots, prolong the points, lengthen the middle part, O Plant. Let the black locks spring thick and strong and grow like reeds upon thy head.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 137 · A charm to promote the growth of hair - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A charm to promote the growth of hair की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A charm to promote the growth of hair स्तुति]: The Plant which Jamadagni dug to make his daughter's locks. grow long, This same hath Vitahavya brought to us from Asita's abode.

2. [A charm to promote the growth of hair स्तुति]: They might be measured with a rein, meted with both extended arms. Let the black locks spring thick and strong and grow like reeds upon thy head.

3. [A charm to promote the growth of hair स्तुति]: Strengthen the roots, prolong the points, lengthen the middle part, O Plant. Let the black locks spring thick and strong and grow like reeds upon thy head.

title: Sukta 138 · A woman's imprecation on her unfaithful lover
deity: A woman's imprecation on her unfaithful lover
text:
क्लबत्वम्।
१-५ अथर्वा। वनस्पतिः। अनुष्टुप्, ३ पथ्यापङ्क्तिः।
त्वं वी॒रुधां॒ श्रेष्ठ॑तमाभिश्रु॒तास्यो॑षधे ।
इ॒मं मे॑ अ॒द्य पुरु॑षं क्ली॒बमो॑प॒शिनं॑ कृधि ॥१॥
क्ली॒बं कृ॑ध्योप॒शिन॒मथो॑ कुरी॒रिणं॑ कृधि ।
अथा॒स्येन्द्रो॒ ग्राव॑भ्यामु॒भे भि॑नत्त्वा॒ण्ड्यौऽ॥२॥
क्लीब॑ क्ली॒बं त्वा॑करं॒ वध्रे॒ वध्रिं॑ त्वाकर॒मर॑सार॒सं त्वा॑करम्।
कु॒रीर॑मस्य शी॒र्षणि॒ कुम्बं॑ चाधि॒निद॑ध्मसि ॥३॥
ये ते॑ ना॒ड्यौऽदे॒वकृ॑ते॒ ययो॒स्तिष्ठ॑ति॒ वृष्ण्य॑म्।
ते ते॑ भिनद्मि॒ शम्य॑या॒मुष्या॒ अधि॑ मु॒ष्कयोः॑ ॥४॥
यथा॑ न॒डं क॒शिपु॑ने॒ स्त्रियो॑ भि॒न्दन्त्यश्म॑ना ।
ए॒वा भि॑नद्मि ते॒ शेपो॒ऽमुष्या॒ अधि॑ मु॒ष्कयोः॑ ॥५॥
translation_en:
O Plant, thy fame is spread abroad as best of all the herbs that grow. Unman for me to-day this man that he may wear the horn of hair.

Make him a eunuch with a horn, set thou the crest upon his- head. Let Indra with two pressing-stones deprive him of his manly strength.

I have unmanned thee, eunuch! yea, impotent! made thee- impotent, and robbed thee, weakling! of thy strength. Upon his head we set the horn, we set the branching ornament.

Duas tuas venas, a Diis factas, in quibus stat vigor virilis, paxillo ligneo in testiculis ob istam mulierem tibi findo.

Ut mulieres mattam (tegetem) facturae arundinem lapide findunt, sic fascinum tuum cum testiculis ob istam mulierem findo.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 138 · A woman's imprecation on her unfaithful lover - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A woman's imprecation on her unfaithful lover की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A woman's imprecation on her unfaithful lover स्तुति]: O Plant, thy fame is spread abroad as best of all the herbs that grow. Unman for me to-day this man that he may wear the horn of hair.

2. [A woman's imprecation on her unfaithful lover स्तुति]: Make him a eunuch with a horn, set thou the crest upon his- head. Let Indra with two pressing-stones deprive him of his manly strength.

3. [A woman's imprecation on her unfaithful lover स्तुति]: I have unmanned thee, eunuch! yea, impotent! made thee- impotent, and robbed thee, weakling! of thy strength. Upon his head we set the horn, we set the branching ornament.

4. [A woman's imprecation on her unfaithful lover स्तुति]: Duas tuas venas, a Diis factas, in quibus stat vigor virilis, paxillo ligneo in testiculis ob istam mulierem tibi findo.

5. [A woman's imprecation on her unfaithful lover स्तुति]: Ut mulieres mattam (tegetem) facturae arundinem lapide findunt, sic fascinum tuum cum testiculis ob istam mulierem findo.

title: Sukta 139 · A woman's love-charm
deity: A woman's love-charm
text:
सौभाग्यवर्धनम्।
१-५ अथर्वा। वनस्पतिः। अनुष्टुप्, १ त्र्यवसाना षट् पदा विराड् जगती।
न्य॒स्ति॒का रु॑रोहिथ सुभगं॒कर॑णी॒ मम॑ ।
श॒तं तव॑ प्रता॒नास्त्रय॑स्त्रिंशन्निता॒नाः ॥
तया॑ सहस्रप॒र्ण्या हृद॑यं शोषयामि ते ॥१॥
शुष्य॑तु॒ मयि॑ ते॒ हृद॑य॒मथो॑ शुष्यत्वा॒स्यऽम्।
अथो॒ नि शु॑ष्य॒ मां कामे॒नाथो॒ शुष्का॑स्या चर ॥२॥
सं॒वन॑नी समुष्प॒ला बभ्रु॒ कल्या॑णि॒ सं नु॑द ।
अमूं च॒ मां च॒ सं नु॑द समा॒नं हृद॑यं कृधि ॥३॥
यथो॑द॒कमप॑पुषोऽप॒शुष्य॑त्या॒स्यऽम्।
ए॒वा नि शु॑ष्य॒ मां कामे॒नाथो॒ शुष्का॑स्या चर ॥४॥
यथा॑ नकु॒लो वि॒च्छिद्य॑ सं॒दधा॒त्यहिं॒ पुनः॑ ।
ए॒वा काम॑स्य॒ विच्छि॑न्नं॒ सं धे॑हि वीर्यावति ॥५॥
translation_en:
Thou hast grown up, a source of joy to bless me with pros- perity. A hundred are thy tendrils, three-and-thirty thy descending shoots. With this that bears a thousand leaves I dry thy heart and wither it.

Let thy heart wither for my love and let thy month be dry for me. Parch and dry up with longing, go with lips that love of me hath dried.

Drive us together, tawny! fair! a go-between who wakens love. Drive us together, him and me, and give us both one heart and mind.

Even as his mouth is parched who finds no water for his burn- ing thirst, So parch and burn with longing, go with lips that love of me hath dried.

Even as the Mungoose bites and rends and then restores the wounded snake, So do thou, Mighty one, restore the fracture of our severed love.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 139 · A woman's love-charm - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A woman's love-charm की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A woman's love-charm स्तुति]: Thou hast grown up, a source of joy to bless me with pros- perity. A hundred are thy tendrils, three-and-thirty thy descending shoots. With this that bears a thousand leaves I dry thy heart and wither it.

2. [A woman's love-charm स्तुति]: Let thy heart wither for my love and let thy month be dry for me. Parch and dry up with longing, go with lips that love of me hath dried.

3. [A woman's love-charm स्तुति]: Drive us together, tawny! fair! a go-between who wakens love. Drive us together, him and me, and give us both one heart and mind.

4. [A woman's love-charm स्तुति]: Even as his mouth is parched who finds no water for his burn- ing thirst, So parch and burn with longing, go with lips that love of me hath dried.

5. [A woman's love-charm स्तुति]: Even as the Mungoose bites and rends and then restores the wounded snake, So do thou, Mighty one, restore the fracture of our severed love.

title: Sukta 140 · A blessing on a child's first two teeth
deity: A blessing on a child's first two teeth
text:
सुमङ्गलौ दन्तौ।
१-३ अथर्वा। ब्रह्मणस्पतिः, दन्ताः। (अनुष्टुप् १) १ उरोबृहती,
२ उपरिष्टाज्ज्योतिष्मती त्रिषटुप्, ३ आस्तारपङ्क्तिः।
यौ व्या॒घ्रवव॑रूढौ जिघ॑त्सतः पि॒तरं॑ मा॒तरं॑ च ।
यौ दन्तौ ब्रह्मणस्पते शि॒वौ कृ॑णु जातवेदः ॥१॥
व्री॒हिम॑त्तं॒ यव॑मत्त॒मथो॒ माष॒मथो॒ तिल॑म्।
ए॒ष वां॑ भा॒गो निहि॑तो रत्न॒धेया॑य दन्तौ॒ मा हिं॑सिष्टं पि॒तरं॑ मा॒तरं॑ च ॥२॥
उप॑हूतौ स॒युजौ॑ स्यो॒नौ दन्तौ॑ सुम॒ङ्गलौ॑ ।
अ॒न्यत्र॑ वां घो॒रं त॒न्वः॑१ परै॑तु दन्तौ॒ मा हिं॑सिष्टं पि॒तरं॑ मा॒तरं॑ च ॥३॥
translation_en:
Two tigers have grown up who long to eat the mother and the sire: Soothe, Brāhmanaspati, and thou, O Jātavedas, both these teeth.

Let rice and barley be your food, eat also beans and sesamum. This is the share allotted you, to be your portion, ye two Teeth. Harm not your mother and your sire.

Both fellow teeth have been invoked, gentle and bringing happi- ness. Else whither let the fierceness of your nature turn away, O Teeth! Harm not your mother or your sire.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 140 · A blessing on a child's first two teeth - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A blessing on a child's first two teeth की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A blessing on a child's first two teeth स्तुति]: Two tigers have grown up who long to eat the mother and the sire: Soothe, Brāhmanaspati, and thou, O Jātavedas, both these teeth.

2. [A blessing on a child's first two teeth स्तुति]: Let rice and barley be your food, eat also beans and sesamum. This is the share allotted you, to be your portion, ye two Teeth. Harm not your mother and your sire.

3. [A blessing on a child's first two teeth स्तुति]: Both fellow teeth have been invoked, gentle and bringing happi- ness. Else whither let the fierceness of your nature turn away, O Teeth! Harm not your mother or your sire.

title: Sukta 141 · A blessing on cattle
deity: A blessing on cattle
text:
गोकर्णयोर्लक्ष्यकरणम्।
१-३ विश्वामित्रः। अश्विनौ। अनुष्टुप्।
वा॒युरे॑नाः स॒माक॑र॒त् त्वष्टा॒ पोषा॑य ध्रियताम्।
इन्द्र॑ आभ्यो॒ अधि॑ ब्रवद् रु॒द्रो भू॒म्ने चि॑कित्सतु ॥१॥
लोहि॑तेन॒ स्वधि॑तिना मिथु॒नं कर्ण॑योः कृधि ।
अक॑र्ताम॒श्विना॒ लक्ष्म॒ तद॑स्तु प्र॒जया॑ ब॒हु॥२॥
यथा॑ च॒क्रुर्दे॑वासु॒रा यथा॑ मनु॒ष्याऽउ॒त।
ए॒वा स॑हस्रपो॒षाय॑ कृणु॒तं लक्ष्मा॑श्विना ॥३॥
translation_en:
Vayu collected these: to find their sustenance be Tvashtar's care: May Indra bless and comfort them, and Rudra look that they increase.

Take thou the iron axe and make a pair by marks upon their ears. This sign the Asvins have impressed: let these increase and multiply.

Even as Gods and Asuras, even as mortal men have done, Do ye, that these may multiply in thousands, Asvins! make the mark.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 141 · A blessing on cattle - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A blessing on cattle की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A blessing on cattle स्तुति]: Vayu collected these: to find their sustenance be Tvashtar's care: May Indra bless and comfort them, and Rudra look that they increase.

2. [A blessing on cattle स्तुति]: Take thou the iron axe and make a pair by marks upon their ears. This sign the Asvins have impressed: let these increase and multiply.

3. [A blessing on cattle स्तुति]: Even as Gods and Asuras, even as mortal men have done, Do ye, that these may multiply in thousands, Asvins! make the mark.

title: Sukta 142 · A blessing on cattle
deity: A blessing on cattle
text:
अन्नसमृद्धिः।
१-३ विश्वामित्रः। वायुः। अनुष्टुप्।
उच्छ्र॑यस्व ब॒हुर्भ॑व॒ स्वेन॒ मह॑सा यव ।
मृ॒णी॒हि विश्वा॒ पात्रा॑णि॒ मा त्वा॑ दि॒व्याशनि॑र्वधीत्॥१॥
आ॒शृ॒ण्वन्तं॒ यवं॑ दे॒वं यत्र॑ त्वाच्छा॒वदा॑मसि ।
तदुच्छ्र॑यस्व॒ द्यौरि॑व समु॒द्र इ॑वै॒ध्यक्षि॑तः ॥२॥
अक्षि॑तास्त उप॒सदोऽक्षि॑ताः सन्तु रा॒शयः॑ ।
पृ॒णन्तो॒ अक्षि॑ताः सन्त्व॒त्तारः॑ स॒न्त्वक्षि॑ताः ॥३॥
translation_en:
Spring high, O Barley, and become much through thine own magnificence: Burst all the vessels; let the bolt from heaven forbear to strike thee down.

As we invite and call to thee, Barley, a God who heareth us, Raise thyself up like heaven on high and be exhaustless as the sea.

Exhaustless let thine out-turns be, exhaustless be thy gathered heaps, Exhaustless be thy givers, and exhaustless those who eat of thee.
translation_hi:
॥ Sukta 142 · A blessing on cattle - हिन्दी भावार्थ ॥

प्रस्तुत सूक्त में ऋषि द्वारा A blessing on cattle की दिव्य महिमा, अनुग्रह, शक्ति और कल्याणकारी स्वरूप का वैदिक मन्त्रों में स्तवन किया गया है।

1. [A blessing on cattle स्तुति]: Spring high, O Barley, and become much through thine own magnificence: Burst all the vessels; let the bolt from heaven forbear to strike thee down.

2. [A blessing on cattle स्तुति]: As we invite and call to thee, Barley, a God who heareth us, Raise thyself up like heaven on high and be exhaustless as the sea.

3. [A blessing on cattle स्तुति]: Exhaustless let thine out-turns be, exhaustless be thy gathered heaps, Exhaustless be thy givers, and exhaustless those who eat of thee.
